tei:div.tei:p: dag snang lasaḥ bla sgrub ye shes thugs kyi snying po bzhugs soḥ

sgo kyi na mo gu ru we ༷ 411smo118) sangs rgyas kun dngobabla ma la brten nas byin r+ṣasabaskul 'dod naḥkhyed shes dad pa drag po yis bla ma yid la bsgom bzhi du aḥ dbang sdon mkhye1 zhun ma'i ngos yangs por0 sna tshogs ge sar zla nyi zhal sbyor khar rgyal ba kun dngos ye shes rdo rje cheḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma nus ldan gling ba ni he ru ka dpal dkar dmara'adzum mdzes sgegs phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags phur gdengasaḥ sna tshogs dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyanaḥ rol ba'i thabs bzhugs 'ja' 'od zer gsum 'phro brgyudagasum rgya mtsho'i spyi gzigs lam mer gsal khyed shes dad pas na mo gu nas stong gsum 'dus ma byas pa ye grol gyiklong nas rgyal kun thugs rje'i gzigs pa nus ldan glingamakhyen no ༷ shugs 'byung blo bde yan pa'i chos nyid de rtogs paraX skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs bla ma mchog mkhyen noX srid las rnam par sgrol ba'i shing rta la pheb nas sku gsum gtan srid zin par byin gyis rang brlabs shig brgya stong ci rigs brjod bla ma'i thugs ka nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'od lnga'i zer lam nas brgyud de rang gi

sgo snying gar thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub kye dbyeg chen po thob par bsam laḥ e ma hā gu ru kle ma sarba sedzha hūṃ kye mkhyen no ye shes sgyu ma nus ldan glengamakhyed no gzigs shig skye 'gags bral ba'i dbyings nyid las gzigs laX sbor zhig nyams rtogs yon tan phyogs med du sbar laḥ thob mdzod rang byung sangs rgyas lagamathil nas rted mdzod ca mang brjod mthar dbang bzhi blangs pa ni kyeḥ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che'iX gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'byu las 'od zer dkar dmaramathing ljang rnam par byung bdag gi gnas lngar thims pas dbang bzhi thobaX sgrib pa bzhi dag lam bzhi sgom la dbang sku bzhi ye shes mngon du gyur bar bsamaḥ a yi blama'i thugs mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi don la mnyam par bzhag goX thun grol tshe na mo gu ru snang grags dran rig dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mdzad pam lus mthar phyin nas skyabs mgon bla ma gar bzhugs phrin las par gyur te/ don gnyis lhun grub 'khor ba dong sprugs byed por sgo gaḥ lan gsum gdab bza' gas byed tshe

trīḥ longs spyod lam pi gar rol bla ma he ru ka dpalaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje khyed nyid dran bzhinaḥ bde stong tshim pa drug ldan sngags kyi zlos gar bsgyur gyisaX zag med ye shes 'char ba'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur mdzodaḥ sarba sirnyi hrī: gnyad du phyogs tshe 'dun pa drag po yis trīḥ o rgyan rang byung gnas mchog tsit+ta rin chen sbubs na lnga ldan 'od lnga'i klong du ye rdzogs sangs rgyas rang chasaḥ kun bzang pad 'byung nyid dang dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma'iX stong gsal 'od kyi phung po ye shes gzigs pa mchog ltanaḥ 'bras bu sangs rgyas dgongs pa ka dag lhun grub rtogs paX blo las 'das pa'i shes rab rang rig stong gsal mdzod ༷ mos gus tshad med pas kyiḥ mkhyen no sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dpalapagon bla ma mkhyen noḥ srid pa'i grong khyer zhen 'dzin rang grol thos bsam sgom sgrubasaX bya ba gces dgu cog bzhag nyams len mtha' ru phyin te/ dal 'byer don ldan lha chosa'agrub par byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ bka' drin mtshungs pa skye dang tshe rabs rnam pa kun tu dpal ldan bla ma gar bzhugs gnas der 'khor kyi thu boraX legs par gyur

shārwa nas rig bzang blo gsal teng 'dzin brtan pos nyon shes zag zad sa lam rtsal rdzogs zung 'jug 'thob mardzadaḥ 'a jags skrag drag pos 'dung tshe kye skyabs cheX bdag la 'jigs chen gdung bas gzir skabasaX re ltos gzhan na ma mchis dpal mgon bla maḥ skyid sdug legs nyes ci mdzad rje khyed mkhyen no mnar gcod 'khrulasnang rang zhi 'od gsal bde chenaX dpal ri pad+ma 'od du snang ba 'phos teḥ rig 'dzin dam pa'i rjes zin bdag gi dge mtshanaḥ 'gro ba'i 'dren ston gyur bar byin gyis rlobasashig de ltar gdab nam yang bla ma dran tshe rje ma rig mun pa sel mdzad skyabs mgon bla maX sku rdul bral gangs ri'i zhal bzang dran pa'i mod laX gsung bdud rtsi'i sbrang char snyingadabus pad 'tshor sim tshe thugs rta bdun dbang po shes rab sgo brgya 'byed bzhinaḥ blo'i ma rig rgong rgya sems kyi g.ya' kun chod nasaḥ deng lhag mthong rig pa'i sgron me'abar ba e maḥ zhes yang yang brjod la thugs yid bsre'o 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i b.raḥ bla ma mchog gi gdul byar rab gyur te ltems rkyangs med pas zhabs tog

bka' bzhin 'grub thugs yid gcig 'dres rtogs pa mngon gyur thegag zhes smon lam gdab nye lam dngos grub yon ma kun rdo rje'i bla ma bsnyen las 'byungaḥ de phyir thang lhod bral ba yis bla ma spyodalam rnam bzhir sgom mos gus thang lhod med par gyis khyed shes dad pas gsol ba thob gdung shugs drag pos 'o dod 'bod 'bras bu tshe 'dir sangs rgyas rted the tshom med do rgyal ba'i bka'aḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin chos gsal rgya mtsho nas bkra shis lha reg gi skyesabacasayang yang bskul ngor nusaldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa sarba ma lam —13 dhi 'jam mgon smra ba'i nyi ma dngaX mi pham rnam rgyal sras bcas laḥ snying nas gsol ba 'debs lags naḥ kun dha byang chub sems kyi gnasaḥ khams lus dwangasapa lnga yi dalaḥ phun tshogs nang gi gsang chen laX nyams chags zhig ral med pa dang rmi lam na'ang bsrung ba'i dge byang chub bar du nyams med mdzodaḥ e baṃ badz+ra kun+d+ra li hūṃtu tra shagaX smra bcad brgya rtsa ma chags paraḥ yi dam mdzod dang rno nus che gzhen la gsang ba phyag rgyas sdomaḥ bskal ba can dang 'phrad par shog nus ldan pas so

tshang dag snang lasaḥ bla ma'e rnal 'byer byen rlabs dngos grub kye chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ——1) na mo gu ru —1 1 zher (tswakhu'i khyed shes dad pa drag po yis bla ma'i rnal yor 'di la 'bad na mo gu rtsa rang lus 'dzin med smin mtshams nam mkha'al dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma kun 'dus dpal bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma niX o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam rol gsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sprinaphung 'khrigasaX dad ldan mos mtshor thugs rjes nyer dgongs dmigs bye skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzigs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje mi mjed zhing gi skyabasagacigaX 'gro ba'i 'dren ston dam pa bka' drin mtshungs zla bral ba' o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal tshab sprul pa'i gter chen rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rjer snying nas gsolab 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shigaX 'bral med thugs rje zungs mdzod rnga yab dpal gyi ri laḥ mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mosaḥ lam ston lam sna 'dren mdzod

ces gsol ba ci mang bawaḥ e ma hoḥ zab rgya'i sgrom 'byed rig 'dzin hūṃ ka raX rgya bod lo tsā lang gro dkon mchog 'byungaḥ chos rgyal rig 'dzin bdud 'joms khyung drag laX gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud byin rlabs rtsol0 thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams len gyisaX snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlabasaḥ lan gsum gdab rjes bzlos dmigs ni gu ru'i thugs ka nas byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba 'od zer ba thag lta bu spreng ste rang gi snying gar thim pas snang zhen gyi dri ma dgaḥ rlung sems 'khrul ba'i spros pa zhi bying rmugamathibs pa kun gzhi'i g.ya' 17laX thim la ma rmug pa nang gsal gyi ye shes mngon sum du mthong bar bsam laḥ snyen ma hā gu ru sa man+ta bha tra sdakhya sarba sirnyi pha la ( ci nus bzlosamathar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim sgrib bral dbang thob thugs yid 'dres smra ba'i blo las 'das pa yiḥ rig pa rang grol nyid la lta a yas dngosagrub kun gyirtsa ba 'di skal ba can gyi nyams su longasaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim lhaḥ zhes pa'ang rong sngags reb gong ga yul gru dbyin sa nas phe ba pa'i sngags pa dpal chen skyabs kyas dar bcas bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes dbyings snang

hoX zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs don bsdus yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs soḥro/ —— na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX kokhos ཿ khyed shes blo gtad mi 'gyur nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya e ma ho skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nas dgongasadrong snyan brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter yongs rdzogs ngo bo dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor laḥ khyed shes dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na snang zhen rlung sems spros parnam dag nas khregs chod gzhi yi gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrodaḥ thod rgal snang ba bzhi yi nyams rtsal rdzogasaḥ dbyings rig dbyer med bla ma'i dkyil 'khor duḥ tshe 'di nyid lamangon par byang chub regag de ltar gsol btab nyams rtogs 'phel rig 'dzan sa la the mi tshomaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya ཿ gsol 'debs don bsdus yid bzhin nor bu rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgyaḥ o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma sam bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang sngags kyi dbang phyug bla ma ljon rgyas kyis bkra shis lha reg rdzab kya zhal bu mngar gsum gyis
bkang ba'i skyes bcas bskul ngor 7 kho bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin mi tri' bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

—11 zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rtsa sgrub ye shes snying po bzhugs so ——14 na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥ 24zag/sgorna/ ma bcos rig pa thad shar bzhag dgo sa pa chos sku'i gter sgo dbye sgo gsum bya ba ro snyoms gtong rlung sems thad grol dbu mar bzhagaḥ sam māḥ sbyor ba skyabs se /sa niḥhrīX ma bcos rig pa stong gsal 'dus ma byasaḥ lhag mthong rang ngo rig pas skyabs su mchiḥ tha snyad sems kyi 'khrul snang rab rib 'diḥ ka dag gzhil sangs phyir sems bskyed doḥ dngos gzha lha yi bskyed rim niḥ āḥ ngang nyid stong pa rdo rje btsun mo'i mkharaḥ brda don rtags rdzogs ye shes gzhal med dbusaḥ chags pa'i rdul bralapad nyi bdud bzhi'i khar rig pa rang grol bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pad+ma rā ga'i zhal can 'dzum mdzes sgegs zhal gsum phyag drug ye shes mtshon cha 'dzinaX skye bzhi dbyingasasgrol zhabs rnams 'dor stabs bsgradaḥ rus rgyan dar chas he ru ka dpal tshul ༷ gsang ba ye shes gri thod 'dzin dang rol thugs gar mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u'i klong dkyil

'khor gtso brgyad yab yum sprul 'khor bcas ma 'dres rang gsal rig pas rgyan rdzogs sharaḥ stong gsal 'dzin med ye shes snying por blta dgongs pa mi 'gyur lta ba'igazer chen gdabaḥ rang gsal 'gags med bde stong 'dzab rgyun skyongasaX gang shar rang grol kun bzang chos sku'i klong thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes zang thal sgrubasaX oṃ yisahūṃ trīḥbadz+ra gu dza dhe wa dhā ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā ma bcos rig pa ther la phud stong gsal 'dzin pa bral ba yisaḥ rgyal kun ye shes gcig tu sgrubs don dam rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma yuḥ rjes rimamachod cing bstod pa niḥ hūṃ trī ༷ bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rā ga'i zhalaX dbyings phyugs gsang ba ye shes 'dzum la rolaḥ zung 'jug gar las ye shes klong dgu 'gyedaX gtso 'khor sprulapa ra bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod snang ba mi dgags dag mnyam lam du khyer sgyu lus 'od gsal phyag rgya'i nye lam brten dran rig spros bral chos sku rjen par bzhagaX lhanaskyes sku gsum 'bras su mngon du bya de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshang bas sgrub pa zab mo nyams su len phya nang bar chad bdud las rgyal don gnyas lhun grub gdon mi zaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma

sgo māḥ e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor zab gsang rdor snying man ngag bcud 'brog ban lo tsa'i bgo skal gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstims bkra shis rdzong der gtad rgya sdoms rten(byedro dus la bab pa'i tshe nga sprul las can gcig gis rnyed 'gro don phrin las byang phyogs rgyas 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig sbu gri gsumaḥ dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhigaḥ sam yuḥ rgya rgya rgyartsa sgrub ye shes snying po rdzogs so gter rgyaḥ gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu rgyaḥ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim snyiḥ zhesapa 'di'ang tshogs smon lasa'aphros bskul ba rig grol rgya mtsho'i bkra shis dge ba'i skye du ma dang mtshal shog snag gsum bcas bskul ngor/ sbasapa'i rnal 'byor nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis dbyingasasnang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa nilung zin mi tri'i bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma lamaḥ

ma dran rdzogs gzhug ma'i lha gsal ba urnam kun mcheg ldan ches sku' slongaḥspro bsdu' rgyal po ga ga ma' zhalaX sred pa rdo rje kā la ya ༷ma bskyed reg pas 'khrulabye je bcom ༷ye ོgas klong yangs rig tsam grol 'gro 'ong 'brul rtog dab bskur bcomaḥzhe sdang rdo rjes ma rig bsgral sems kyi chos kun gnyug mar sangasaḥs ma wā rjesadran rig ngar glu bstod ni hū hrīḥng bdagamatshan 'dzin rū tra'i gshedaḥkhros pa'i gar gyis 'khor ba rlogasaX gdod ma'i rgyal sar mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥgazhir bzhengs rdo rje srin por bstodaḥyod steng bsog 'dod nus lngan sa kun rtog snon pa spel tsam bris sarba maṅga lam/

shārwa zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gsol bdebs byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs bzhugasaX—13 ——1snga3313 khyed shes dad pa drag po yis bla ma' lha tshogs gsal gdab teḥ kha tsam min par snying khung nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya e ma nyo gdod ma gzhi yi bla makun tu bzangaX bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas snang mtha' yas ye shes gzigs tshul ma 'gags pad 'byung laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud rtogs pa spor rgyud sde'idakyil 'khor kun gtso dgongs pa 'dus sgrub sde phyi 'dus rta phag rol ba rtsal rtsa gsum kun dngos he ru kā dpal la0 gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabasartsolaḥ gsang ba ye shes ma dwa ra ba'i zhalaḥ bde chen rgyal mtsho rgyal ba bskyed pa'i dbyingasaḥ lha tshogs yongs 'dus nyes brgya nyer lnga laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dbangabyin rtsolaX rdo rje'i bka' 'khor dpa' bo dpa' mo'i ging las mdzad 'bar ba brag btsan mched bdun laḥ zab gsang dpal 'dzin sha za kha mo cheraḥ gsol ba 'debs so

phren las rab 'byams sgrub snang zhen dre ma gnas lugs rang sar dgaX rgyu lus 'od gsal dwangs ma'i lha ru smin ma brtsal sku dang ye shes rol bar rdzogs nang dbyings heru ka dpal mngon gyur regagaX de ltar gsol btab byin rlabasa'ajug dngos grub nyam rtogs mkhal ltar rgyasaḥ sam yuḥ e maḥ rang byung ston pa pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i sgod ldan jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal laḥ sa 'og gter gyi snyingazhu dgongs pa 'dus rgyal tshabs sprul ba' bgo skal rnam pa gsum kun kyi yang zhun bla ma'i sgrub skor nyidaḥ sangs rgyas glang pas bgo skal ya mtshan med cha lags las phran bod sngags 'brog lor sprul yi dam dgongs 'dusad dung sa yi bcud rten 'brel dus la bab tshad yongs su gsal mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dusaganam lcags me 'bar bcud phran tsam ye shes mdzod rgyal sprul pas rted bka' 'di bab so chos bdag bcu drug 'byung bar chadabadud dang dam sri' ma bkags na bstan pa rin chen phyogs nasaphyogs su rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma' bka' nyes can lag tu ma shor sbu gri gsumaḥ skal ldan zugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gsola'adebs byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ gu h+ye bdo thimaḥdziḥ zhes pa'ang rnal 'byor mthu dpal

/rdo ༷ dang btsa pa dz+nyā nasama' can nye gnasamun sel mthar phyin zung dang sngag skyes kun bzang rnams kyis bskur ngor mi ldog tsam du kho bo nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'idro( 11da la bsgyur ba'o dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅga lam/
—14 zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rtsa sgrubs dpa' bo lha gcig lus dkyil lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu spros med bzhugs soḥ

——1) na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye: ཿ/rtsesgogyismosko rang byung lhun grub pad+ma saṃ bha waḥ mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du rol tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzoms pas skal ldan la zab gsangagand gyi man ngag zab mo bstan sa ma yā phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya gnad du bsdamaḥ bde stong ye shes dkyil 'khor gsum ldan skyongs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshangs ba'i rnal 'byor bsgomaḥ dang po skyabs su 'gro zhing semasabaskyed ni na mo bde gshegs yongs 'dus rang rig byang chub sems lhun grub 'dus ma byas la skyabs su mchiḥ med la yod par bzung ba'i 'khrul snang 'di: chos nyid sgyumar bsgral phyir sems bskyed do bka' bsgo naḥ trīX ye nas sgrib med chos sku nyag gcig laḥ ma rig dbang gi rnams rtog glo bur byungaḥ 'khrul ba rang rgyud gol ba'i gnyis 'dzinagadonaḥ don dam mtha' bral bdag med dbyings su bskrad srung gur niḥ gdod nas mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi klong: ma skyes mi 'gags rdo rje'i rang bzhin laX nga bdagamatshan ma'i gdon gyi glag mi rted deng 'dir rang byung ye shes rā gur 'dzinaX byin 'bebs ni trī sgrib gol mi mnga' chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥ ye shes gzigs pa bla ma

shāshā dgongs 'dus dal don dam nyed du gnyes su mi dmigs kyang skal ldan mas rngar gzugs sku'e byen dbang phobaX mchod pa byin mas ni sde rang snang ches rgerno rmi spang rgyan du che: rig pa ye shes gzi byin rgya yi gdab 'khor 'das ro mnyam sku gsum dkyil 'bor laX khams gsum yongs sgrol ro mnyam mchod sprin gtams deni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'oḥganyis pa la ting 'dzan rnam gsum niḥhrīḥ chosasku mkha' khyab de bzhin nyid kyi klong longs sku kun snang 'od gsal mnyam par brdalaḥ sprul sku phrin las gzhan donahrī yig sharaḥ skye 'chi bar do'i snang ba dbyings su sbyangasaX lha bskyed niḥ trīḥ 'byung ba rang dag yum chen lnga yi klong lhun grub 'od gsal gzhal med khang chen poḥ sgo gru rta babagadug tog mtshan rdzogs dbus sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla bzhad pa'i khar: rtog bral bo ro bsnol ba'i khri yi steng: rig pa hrī bab spro bsdus zhu ba lasaX bdag snang dkyil 'khorakun gtso dgongs pa 'dus dmar gsal rā ga'i mdangs 'bar gzi byin 'gyuraḥ g.yas mthi g.yon dkar zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshan dang dpe

byad 'baraḥ g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri bum pa dang g.yon rnams dril bu bhan thod kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnamasaḥ zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhengasaḥ dur khrod dpalachas dpa' ba'i rtags su klubaḥ gsang ba ye shes dmar gsal 'khril sbyor rolaX dpa' bo bskul ba'i thod rnga bhan dmar stobasaḥ sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan1ngaḥ thod phreng sde lnga gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs thabs shes zung 'jug byang chub sems kyi dalaX nyes brgya lnga bcu ma 'dres lam mer gsalaX bde dang stong pa'i ye shes yonatan 'baraḥ rdo rje'i sa bon srog gi yig ge las spros pa'i 'od kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas rtsa gsum dam can dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rnga yab gling nas pad 'byungagatso dang 'khoraX phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnams pa dza/ sbyan drang dbyer med mnyams pa nyid du bsreḥ spyana'adren ni trīḥ nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rang byung dkyil 'khor nas phyo gsum yongs 'dus bla ma he ru gaX dgongs 'dus gtso 'khor sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin rlobs dbang bskur zhigaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs

'o/ gsol niḥ hrīḥ ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i kharaḥ rig kun yongs 'dus gtso mchog he ru gaḥ dam ye zung 'jug mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs rtogs pamajerdo gyur g.yo med brtan par mdzod: sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ phyaga'atshal ba niḥ na moḥ kun khyababla ma ye shes chos kyi skuX kun mkhyen bla ma lhun grub longs spyod rdzogasaX kun gzigs blam thugs rje sprul pa'i skuḥ kun 'dus rang rig rjen par phyag bgyi'o na mo dṛ hoḥ mchoda'abul niḥhrīX chos nyid nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings mdzod lasaḥ sna tshogs snang ba mchodapa'i sprin du shar rdo je lha mo mdzes pa'i gar dang bcas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bulaX badz+ra pu ja sa ma ya hoḥ bstod pa ni hrī mngar gyi ma gos pad+ma'isbubs las byonaḥ rus rigs las 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamaX pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i lha la bstod chos dbyingasabazang mo gsang ba ye shes dbyings rgyu lam 'bras bu bde ba'i chos char 'bebs sa gnas don gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtsoX ma dha ra ba dgyes sde'i mchog la bstod dug

lnga tshogs yul phung po 'byung ba'i khamasaḥ kun rtogs rang grol bde chen mnyam pa'i 1nga rta phag zung 'jug mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor lasaḥ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs nyes brgya nyer lngar bstod brgyud pa drug ldan bla ma yongs 'dus zhalaḥ dkyil 'khor kun gtso dbang phyug he ru ka bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rje dgongs pa 'dus pa 'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstodaX bgagasapa na ཿ trīḥ risachad blo yi bcos pa'i gol sgrib dngaḥ bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gsang sgog byin ma thebaḥ bag med 'khrul ba'i rjes 'brang don la g.yelaḥ thams cad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshagasaḥ sa ma ya ā 'dzab niḥ shāḥ rang snang bla ma dgongs 'dus gsal ba yiX thugs klong pad zla nyi steng ye shes sems rta mgrin dmar gsal tshon gang dpa' chas klubasaX gri gug thod 'dzin dbu gtsug rta zhal mdzes rdo rje phag mo yum dang 'khril sbyor rol bde ba'i 'od kyi 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bskul thugs gar nyi steng rdo rje nas 'bru tsamaḥ lte bar dbyangs gsal ga'u kha spyor sngabasaḥ rig pa trīḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bsgor

shā bzlas pa'i rgyu las mtshan ma rang grol teḥ thams cad dag mnyam dgongs pas 'dzab rgyun skyongaḥ yo bstsa gu ru bṛ pad+ma badz+ra trī dhu ma gha ye dh+wa ki nī na ma swārte rdogongasapa de bzhin nyid la gnas spro bsdu'i 'od zer 'dzab rgyun skyongs snang grags rigs gsum lha ru blta' bde chen ye shes gza byan bskyedaḥ sa ma yāḥ sgrub 'dzab niḥ hrīḥ bdag thugs sngags phreng lu gurgyud du byung yum gyi zhal zhugs sku yi dbyings brgyud nas pad+mo nas byung gsang ba'i rdo rjer brgyud thugs srog hrīḥl bstim te gzi byin 'bar bde stong dga' gzhi'i ye shesamangon gyur ngang byas yi hūṃ hrīḥ badz+ra gu 〈co dhe wa snyeki ni sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ yengs med rlung gi rta byas te 'bar ba'i bzhus nas dga' ba bzhi bcu drug phyed phyed thig le yis spang dang rtogs pa'i yon lngasngangaḥ sa ma yuḥ las 'dzab niḥ trīḥ bdag srog 'od kyi rtsa gnas lha tshogs bskulaḥ kun kyang bde stong zung 'jug 'dzab rgyun skyongasaX rlung sems rgyu las mtshan ma rang grol te do na dam mtha' bral dbu ma'i klong du sad gnyis snang mtshan ma rang sar zhi zhing stongaḥ tshe dpal bsod nams nyams rtogs yon tan rgyasaḥ mos bzhi dbang 'dus dgra

bgegs rdul brlag zhingaX rab 'byams phrin las lhun gyi grub par dmigs sa yisahūṃ hrī badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rnye wa bzhi niḥ sto dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha badz+ra ma hā kro dha sha ti ga trī ma hāre ni sa ra tsa hrī yaX sarba sirnyi kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na sa twa a mi dhe wa ma ma tsit+ta saṃ bha wa adhiṣ+ṭha rnaḥ ma ma a yudz+nyā na sirnyi pha la hūṃ swā hā las sngags ti 'dzin dgongs pa 'i bskyar rangabyung ye shes ngang la gnas byan gyas brlab pa'i dgongs pa yis rnam bzhis phrin las thog med 'grubaḥ sa ma yuḥ de dag dngos gzhi'i ram pa'o gsum pa la tshogs byan rlabs ni ma dwa na dang ma sa sogs bza' bca' btungabar 'os pa'i rigs dum gcag snod du bsagasabyas te ting 'dzan dgong pa'i byin dbab ni ho bde chen snod mchog ka pa la yi nangaḥ sha chang bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams kunaḥ zag sted ye shes bdud rtsir sbyangs bsgyur spelaX ro mnyam rdo rje'i tshogs ston bla na med ram̐ ye khaṃ o unyu spyan 'dren ni trīX rgya mtsho'i gling dbus mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs rtse ngak+ta thod phreng yi dam kun dngos dpalaḥ pad+ma 'od klong bla ma dgongs pa 'dus dga' ston tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyi bro gar lhag lag

'o/ bcas: dpa' mo rnams kye glu dbyangs sangs sangs gyeraḥ geng dang leng gas bstod sngags rol mo 'drel rtsa gsum rgya mtsho ye shes tshogs la rol mgubye bye dhe wa dh+wa ki ni sarba sa ma ya hrīng dza dza rgas phud naḥnyo rig stong lhan skyes lha mo gar dang bcasaḥ ye shes mnyam pa'i tshogs ston mtha' yas spro don dam dbyings su 'bulabazhes gnyis med kyangaX gdul bya'i bsod nam rdzogs phyir mnyam par rolaḥ a la la ho sa ma ya tswaḥ bar ba bshags pa ni nye sgrib bo la mi mnga' kun mkhyen ye shes zhal: rgyugasum rkyen bzhi'i lkog gyur nongs dbang gis: sdom gsum ris chad blo yi dri ma kunaX 'da' nyams las 'das zang thal chos skur bshags sa ma ya āḥ tshogs bsgral ni / dza 'khrul gzhi bdag tu 'dzin pas rtog pa dngaḥ 'khrul snang kun bdag rgyu ba sna tshogs pa shes rab stong pa'i mtshan ma'i sgog 'phrog phyiraX ye shes dbyings su khams gsuma'akhor ba bsgralaḥ rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ bstabs pa ni hū hūḥ nye ru ka dpal bde ba mchog gi 1nga: gnyis snang rang sar bcom pa'i mtshan ma rdzasaX chos nyid la yang thim pa'i

tshul du 'bul 'khrul snang srid gsum ka nas dag par mdzodaḥ mo sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha hiḥ lhagam niḥ phe: stong pa chos nyid dbyings su srog cig kyangaḥ rnam rol du ma'i gar ngomabastan pa skyong: rnal 'byor rlung sems dbyings rol rtog pa spelaḥ bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgring lta log ru tra 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod skyongasaḥ sngon nasagayar dam pham phab lhag mas bdagaḥ 'dir byon dpal chen rol pa'i bka' lung ltar tshogs ston rol la sgrub pa'i drod tshad skyongasaḥ rnams bzhis phrin las bcol la mgayel zhig ma ma hrīng bā lirnya kha kha kha twe khā hiḥ bskul pa niḥ bye dkyil 'khor gco mchog bla ma dgongs pa 'dusaḥ ye shes rol pa'i phyag rgya da bzhengs laX 'khrul gzhi gdodanas dag pa'i nang dbyings suḥ gzung 'dzin tha snyad rgyu ba rang grol te/ bdud bzhi'i sgog 'phrog dgra gsum tshar bcad de g.yang sa drug bcom sku gsum bla ma'i saraḥ 'khrulapa ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod ༷ mtho ni —3 rgyal b.lidabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was0 'og min lha gnas rgya bal bod yul duḥ gsang sngags nang rgyud chos 'khor bskor ba'i

sgo tshe dregs pa rgya mtsho'i srog 'phrog gnad la dbab bran du bkol nas sngags kyi gnyer byang gtad bstan pa rted dang bkur sti zhabs tog bcas /je don brin las rgya cher rgyun ring bor: spel zhing skyongs bar zhal bzhes dam mnos ltaraḥ tha tshig bsgrag go 'dir byon chad tho bzhesaḥ rnal 'byor thugs mthun bzhed donakun spel la don gnyis lhun gyi 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ bstan ma niḥ bh+yo lhun grub rig 'dzin pad+ma rgyal po yisaḥ zhabs pad spyi bor len pa'i bka' rtags can bdaganyid ma bzhi gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi: sman phran spun bzhi rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas lhab lhub rgyan bcas dril rta bkol bzhin duḥ phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i gral mthar datshur 'dus: bshal chu'i skyems dang bā ling brngan mchod bzhes nad mug mtshon 'khrugs rgud pa mtha' dag dngaḥ mtha' mi dmags tshogs du ru ṣa yi sde 'jigs dang sdugabasngal mi 'dod phyogs rnams kunaX skye med dbyings su zhi zhing stong pa dngaX phyogs las rnam rgyal tshe dpal rnam rtogs sgo yar ngo zla ltar gong nas gong 'phel zhing dam tshig

sdom pa mel rtses srung byas teḥ legs na gzeng bstod nyes na chad pas gziraX so kha srung ba'i phrin las ma g.yel zhigaX ma ma sring 'gro ma e ṭ+wāṃ bha lirnyi kha kha khā twe khā hiḥ rtabroni e nam mkha' rnam dag stong pa'i sgrom rgya rtsa gnyis snang bdud bzhi dam sri brub pa la dbang chen rta phag ma mo'i bro brdung ngoḥ ma ldang ldang med ru tra dbyings su 'thar o sa/ swā hā ma ra ya nanaḥ dngos grub niḥ trīḥ phyogs ras mi dmigs bde chen slong yang nas dkyil 'khor kun gtso bla ma dgongs pa 'dusaḥ dgongs pa'i bsgrub cing ting 'dzinagazer gyis bsnyenaḥ yan lag rnams bzhi spyod pa mthar phyin pas dngos grub rgya mtsho thugs kyi klong nas rtsolaḥ phyag rgya chen po'i sa la nye ba nyidaḥ sku gsum btsan sa zin paramadzad du gsol rtsasngags mtharaḥ sirnyiphal a la la ho bzod gsol ni sa phyogs ris midamigs ye shes thugs rje'i klong ༷ nye rang mi mnga' kun la snyoms brdal bas ༷ tha snyadardul skyon sems kyi dri ma kun rmi lam rang bzhin med snyams stong par bshagasaX a u bsngo smon niḥ ho 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs kunaX 'khor gsum yongs

sgo dag chen por bsngo bar bgyiX tha snyad sgyu ma'i rol mo rabs dag te: nang dbyengs sku gsum rol par sad gyur tsagaḥ lan gsum bsdu ldang ni sa sna tshogs gazlorges sku'i bkod pa rab bsdus te don dam mtha' bral chos sku'i 1nga du shā slar yang 'gas med gzigs pa'i brin las su snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam khyeraḥ phaṭa phuṭaḥ shisabarjod ni na mo kun gzhi phra rag dbyings su nub pa laX 'khor 'das thams cad dwangs ma'i 'khor lo sadaḥ sku gsum ye shes 'phrin las mtha' yas pas: ganga'ado/la mdzad pa bsam pa'i bkra shis regagaḥ de ni rjes kyis rim pa'oḥ sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was snod ldan bzung ma ye shes mtsho rgyal laḥ sa 'og gter gyi snying khu dgongs pa 'dus bka'atshes phyag rgyas btab nas gces nor brtsal ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga yi dus skabs su nga ya rgyal tshab pad+ma'i rig can la mdo khams rtse shod gshams nas dgongs pra thobaḥ waka gi ming can rtogs pa'i lta ba mthoḥ sa ras ming can rgyu'abras spyod lam zhib ṅgā las mang can snying rje'i myu gu 'byungasaḥ pra tshwa'i mtshan can shes rab dpal dang ldan rten 'brel dbang gi dus su phun tshogs 'byor 'gro don phrin las mkha' ltar rgya cher 'byung shin tu zab cing gsang ba'i

te ka 'de dam nyams lag tu ma shor sbu gri gsum skal ldan thugasakyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rtsa sgrub thugs kyi nyams len rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgyaḥ o rgyanaslob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhesapa'ang bla ma mthu dpal dang dz+nyā na'i mtshan can zung dang dad ldan mun sel mthar phyin rnams kyis bskul ba dang sngags skyes kunabazang nas kyang bzhed pa don dang ldan phyir kho bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba maṅka lam

tsha la zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥbla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bskang bsdus dri med shel phreng bzhugasaḥsgo na mo /da bye pad+ma ka ra yeḥ ༅༅6)1 chang snod bcud dpa la 'byar yod byad kun ya shes tshogs su dang blang nas rgyal ba'i dgyes pa rab bskang te rnal 'byor chags nyams sorabazlo khrur hūṃ hrīḥm bcos gdod ma'i gzhi ru sangs rgyas paḥchos sku kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥchags bral pad+ma 'bum sprin 'byil dbang phyug longs sku 'odamatha' yas gang 'dul 'phrul mtshan bye ba phrag sa yaḥsprul sku pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskangaX bde ba mchog sbyin stong pa'i dbyings la rol bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pas rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings nyid phyag rgyar rol gsang ye man dha ra ba'i dbang gi rdo rje rjes chags dpa' rtag canaXrta mgrin khams gsum bde rol srid pa ma skyes gzhiru mngon rol ba'i gtum rngam za byed phag mo'i gti mug ngo bo ma spang rang grol sku chos dbyings rdo rje yab yum zhe sdang rang grol dri bral dwangs ma'i skuX me long rdo rje yab

yum thugs dam bskangasaḥ nga rgyal ro mnyam mtshan ma'i gdos dang bral mnyam pa'i rdo rje yab yum 'dod chags 'phrul ba mi gnas stong pa'i ngangaḥ sor rtogs rdo rje yabayum phrag dog rtsad gcod byang chub sems rol ba nan tan rdo rje yab yum ye shes gcig las rnam rol mtha' yas paḥ gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dmabaskangasaX chos nyid srog ldan chos can phyag rgyas bsgyur las mdzad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i stong par dag bsgyur dgra srog 'phrog mthu thobaḥ brag btsan sha za bdudargyal dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bka' sdod pho nya baX las mdzad pho nya rnams gyis hūṃ hrī thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas niX gzung ba yul med phyi mchod sprin gyisabaskangasaḥ 'dzin pa rang grol nang mchod rgya mtshos bskang dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor dak+ta'i bskangaX dga' bzhi ro mnyam rig ma'i tshogs kyis bskangs: rkyen ngan lamasgong phyag rgya gar gyis bskangaX gzung 'dzin dbyings bsgyur sgrol ba'i mchod pa'i chos zad blo 'das don dam lta bas bska : gnyis med mnyam brdal ye shes rig pa'i

——3 spang blang gza' gtad bral ba spyod pa'i bskang 'bras bu lhun grub rdzogs pa chen por bskang bskang bya skong byed gnyis 'dzin bral bar bskangs: thamasacad mi dmigs 11sa dang bral bar ā de ltar bskang ba'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nyam rtog yon tan yar ngos zla ltar 'phel bsod nams thabs su shar ba'i 'jug ngog 'di las can skal ldan gcig dang 'phradapar shog bka' gsang thub par srung shig spu gri gsum snod man lag tu ma shor sha za moḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya bskang bsdus dri med sher phreng rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye o rgyan gyi slobadapon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkha' bzas bkod pa'o brda zimaḥ3)ཿ zhes pa'ang dam pa du ma'i gus bskul ngor/ kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'thul mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phelasarba ma lam/

ma tshogs la rol ba niḥ las kyi rdo rjesaḥhoḥ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsolaX chos sku mnyam pa'i rgyas gdab pas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i bzhes lhag 'di: thugs rje'i/rgongs te dgyes par rolaX blamasaḥ a la la ho bde ba che blang dor yid chos bral ba yisaḥ dngos grub dam pa shar ba'i skyes: mnyam pa nyid du rol bar bya: tshogs byang nas ho gsang sngagabashathabs kyi khyad par las myong bas grol ba dga' ston tshogs pañca a pra bcas sbyar baḥ chos khams zag pa zad phyir rol a la la hoḥ 'di yang nye bar mkho ba'iphyir nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge sarba ma lam/

77 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rtsa sgrub ye shes snying po bzhugs soḥge pa na mo gu ( 11d+mā ka ra ye za nagatog ma bcos rag pa thad gar bzhagaḥdagongs pa chos sku' gter sgo dbye sgo gsum bya ba ro snyoms gtong rlung sems thad grol dbu mar bag sam māḥsbyor ba skyabs sems naḥhrīḥm brtsos rig pa stong gsal 'dus ma byas:lhag mthong rang ngo rig pas skyabs su mchiḥtha snyad tsam gyi 'khrul snang rab rib 'diḥka dag gzhil sangs phyir sems bskyed doḥdangos gzhi lha ya bskyed ram na ungang nyid stong pa rdo rje btsun mo'i mkharaḥbarda don rtag rdzogs ye shes gzhal med dbus chags pa'i rdul bralapad nyi bdud bzhi'i kharaḥrig pa rang grol bla ma dgongs pa 'dus ༷pad+ma rā ga'i zhal can 'dzum mdzes sgegasaḥzhal gsum phyag drug ye shes mtshon cha 'dzin skye bzhi dbyingasasgrol zhabs rnams 'dor stabs bsgrad rus rgyan dar chas he ru ka dpal tshulaXgasang ba ye shes gri thod 'dzin dang rolaX thugs gar mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u'i klongaX dkyil

'khor gtso brgyad yab yum sprul 'khor bcasaX ma 'dres rang gsal rig pas rgyan rdzogs sharaḥ stong gsal 'dzin med ye shes snying por bltaḥ dgongs pa mi 'gyur lta ba'igazer chen gdabaX rang gsal 'gags med bde stong 'dzab rgyun skyongasaḥ gang shar rang grol kun bzang chos sku'i klong thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes zang thal bsgrub0 oṃ ā hūṃ hrī badz+ra gu dzag dhe wa dhā ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āX ma bcos rig pa zer la phud sto gsal 'dzan pa bral ba yis rgyal kun ye shes gcig tu sgrub don dam rtog pa mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma yāḥ rjes rim mchodaceng bstod pa niḥ ( hrīḥ bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rā ga'i zhalaḥ dbyings phyugs gsang ba ye shes 'dzum la rolaX zung 'jug gar las ye shes klong dgu 'gyedaḥ gtso 'khor sprul parabacas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ snang ba mi 'gags dag mnyam lam du khyer sgyu lus 'od gsal phyag rgya'i nye lam brtenaḥ dran rig spros bral chos sku rjen par bzhagaḥ lhan skyesasku gsum 'bras bu mngon du bya: de ltar spyor dngos rjes tshang bas sgrub pa zab mo nyams su len phyi nang gsang ba' bar chad rgyal don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za bden rdzun lag tu lo da gsal sa ma rwa e ma

ba 'debasaḥ badz+ra he ru ka yi dgongs dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal gnyen dang: hūṃ chen ka ra'i bar du byin rlabs teḥ 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyiḥ thugs kyisabargyud pa'i bla ma la gsol 'debasaḥ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debasaX che mchog he ru ka yi dgongs pa yiX sprul ba'i mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin mang po dang mi 'gyur nam mkha'i bar du byin rlabs te ༷ 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyiḥ yon tan brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol 'debasaḥ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debasaX dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nus dgongs pa yisaX lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin dngaX rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la byin rlabs te 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyiX phrin las brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol 'debasaX o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs mngon rdzogs rgyal po che mchog he ru gaX ma rgyud lha mo yongs 'byud bde ma dang dha na saṃ skṛ'i bar du byin rlabs teḥ 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi srid pa ma brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol 'debasaḥ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la

'khrul ba'i las la 'khor yug spyodaḥ chags sdang chos brgyad g.yang ba'i rtag par bslusaḥ da ne ma 'khrul sgo gsum dge la 'bod skye rga na 'che nam 'ong cha me chodaḥ skad cegatsam yang rtag pa'i go skabs med dga' ba'i grogs dang bral la skabs re nyeX gcig pur bar dor 'khyams la thug srid pa'iX bar do drug las g.yang sar mi 'chor phyir rtsegacig 'dun pa dkon mchog gsum la gtodaḥ yid ches re ltos bla ma'i bka' ltar sgrubasaḥ ma yengs gdams ngag zab mo snying la 'chongasaḥ gtan du thar ba'i 'dun pa yangadag skyongs khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas la chags zhen spongasaX ma 'khrul ma yengs skal ldan sems kyi bu zhes gsungs pa'i mod la 'jig rten skye gnas kyi bar do 'di la yun du sdod khomasasted par skyo ba bskyed nas blo sna nang du bstung ste dge ba' bshes gnyen gyis bka' bzhin zos bsam kyi sgro 'dogs chod nges par byas te zab mo' don nyams su len pa la yid gnyis the tshom ma dgos par the bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bukhrung ba'i slad du bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ma kye shud bdag 'dres sems can rnamasaḥ ma rig 'khrul ba'i lam las bzlog pa'i phyir mi baspu nges pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang mdun gyi

sgong nam mkhar rtse gcig gsal gdab teḥ kha tsam ma yen snyeng khung rus gtang nasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzegs0 lam log lamarge) srid pa'i grong khyer las da lta nyid du thar bar mdzad du gsol0 gzung 'dzin srid pa'i drwa ba dam po lasaḥ skad cig nyid la grol bar mdzad du gsol ༷ chags sdang nyeralen rtog sgrib smag rum lasaX myur ba nyid du sangs par byin gyis rlobs0 zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab pa 'i tshe dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma'i zhal nas ngo sprod 'di ltar gdams par mos lakye ma kye hud skal ldan rigs kyi buḥ khyod la skye gnas bar do 'char dus 'dir tshe la long med 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyabaḥ 'jig rten 'du 'dzi le lo spangs byas nasaḥ thosabasam bsgom la rtse gcig 'jug par byosaX mi lus lan gcig thob pa'i dus skabs 'diraḥ yeng ma lam la sdod pa'i dus tshod min snang sems lam slong sku gsum mngonashākyar mdza/daḥ ces gsu sa tshe yar mar gyi sa mtshams rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba'i dus lta bu 'dir 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas las thar zhing gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa 'a sa sa rgyas kyi go sa la snyogs pa'i thabs la brtson par bya'o

na migs brad sogs gzhung ltar du shes pa ra byaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya 'jig rten nyin mos snang ba rim gyi nub te kun gzhi'i dbyings su brdal ba nas cung zad rlung gis bgul bskyod kyis gsal snang cung zad byung tshe rmi lam 'khrul ba'ibar do bzang ngan bar gsum gyis baglu dbang du mi 'chor bar chu bo'i rgyun lta bu'i nyams len 'byung phyir rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid ma 'dres bkra lam mer byon par bsam la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ma kye hud bdag 'dra'i 'a17 brnams rmi lam 'khrul ba'i lam las bzlog pa'i phyiraḥ thugs rje can nyid bla ma rdo rje 'chang skad cig nyid la ye shes gzigs pas dgongs: nyin 'khrul mtshan 'khrul rmi lamagayul ngo las skad cig nyid du mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzodaX bag chags 'khrul ba'i nyams kyis mi bskyod par rang snang bden med rang ngo shes par shogaḥ ma rig 'dilas bla mas bsgral du gsol gti mug gnyid las thugs rjes bskyab du gsolaX bag chags 'khrul snang 11la bar byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol ba btab tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid zhal 'dzumabartse ba'i rnams 'byur dang ldan pa'i ngang nas byon cing ngo sprod 'di ltar gdab par bsam kye ma kye spyod skal ldan rigs kyi buḥ khyod la rmi lam bar do 'char dus 'dir gti mug ro nyal bag med

shā mi byed paraX yengs med dran pas gnas lugs ngang la zhugasaḥ rme lam bzung nas sprul bsgyur 'od gsal sbyangasaḥ gnyed dang mngon sum 'dres pa 'erte113 len skyongasaḥ dud 'gro bzhin tu nyal bar ma byed cigaḥ ces gdams tshe rma lam 'byul ba'i snang ba bzang ngan bar gsum gang gis yang brdzi mi zhugs par sprul bsgyur 'od gsal kho nar sbyang bar bya'oḥ rgyasapar dmigs rim khrid gzhung ltar du shesaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya 'jag rten gyi bya ba che chung thams cad la zhen pa spangs te rig pa rang thog tu sa bzung nas dran shes kyis grog byas te bsam gtan kyis ngang la pheb tshe dwa phrug ma dnga'aphrad pa lta bu'i nyams len 'byung phyir bla ma nyad ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can dwangs ma'i zhal phyag rgyan chas rdzogs pa dang mjal tshe gsol ba 'di ltar gdab kye ma kye sdod bdag 'dra'i sems can rnams0 gnas nyamasabasam gtan had por 'khyol ba naḥ ye shes gzigs ldan bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ 'du 'bral med par brtse ba'i rjes su zung: bde ba'i nyams las mtshan 'dzin grol bar shog gsal ba'i rang bzhin zhen chags dben par mdzodaḥ mi rtog nyams las rang grol rjen par skyolaḥ 'khrul ba'i gshis nyams gol sa rang grol nas phyogs 'dzin bsam

gtan spre sa pa rang zhig nas dpal mabo na bla ma nyid dang dbyer med regagaḥ ces gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab tshe skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma nyid thugs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa'i zhal bzang ngomasabazhin tu ngo sprod 'di ltar gnang bar bsam kye ma kye spyod skal ldan rigs kyi buḥ khyod la bsam gtan bar do 'char dus 'dir rnam g.yeng 'khrul rtog rjes su mi 'brang b.raḥ yengasasted 'dzin med mtha' bral ngang la zhogaḥ bskyed dang rdzogs rim blo bral de kho naḥ bya ba spangs nas sgom pa'i dus tshod 'diraḥ chags sdang nyon mongs re dogs nyer len sogs gang gis dbang du ma gtong btsan sa zungs: zhes gdab tshe tshe 'di'i gdu thag dang bsam gtan nyams zhen gyi dri ma gang gis dbang du mi 'chor bar lhag mthong bdag med chen po' nga nga la btsan sa zin par bya'o na mags khrid rgyas par gzhung las shesaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya tshe yi 'du byed kyi bkod pa rim bzhan zad de sman dpyod rtsis bon sogs kyi bsgyur du mi btub pa ra ces kyang 'chi ba'i dus la bab tshe rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin lta bu'i man ga 'byung phyir rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid spyi gtsug gi nam mkhar byon nas mngon sum du bzhugs yod par gsal la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ma kye spyod bdag 'dra'i 'a11 ba rnamasaḥ mi rtag 'chi ba'i

shāshā 'jegs las skyobs pa'e phyeraḥ 'aka' dren mtshungs med bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ ye shes gzegs pas dad ldan bdag la dargangasaX rang snang nya 'phrol btsu ba 'ayus (nga ngoms: mi rtag sgyu lus rang mdangs mngon bstan nas skyes chen bar do'i 'phrang la 'grims dus 'diraḥ bzod med sdug bsngal tshor ba'i sgo 'gags sogs ༷ nyonamongs 'a spyol ba'i g.yul las skyabs su gsolaḥ bag chags 'chi ba'i 'jigs las dbugs dbyung zhingaḥ dpa la mgon bla ma khyed dang dbyer med regagaḥ ces gsol ba btab tshe skyabasaganas kun 'dus kya ngo bo bla ma nyid zugs brtse' rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa 'i ngang nas ro sprod 'di ltar gdab par bsam kye ma kye shud skal ldan rigs kyi buX khyod la 'chi kha bar do 'char dus 'diraḥ 'disnang chos la chags sems zhen 'dzan spongs gdams ngag zab mo'i don la yengs med 'jugaḥ rang rig skye med nam mkha' lta bu'i klongaḥ dran bsam rtog pas ma bslad dbyeramed 'phoḥ 'dus byas sha khrag lus sems bral la khad thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin ngo shes shingaḥ re dogs spros pa chod la ro snyoms zhog ces gdams tshe 'jag rten tshe 'di'i gdung

thag dang phyi ma'i 'jigs sgrags thams cad gang la'ang mi sems par thams cad stoms su bzhag la 'chi srid ka dag chos sku'i dgongs pa la mnyams par bzhag go dmigs khrid rgyas pa ra gzhung las shes sa ma wā rgya rgya rgyaḥ 'cha ba ka dag chos sku'i bar do ru grol ma nus na chos nyid bar do zim lugs brgyad kyas snang ba thams cad shar tshe re dwogs nyer len gyi spros pas mi 'ching bar ma pa nga bu 'jug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag 'byung phyir rtsa ba' bla ma rgyal kunayongs 'dus kyi ngo bo nyad ma 'dres bkra lam mer mngon sum 'byon par bsam la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ma kye shud bdag 'dra'i sems can rnams chos nyid bar do'i 'jigs las skyabs pa'i phyir skyabs gnasakun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang: mngon sum mos ngor gzigs pa legs bstan nas 'jigs rung khro bo'i tshogs kyi dpa' brjid dngaḥ hūṃ phaṭa sod rgyob nga ro sgrogasapa sogs mi bzod ya nga'i g.yengs sa chen po lasaḥ bka' drin mtshungs med bla mas bskyabs du gsolaX 'khrul snang rang grol rang ngo shes par re ga0 skad cig gdod ma'i btsan sa zin gyur cig ces gsol ba btab tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dgyes brtse'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa'i ngang nas byon cing brda thabs du ma' sgo nas ngo sprod 'di ltar gdab par bsam kye ma kye shud skal ldan rigs

sgo2 kye buX khyod la ches nyed bar do 'char dus 'deraḥ bar do'i snang ba bzang ngan gang shar yangaX sngangs skrags 'jegs snang thams cad spangs byas nas gangasharwa rang byung rig rtsal ngo shes shing bar do'i snang ba yin pas zhen pa spongasaḥ don chen 'gags la thug pa'i dus tshod 'diraḥ zhi khro'i la tshogs shar la ma 'jigs paraX 'odagasal 81ngas sku'i zhing la 'do/na pa ga31daX ces gdams tshe 'khrul snang la yengs 'khrul gyis rgyas ma 'debs 'od gsal sku da ye shes kyi 'khor lo la lo sa spyod bya'oḥ dmigs khrad rgyas par gzhung ltar byaḥ sa ma shārgya rgya rgyaḥ 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul gyi 'khor lo der ma grol na mngon shes phran bu dang rdzu 'phrul ya ma zungs legs nyes 'gro drug gi snang ba gang la'ang chen chags kyi spros pa'i rjes su ma 'brang bar sngon chad gdams ngag gi 'phro mthudanus pa yul ba rkang chad la wa 'dzug pa lta bu'i nyams len 'byung phyir bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyad ye shes rgyu ma' skur bzhengs te byon par mos la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ma kye spyod bdag 'dra'i 'gro ba rnams srid pa'igrong khyer bar do'i bde sdug sogs: mi 'dod tshor ba sna tshogs las zlog phyir srid na zla bral bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ ye shes gzigs pa mngon sum legs bstan nas ci byed

chad med gyur pa'i dus tshod 'diraX skyabs dang re sa gzhan na ma mchis pasaḥ las ngan bdag gzhan thugs rjes bzung du gsol ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo las bsgralanas: dal 'byer rin chen nor bu rnyed par 37ga: ces gsol ba btab tshe bla ma nyid dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pas byon cang ngo sprod 'di ltar du gdab par bsam kye ma kye shud skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la srid pa bar do 'char dus 'diraḥ 'dun pa rtse gcig sems la bzung byas nas sngon bsags bzang po'i 'phro la 'jugs byas teḥ mngal sgo bgags dang bsdams pal sogs nasaḥ dag snang snying rus kho nar 'bad byas te0 chags sdang spangs la bla ma yab yum sgomasaX lta sgoms spyod pa'i gnad la lhag ger 'jogaḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'igral rjes 'dun pa gtodaḥ ces gdams tshe na song gsum kyi snang ba dang mtho ris gnyis dang gling gsum kya snang ba la re chags mi byed par 'dzam gli chos kyi rgyal po 'i mnga' 'og dge ba'i blo ldan pho mo'i 'a la sbyor gyiganas lhag pa'i lha'i zhing khams dang yi dam gang yin gyi lta dgongs zab mo'i gdeng zin pa sa 'gro ba'i don la 'jug par bya'oḥ dmigs da rgyas par gzhung las shesaḥ sam yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ e ma tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzom pa yi

rār+sha) dad ldan pho po thams cad kun don med chos brgyad bya ba sbongs 'jig rten tshe 'di'i gdung thag chod mi rtag rgyud bskul gnad du bzungs rin chen gser gling phyin bzhin par stong log byas na shin/ tādz+nyār+shaḥ dgos nges dam pa'i lha chos de rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun par sgrubs mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag sems la rtse gcig dril bag med g.yeng bas baglus gyur na rang gis rang nyid bung b.ra'agyur de phyir dad brtson mos gus can drug khrid gdams pa zab mo 'di'i nyams len rtse gcig gzhol byas nas 'khor bar mi ldog gde sa thob mdzodaḥ sa ma rwa ཿ bka' 'di sngags bdag ral gcag mas rtag par mel rtsesrung skyobs mdzod dam nyams lag tu mi shor bar thugs sras rig 'dzan dpal du shogaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di' lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis lha regs rin chen g.yu byur sposashel sogs kyi skyes bcas nan tan chen po' bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gas ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni lung zin me dri'i mtshan can gyis bris padage'o/ dge'o dge'o legs so/ sarba masgo lam/

—11) na po badz+ra sa twa yaḥ chonartarna/—314 sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa canaḥkun mkhyen 'gro mgon thugs rjes gter rgyal ba'i sras mchog rdo rje sems dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshalaḥma'ongs snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams las nyon zug rngus rtag par mnar 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang grol phyir man ngag sgom khrid bstan par bya sa ma yuḥ de yang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la brten nas phyi nang gimachod tshogs rgyas par spros la dgyes pa bskangs: phyag dang bskor ba nan cher 'bad sbyi khrus 'gyod tshangs kyi bshags pa byas la dben par phyin la mya ngan gyi 'dug ltangasabyas te skyo lhang nge 'gro ba'i ngang nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsamaḥ ngag nas 'di skad smra zhing dran pa'i gsal gdab bcas te kye ma kye ma kye hud 'khor ba 'di ni sdugabasngal ba'o myang 'das ni bde ba'oX ces brjod cing bsam kye ma kye hud 'khor ba ni me'i 'ob lta buḥ srin mo'i klong dang 'dra baX dug sbrul gyi tshang 'dra baḥ spu gri'i so kha dngamatshungs rgyal po' khrims khang dang 'dra mtshungs shingaḥ khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdag bsngal ni bzod brlag med bde ba'i go skabs thang cig tsam yang med par rgya che la

bskyo gting zab paḥ dpang mtho la 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du rang dang sems can thams cad tshud par bsam la kun gyis mya ngan drag pos non pas 'o dod tse re re 'don gyin yod par bsam la ba ga nas: a tsa maḥ nged cag rnams ni 'jigs re che: sngon chad nas mnar: da skabs la thugaḥ da dung yang 'jigs par 'gyur nges pas re sdug ༷ nga re 'gyod ngas ci bya'o snyams pa'i dus su ra nyid kyi steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing phyag 'od zer gyis lcags kyu bsnams pa zhig thugs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'khyud bzhin byung nas bdag la 'di skad gsung bar mos: kyi maḥ 'khor bar skyid dben btson dong me yi 'ob 'di las brosaskabs da dus lan gcig yinaḥ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam mtha' yas bde ba'i go skabs skad cig ma mchis pasaX da ni khri mun gzeb las bde la snyogasaḥ zhes gsungs pa'i mod la 'khor ba la yid skro shes 'khrungs nas rang bde gcig pu ma yin par sems can thams cad la thar 'dod kyi snying rje drag pos zin nas bdag gis bsgral

bar bya'o snyams pa'i mod laḥ bla ma'i phyag gi lcags kyus bdag gi snying ka nas drangs te bde ba chen po'i gnas su yer gyi bsgral ma thag tu 'od zer gyi lcags kyu zhig bdag gilag tu byung nas: btson khang me dong du 'khod pa'i sems can gcig kyang ma lus par bsgral te bde ba la bkod pa'i 'dun pa bzhag nas snying rje yang yang bskyed pa dang 'khor ba la rgyun du blo sbyong ba ni gnad kyi dam pa'oḥ de'i 'khor ba las blo ldog nas dam pa'i chos la yid ches rted tshe 'di'i gdung thag chod nas sgo gsum dge ba la bskul nas mthar thug mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur roX de nas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la ma bsam na chos mi dran pas yang yang de don sto bzhag pa gal che bsaḥ de mang gnas 'bu srin dang grog sbur dud 'gro'i rigs mang du yod pa'i sar phyin laḥ lus gnad ni rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag byas la yid kyis 'di ltar bsam mo

—1rdo pa'i dus yin par shes shing: sems can thams cad grangs bsgrangs las 'das pa dang bcas pa 'di dag ngan song du 'khyams pa dag mthong ba la snying rerje snyams du yang yang bsam par byas la ngag nasaḥ kye ma ho kye ma mi lus rin chen thob pa da res tsam 'jig pa'i skyen mang 'tsho ba'i grogs ni nyungaX 'di la chos ma 'grub nabyes rnyed dka'aḥ ngan song gsum du skyes tshe ci zhig byaḥ zhes dran bskul gdab la bsgoms nam mkha'i gar khyab 'jig rten gyis phyur bur gtams pa'i sems can dmyal ba'isdug bsngal myong ba rnams ngu skad tsi ri ri yod pa dang yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bas cho nges ti ri ri yod pa dang: dud 'gro'i rigs bsam mtha' yas pa'i gcig lagacig za gnod sbyor brdeg brdung sogs mi bzod par cho nges dang skad ngan ti ri ri nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad 'gul shig shig du byed bzhin shin tu mang zhing rgya chebar bsgomaḥ de rnams kyi dkyil du brag ri mthon po gcig gi steng du bdag grogs med gcig pur mi lus thob nas der yod par bsnyamasaX de nas mar la ltang la khad byas tshe

ma pa laḥ a tsa ma dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro 'di dag gi nang nas bdag gcig pu'i mi lus thob pa ni da res tsam ste bsod nams bsags pa/thob dka' 'di don med stong log btang nas ma kai ngan song gsum myong tshe nga re 'jigasaḥ nga re phung: nga re sdugaḥ mi lus 'di yang yun thung mgyogs //zhan dag gi gral snyogs tshe kyi spyodaX a dziX kye maḥ 'jigs pa la ci bya snyams du ngag nas mya ngan gyi skad ngan lang wang 'di ltar brjodaḥ kye ma ho kye maḥlugs som ngan song skye 'gro'i mang lugs somasaX ma kir lhung ba'i mgyogs lugs soms rted dka' 'jigs par sla la somasaX a tsa ma na bas mchis cis mi bsgrubaX bsnyams nas smre sngags 'don gyin yod pa'i tshe rang nyid kyi steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid g.yas skyabs sbyin shā na nas 'di skad gsung bar mosaḥ kye maḥ dal rten rjed dka' thob pa da res tsamaḥ 'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i 'phrog nges steḥ myur bar ngan 'gro'i gan

—— khad da res 'di la don chen ma sgrub naḥ phyis su rted dka' sems can grangs la ltosaḥ rten 'dir brten nas sangs rgyas 'grub par gyis zhes gsungaba'i mod la bdag gi bsam pa la'angaX kye ma bdag kho nas thar pa tsam gyi ni ci bya sems can grangs mang ba 'di dag kyang mnyam du bsgral bar sangs rgyas pa zhig bya'o snyamasadu sems bskyed ma thag par bla ma'i thug ka nas 'od zer zhig bdag la reg pa'i mod la bdag bde ba can du sleb par mosaḥ yang bdag gi snying kha'i 'od zer dpag medasems can thams cad la reg pas gcig kyang ma lus par bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs bar bsam zhing sems can la snying rje drag tu bsgom btson 'grus drag pos snying rje dngadal 'byor rnyed dka' yang yang bsam nas tshe 'di'i zhen 'dzin gcod pa dang0 rten chud zos su mi gtong ba dngaX chos lam las phyar mi ldog par byang chub thob nges pa zhig labartson no de lta'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'ang mi rtag par 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das shingaX nam 'chi la cha med 'chi rkyen la nges pa medaX 'chi ba ni glo bur thog

bab tu byung naX bdag tha mal du sdod 'o/nga med pas 'chi ba la blos dmigasaḥ sngar shi ba dag la yang yang somasaX tshe thar du lus pa gcig kyang med pa la gzhig lus 'dusabyas yin pas 'chi bar ngesaX tshe skad cig kyang sdod long med par zadaḥ ri gzar gyi 'bab chu'i dpe la gzigs gsod sar khrid pa'i sems can dang 'dra ste shi ran myur b.ra'achi phyogs la thag nye: bdag le lor sdod pas long med pa yin te sus kyang mi khebaX mi bsrung mi gshol pa nges pa yin na gnyen grogs kyi ci bya 'bral ran0 zas nor gyice byar skyur ran grags snyan gyi ci bya stong ran nga rang gcig pur grogs med rgyus med kyi sa la 'gro ran 'dug pas snyoms las ci'i spobs tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub long ci yod tha na gnyid du log pa'ang ga la khoms snyams pas a tsa ma de ring kho nas sdig pa sbyangasaX de ring kho nas dge ba sgrub 'chi dar blo bde ba phyi mar thar lam zin pa zhig ces kyangabya snyams pa'i ngag nas kyang dran bskul lhang lhang gdab steḥ kyi ma kye ma kye hud dkon mchog mkhyenaḥ sprir na 'dus byas chos kun mi rtag goX nyin dang mtshan gyi tshe la rtag par

—1 rku da sngon ma shi ba'ang kha rje cheḥ da ni 'chi la thug ran dam chos stsol zhes dran bskul gdab cing dmigs pa 'di ltar bya de yang bdag gang nas phyinacha med par lung pa kha byang blta zhig tu phyin tsa naX mi yi rgyu 'grul dang skad smra tsam yang med paḥ chu sha ra ra bab pa rlung sgra 'u ru ru sgrog paḥ 'jag ma'i phyu ru ru zer baḥ nyi ma rirtse la nub paX brag ri sngo sang sang yod pa bya rog gi skad tong tong zer baX kha tog nag la bsil baḥ grogs na zla su yang medaḥ sngon chad ni 'gro ma myongaX gar 'gro la gtadaso ni medaX de 'dra ba zhig tu nam phyin cha med par slebs tshe nyam thag skad kyi kye ma kye ma kye shud a tsa maX grogs med gcig pur lung stong 'khyams pa bdag gar 'gro gtadaso ma mchis ya ma bla nga yi yul sa pha ma bu nor khyimaḥ bdag tu spyod skabs nam 'ong dkon mchog mkhyen kye ma kye hud nyam thag bdag nyid skyobasaḥ zhes 'o dod 'bod bzhinadu phyin tsa na brag dong zhig tu lhung ba laḥ nam zhig brag dkyil rtswa phon la 'chang ba 'jus nas sngangs smrags 'dar phri li li yod tsheḥ mar bltas na gting med yar nam mkha'

sngo tsam las gang yang ma mthongaḥ brag ngos 'jam pa ni me 21nga ltar la rgya che la de 'dra ba zhig tu skabs tsam gnas pa la g.yas g.yon brag gi ser srub nas byi ba dkar podang nag po re byung nas rtswa dum du gcod nas song: byi ba 'gog thabs ni ma mchis rtswa phon je nyung la song: 'chi ba la sgragaḥ sngon chad ni g.yang ba'i chos ni medaḥ las ngan ni bsags: 'gro khung ni sdugaḥ thar thabs ni medaX rang yul gnyen bshes nor rdzas thams cad dang da ni nges par bral: sa steng mig gis mthong ba'ang da tsam mo snyams nasamig chu 'dzag: snying gzer byung: 'o dod 'bod kye hud 'don tsa na rang nyid kyi steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid gdan pad zla nyi ma'i steng du phyag ḍā dril dkrol zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug gi spras shing gar ling ling bsgyur nas bdag la 'di skad gsungs bar mos kye ma sa steng 'dus byas thams cad 'jig pa'i chosaḥ dus bzhi mi rtag skye rgan 'chi g.yo lo na zhag dus 'du shes rnam rtog kunaḥ ston spin ri gzar rbab dang 'bab chu bzhin mi rtag mthong bzhin mi sgom 'gro ba blanaḥ 'chi ba bsgog thabs 'dug

bskyo gam da lta 'di 'o da ni long med bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms: zhes pa'i sgra thos tsa na sems la dang ba 'dren bzhin ngag nas: ya da ni shi rung gson rung blam dkon mchog gsum mkhyen0 dkon mchog rin chen rnams pa gsum la thugs rje mnga' na bdag g.yang sa chen po 'di nas bsgral na ci ma rung: ma bsgral na'ang ci bya lasaskyid sdug mtho dman gang gi dus su'ang pha bla ma dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyams pas mos gus drag pos zhe thag pa nas byas pa tsam gyis bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyisnying po gcig bdag la zug pa dang rtswa phon zad pa dus mnyams nasaX bdag 'od zer de'i g.yeng shing btegs nas bde ba can gyi zhing du sleb byung ba dang: yang bdag gi thugaga'i 'od zer dpag tu med pas sems can thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par bde ba can gyi zhing khams su drangs bar bsam zhing sems can la snying rje drag tu bsgom parabya'oḥ de lta bu'i 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom nas nyams su blang na ni: 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad mi rtag par rtogs nas bden med kyis zinaḥ lhag par rgyud dul zhing chos la

brtson par 'gyur ro 'di ni chos kyi bcud yin pas sgom nyams su skye sems can la snying rje 'khrungasaḥ mthar sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'oḥ de dag ni rang rgyud 'dul b.rabyed pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas shin tu gzab par bya dgos soḥ sa ma yā: gnas dben par song nas sgo gsum lhod kyi bzhag nas 'di ltar bsam par bya rang gi sngon bsagasabazang po'i 'bras bus 'gro ba'i nang nas dal 'byor ni rnyedaX 'khor ba'i las la gom pa 'khyolaḥ bag chags 'khrul ba'i las nyon bsags 'chi ba la thag nye 'dus byas mirtag pa'i mdangs bstan ༷ sgyu lus ni rab tu rgudaX tshe tshad la nges pa med nam 'chi cha med yin pas de dus ngas ci bya a tsa ma ༷ nga re sdugaḥ nga re 'gyodaX snyams pa'i gdungashug drag pos smre sngags 'di ltar brjod kye ma kye shud las kyi mnar ba bdag 'gro ba'i nang nas dal rten thob na'angaX gzung 'dzin rjes 'brang ma rig 'khrul dbang 'byams thar ba'i lam sna ma zin 'chi la thugaḥ ci bya gtol med gyur ba'i dus tshod 'dir: skyabs med bdag gi skyabs zhig gar 'tshol kye zhes mkhun pa 'gro ldog ling ling byed tshe

—tshuX mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par byon pa la rje 'bangs lo paṇa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging ling ka dang bcas pa'i sprin 'khrigasashing bzhugs pa mthong ba'i mod laḥ mos gus tshad med pa 'khrungs shing phyag mchod phul tshe bla ma'i zhal nasaḥ kye ma kye spyod ma rig rmongs pa'i 'groḥ las dang nyon mongs dragapos gzeb du dzadaḥ zhes gsung tshe skyabs yul gyi lha 'di ltar bzhengs bar mosaḥ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khrigs pa'i klong pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldanagyi ze'u 'brus khar o rgyan rin po che ཿ snang srid zil gnon gyi cha lugs can dang mdun nas man+ta ra ba mthing gsalaḥ bde chen rgyal mo dmar mo ka la sirnyi dkar moX shākyadhe wa ser mo bzhi lha mo'i cha lugs can gyis bde stong bdud rtsi'i mchod pa phul zhing gus 'dud kyi zhe sar bcas te bzhugs par mosaḥ g.yas phyogs su ston pa thugs rje canagaser btso ma'i mdog can dngaX rgyab tu shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang: g.yon ngos spran ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa dang mdun du yi dam zhi

khro rab 'byams gu ru'i spyi gtsug tu bī ma mi traX de steng dz+nyā na su traX de steng shrī sidhaḥ de steng 'jam dpal bshes gnyenaX de steng dga' rab rdo rjeḥ de steng rdo rje sems dpa' de steng kun tu bzang po rnams 'ja' 'od thig le zlum 'khyil gyi dbus su gsal gdab bar mtshams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging liṅkaḥ sprul pa'i gter ston rgya mtsho dngabacas pa bzhugs par gsal gdab lha tshogs de dag gis dad ldan rnams la zhal gyis phyogs spyan gyis gzigasaḥ thugs rje tshad med pa dang ldan bzhin bzhugs pa'i bla mgatso 'khor dang bcas pa la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas skyabs su mchi'oḥ thugs rjes bzung du gsolaX 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung bar mdzad du gsolaḥ zhes lanagasum dang gsol ba 'di gdab po rje bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs: ma rig mun pa sangs bar byin gyis rlobs bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la gsol ba'adebasaḥ mkhyen gnyis ye shes rgyas par byin gyis rlobs bla ma spral pa'i sa la gsol ba 'debasaḥ gzhan don dpag med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ bla ma mngon byang chub

ge rdo la gsol ba 'debs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥbla ma mi 'gyur rdo rjer gsol ba 'debasaḥganas lugs rang sa zin parabyin gyis rlobs hrī 'gro ba'i bla ma sa rgyan tshe dpag medaḥm bcos lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa laḥrang rig so ma'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs chos rnams zag zad skugasum mngon gyur re gaḥces gsol ba yang yang gdab tshe bla ma'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun nar gyi byung bdag gi spyo bo nas reg pas sgo gsum gyi dri masbyangs bar bsam la dar gcig 'dugaḥyang snying khung rus pa'i gting nasaXhrīX ma bcos ye grol kun bzang yab yum dngaḥm 'gags rang grol rdo rje 'chang chen po:mabartsal shar grol mi bskyod sems dpa' laḥm bcing blo bral ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥgatad med rgya yan dga' rab rdo rje dngaḥ'adzin med rang gsal 'jam dpalabashes gnyen zhabasaḥdamigs med rang bzhag gro seng ha laḥbasgom med blo 'das ngang nas gsol ba 'debs soḥgashis lugs ma bcos dzā na su tra dngaḥyin lugs ma

bslad bī ma mi tra'i zhabs snang lugs ma 'gags pad+ma 'byung gnas laḥ gnas lugs ma bcos ngang nas sems nyid bsam 'das bdud 'dul rdo rje dang chos nyid yula'adus bdud 'joms he ru ga stong nyid blo 'das nam mkha'i rnal 'byer la de nyid brjod 'das ngang nas chos kun ye grol dgongs pa rang grol rtogs rkyen snang cer grolabar do drug grol nasaḥ mtha' grol klong yangs gcig grol 'bras bu rnyedaḥ 'khor 'das mnyam grol kun bzang sa thob shogaX ces brjod tshe bla ma'i byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par rang la reg pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur bar bsam la dar gcig sdodaḥ yang mos gus tshad med pa'i bskul tsheḥ bla ma yab yum spyi gtsug nasaX o dkar 'od zer dngabacas pa bdag gi smin mtshams mdzod spur babasaḥ bum dbang thob nas lus sgrib sbyangasaX sku yi dngos grub thob par bsam bla ma yab yum mgrin pa nas yi dmar 'od zer dang bcas paḥ bdag gi lce yi dbang por babasaḥ gsang dbang thob nas ngag smib dgaḥ gsung gi dngos grub thob par bsamaḥ bla ma yab yum thugs ka nas hūṃ75thing

—— 'od zer dang bcas paḥ bdag gi snying gi dkyil du babaḥ ye shes dbang thob yid sgrib dgaḥ thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par bla ma yab yum lte ba nas trīḥdamar 'od zer dang bcas pa bdag gi lte ba'i gnas su babasaḥ sgo gsum tha dad 'dzin sgrib dgaḥ dbyer med lhan skyes dbang bzhi thobaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub parabasamaḥ de nas bla ma'i 'dzum mdang ston bzhin dgyes bskyed sa rā dzi byung nas bdag gi mdzub mo nas drangs te rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su khrid nas rjes su bzung la byin gyisabarlabs par bsam yang rang gi gnas lnga nas 'od zer sna tshogs spros te 'gro drug gi sems can la phog pas thams cad ma lus par drangs nas rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'khodapar bsamaḥ thabs des dal 'byor don ldan du 'gyuraḥ sgo gsum gyi rtog sgrib sbyangasaX sa lam gyi bar chad selaḥ yon tan gyi gzhi tshugs pa la sogs phan yon dang dgos chedabasam gyi mi khyab boX de nas khyas kyi jing bu la zhugs par bsam la yan lag lnga khyas byaḥ bla ma nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par gsal gdab pa'i drang du gnyen po stobs

bzhi tshangs ba'i phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don zhing bshags sbyangs byaḥ yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab naX kye skyabs med 'gro ba bdag gzhan dmusalong 'gro ༷ji srid byang chub snying po mchis kyis bar bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags tshogs la bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus pa'i skyabs su mchiḥlan grangs mang du brjod yang bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab la 'di skad brjodaḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi rmad byung byang chub mchog tuthugs bskyed cing:phyin drug spyod pa mchog la gnas bzhin ṣābadag gis sems bskyed sdom bzungs 'gro phan sgrubasaXzhes yang yang brjod la sdom pa blang tshe bla ma ye shes sgyuma'i sku can mngon sum lha'i gos pañca li ka lus la bgo zhing 'di skad gsungasaXkyiX sdom pa'i rtsa ba skyabs su song ba naḥbar chad gegs zhi bdud las rnams par rgyalaX lha'igos pa3 khyod kyi lus la bgoḥbyang chub bar du skyabs kyi rwa gur tshudaḥces gsung la gzeng bstod nas slar yang nor bu dbang gi rgyal po phyag gis bsnams nas bdag gis

—tshuX zod rgyan du bcing la bka' rtsal baX dgos dgu lus la tshangs ba'i bsam don 'grub yid bzhin nor bu bcing bas gzhan phan 'byungaX gdul bya'i re'adod skong la phyin drug gi spyod pa rmad byung mtha' ru phyin par shogaḥces gsung nas 'od lam dkar po la drangs nas ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing du 'phags mchog rgyal ba'i spyanasngar 'god par mosaX spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje can la bdag gis phyag mchod phul tshe mdzod sbu nas 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs mu med pa spros nas 'gro drugasems can la reg pas rnam smin bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs bar bsam la skyirngo ni sgrib bral ye shes skuḥser sna bral ba'i bcom ldan 'das:gtong ba chen po'i chu rgyunagyisaḥ'agro ba nyam thag tshims gyur cigaX ma ni dri bral gzigs pa canaḥ'achal tshogs dben pa'i bcom ldan 'dasaX bsrung ba mchog gi rgyan bzang posaḥnyam thag 'gro bsgobs gyur cigaḥṇi ni snying rje yongs khyabs bdalaḥsnying stobs dben pa'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥbyams pa mchog gi gos bzang pos tsha grang reg bya skrobs par shog pad ni

brtson 'grus pha rol phyin le lo dben pa'i bcom ldan 'das brtson chen rkang 'gro'i myur bde ba'iX 'khor ba'i 'khor rnams bsgral bar shog me ni bsam gtan pha rolaphyenaX g.yang ba dben pa'i bcom ldan 'das ting 'dzin 'gyur med grogs bzang pos khams gsum g.yang sa skyobs bar shogaX hū ni shesarab pha rol phyinaḥ ma rig dbenapa 'i bcom ldan 'dasaX ye shes mchog ldan grogs bzang posaḥ srid dang zhi las skyobs par shog ces gsung shingaḥ 'o rigs kyi bu dang bu mo dag bdag ci 'dra ba de 'dra b.rasems can thams cad 'gyur bar 31ga cig: mdzad pa phrin las rgya che la rgyun ring bar sgo ga cig phar phyin drug la rtag tu gnas par 37ga cigaḥ 'dren stobs mtha' yas par gyur cigaḥ 'brel tshad don ldan du byed pa'i ded dpon du gyur bar shog cig: ces stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyal po' thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyis gzeng bstod nas yang bka' rtsal ba 'di nas shar gyi phyogs dri bral pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing mngon par dga' ba na thugs mchog rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i der song la mi 'khrugs ye shes snying

—tshuX po'i dbang zhusaḥ 'gro khams dong nas sprugs pa'i nyam len slob laḥ bag chags kyi rkye rgyun gcod pas sgrib sbyangs la brtson nas 'khor 'das rang grol gyirtogs pa'i yon tan 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs tshe 'od zer gyi gsang lam dkar po zhig gi sna la brgyud de shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing gi sna tshogs rin po che'i shingadrung mdzes sdug bya dang ri dwags kyis rtse 'jo dang chos kyi sgra snyan par 'ur ba'i mtshams rin chen sgrom gyi mtha' legs par bkod ba'i sgo drung du sleb tshe dam du bsdam nas nangadu tshud pa'i skal ba dang bralaḥ grogs gang yang ma mchis 'jig rten gyi khams mthong reg gi yul du ma grub: rten med kyi mkha' la 'od snang las grub pa'i zhing gi ston 'khora'ajal bar ma gyur te shin tu mya ngan gyis 'o dod 'di ltar 'bod par mos kye ma kye spyod dal rten rin chen 'diḥ las 'phro mi zhan dkon mchog rjes zin yang bag chagasa'athug pos yi dam zhal mi mthong: skyabs med skyabs bral bdag 'dra nyam thag rnamasaḥ thugs rje brtse bas gzigs mdzod bla ma rjeX zhes gdung shug drag pos brjod tshe bla ma

nyid rdo rje dril bu bsnol thabs su 'chang zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug can zhabs gar brgyur mdzad bzhin byung nas 'di skad gsungasaḥ kye ma kye spyod ma rig rmongs pa'i 'groX bgachags 'byul ba'i mdud rgya dam dbang gisaX med snang stong gzugs 'gro drug 'khrul grong rgyaraḥdabang med tshud pas gang zag gnyis snang can mi rtog ye shes bcom ldan rdo rjesemasaḥmangon sum mjal ba'i skal ba dman pa laX dpal ldan bla ma'i bsgom bzlas khyad par canaḥtshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal spro bsdu'i sgrib bral nasaḥkun mkhyen ye shes phungapo dang mjal na srid pa'i sa bon stong ngo rigs kyi buḥ zhes gsung tshe bdag gi sgo gsum bag yangs su gnas par byas la dmigs pa ni spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stongaldan gyi ze'u 'brur zla ba nya gang ba la bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur longs sku'i rgyanabacu gsum gyis spas shing zhabs sems dpa'i phyed stel gyis bzhugs shing phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thug gar bstod de 'dzin pa g.yon pa dasu la dkar dril bu gser gyis

sgo rdo rje'i yu ba byas pa dku la brten paḥ cung zhig 'gyeng ba'i tshul can thugs gar zla ba rgyas pa'i khar trīḥyig be+eḍūr+ya'i mdog can la yig brgya dbyangs kyi/dro zhin nam mkha'i mdog can g.yas su sga ra ra 'khor ba dngaḥ mgrin par pad+ma la brten pa'i ā dmar po la yig brgya mgal ma'i 'khor lo ltar dmar kyi li li 'khor bdang: spyi bor nyi ma la brten pa'i oṃ dkar po la yig brgya chu shel gyi mdangs ldan ngang me re re 'khor ba las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rgyun nar gyi byung bdag gisgo gsum la thim pas lus ngag yid kyi bag chags sbyangs rnam smin sha khrag gi phung po mer gyis zhu dbang chen gser gyi sa bzhi'i 'og tu songaḥ las gshin yi dwags kyi sdetshogs len chags bu lon sha mkhon gyi bdag po bdag mo rnams la phog hab thob kyis tshul du rol bas ngom shing tshimasaḥ gnod gdug gi bsam pa dang bralaḥ phan pa'ibasam pa la gnasaḥ sngon gyi lan chags byang: 'phral gyi rkyen gegs selaḥ snyib bral rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ye shes la bltas te0 yig brgya lan gsum brjod tshe khams

gsum gyi bag chags sbyangs: dug gsum gyi 'khrul snang grol sku gsum gyi skal pa rgyud la bzhag pa'i dmigs 'dun la yang yang brtsonaḥ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmong pa yisaḥ dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa la mi 'chab snying nas bshags sbyangs sdomaX ma lus dag par mdzad du gsol rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dmadzig chags nyams 'gal 'khrul nyes lhung dri mi'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas sor chud par bsam moḥ slar yang bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis med kyi dal dumaṇ+ḍal spro ba ni oṃ āhū gis tshogs zhing bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dal du stong gsum mi mjed kyi bkod pa tshangs ris tshangs bdun tshangs chen gyi mnga' dbang su bsgyur bathams cad blo yi blang nas maṇ+ḍal bkod mdzes blta na sdug par yid sprul gyi lha mo rnams kyi dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la 'bul bar bsam (ཿ dbang chen gseragyi sa gzhi laḥ stong gsum mi mjed maṇ+ḍal bkod lha gla mi yi dga' ston sprinaḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin la 'bul khams gsum 'dzin pa rnam dag nas: nub med spral pa'i sma thob

—— shog zhes phyag dang bcas te 'bul bar bya: yang snod rnam par dag pa 'og min stug po bkod pa sa gzhi rin chen sna lnga las grub shing pa1'i tshar dngarabaḥ sman dang dri bsung bsam las 'das par 'phro zhing yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing bu khrus chab mchog la mdzes pa'i gzhon nu dag gis rtse gar bsgyur ba: gser gyi phye ma chuganas sna tshogs nor bu'i gram ba brdal steng cang shes dang glang po che rgyu ba: g.yu yi ne'u sang la spu sdug mdzes pa'i ri dwags rtse baḥ rat+na sna tshogs las grub pa'i ljon shing khadog sna tshogs bkra ba'i 'dabs chags 'phur lding du g.yo ba bar snang 'ja' 'od kyi thig le bsgrangs mtha' las 'das par mdzes sgegs yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo dkar seradamar ljang mthing sngon mu mtha' yas pas mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams 'byed pa nam mkha' la 'ja'i gdugs rgya che la khyon yangs paḥ sna tshogs 'od kyi 'phur ma can gyi rgyalamatshan bkrag 'bar ba 'ja' yi dar yug lta bu ring zhing gsham pa yid 'phrog nus pa'i ba danaḥ 'od zer 'ja' ris kyi bla bre la drwa ba dang drwa phyed mig mang ris su bkra zhing rgya

khyon dang ldan pa 'dod yon kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba lta bu'i bkod par sprul te dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje'i dal du 'bul bar bsam laX e rnam kunamachog ldan stong pa'i klong 'gags med lhun grub longs sku'i zhing lnga ldan stug po bkod pa'i dal bla ma rdo rje 'dzin la 'bul snang zhen sgyu lus rnam dag nas 'od gsalalongs sku thob par shogaḥ ces ting nge 'dzin gyis dang du blang nas 'bul bar bya'oX yang stong chen chos dbyings yangs par kun gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal laḥ tshogs yul gyi brgyan rnam paradag pa bkod nas shes rab kyi zer mdangs 'bar zhing ye shes kyi lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed bzhin rig pa 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du blang nas 'bul bzhes gnyis med kyidagongs pa la gnas bzhin tu don dam bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dal du 'ub chub rol pa chen po'i 'bul bar bsam laḥ ā stong chen ka dag yangs pa la lhun grub tshogasayul maṇ+ḍal bkod shes rab rgyan rdzogs rig pa'i 'phrulaḥ ye shes chen pos dang blang nasaḥ bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bulaX bag chags rgong rgya rab grol nasaḥ nang dbyings kun

dang bzang sa thob shogaḥ ces gnyis med ro mnyam du 'bul ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te rigs kyi bu khyod kyi tshogs rdzogs lasgrib pa bral ba yin no zhes lung bstan gnang nas bdag la thim pas dbyer med bde ba chen por bsres la smra bsam brjod bral gyi ngang bskyang bar bya'oḥ de'i tha mal snang zhen rngam po che sbyangs la thug mchog rdo rje sems dpa' mjal ba'i skal bzang thob te 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub kyi dbyig chen mo thob par bsamamoX man ngag gi sdon 'gro chos bdun po zhag gsum du sbyangs bcug la sgo gsum gyi sgrib sbyangs bya ba 'di ni shin tu med thabs med pa'i 'dul byed dang sbyangs byed zhes bya bayin noḥ skyes bu mchog dman kun gyi snying la phur rgyaḥ sa ma yā khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i don khrid nyams su len pa la drug gis bstan teḥ skye gnas bar do'i khridakun gzhi rang grol the bya tshangs su 'jug pa lta bu'i man ngag dang rmi lam bar do'i khrid 'khyal ba rang grol mun khang du sgon me btags pa lta bu'i mang ngag dang bsam gtan

bar do'i khrid rig pa rang grol dwa phrug ma dang 'phrad pa lta bu'i man ngag dang 'chi kha bar do' khrid dran pa rang grol rgyal po'i bka' them lta bu'i man ngag dngaX chos nyid b.rado'i khrid mthong ba rang grol ma pang bu 'jug lta bu'i man ngag dngaḥ srid pa bar do'i khrid yur ba rkang chad la wa 'dzug pa lta bu'i man ngag rnams soX dang po skye gnas bar do' khrid kun gzhi rang grol the bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bu'i man ngag laX las dang po bas rigs drug gi bag chags sbyangs ba la brtson thabs dang mtshan bcas kyi zhi gnas kyidamigs khrid dngaX mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas sgom rim dngaḥ thabs bskyed rim gyi spyir bshad dngaḥ shes rab rdzogs rim gyi go don bshad pa dngaX zung 'jug rdzogs pa chenapo'i gzhung spyi'i go don 'chad pa dngaḥ rang byung ye shes thabs la mkhas pa'i ngo rang thog tu sprod tshul dang bdun lasaḥ dang po phal ba'i sgrib sbyangs gi dmigs pa la brtson pa ni ku su li'i ngal bso ba'i 'dug ltangs kyi gnas teḥ bar do drug gi gnad byang ltar bla ma spri bor bsgom la gsol ba yang yang gdab khyad par thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo

—— 'dogs chod pa the bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bu 'byung phyir gsol gdab dang bla ma'i zhal nas ngo sprod bcas gnang ba mos la tshig rnams brjod rjesaḥ spyi borazla ba la gser gyi ri mo bkra ba'i chos 'byung zur drug pa'i lte ba lahrīḥdakar po 'od lnga'i zer 'byugs paḥ zur rnams la aḥdakar po 'a ser bo haḥsngon poX shaḥdamaraposaḥljang gu mnasad kha rnamasabacad dang ldan par bsamaX de dag las 'od zer rang mdog spros te rigs lnga'i zhing khams 'og min gyi gnas nas rigs dang dkyil 'khor gartsa'akhor thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul teḥ 'od zer sna tshogs las rnam par bsdus nas yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsamaḥ yig 'bru re re bzhin dal larang ba'i brgya re brjod par byaX de nas rang rang gi lus kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang snying thad nas mar brtsegs te aXdri snyeX triḥpres rnams dkar sngo ser ljang dmar nag gi rnams pal rang mdog thig le bkrag med pa re'i klong du gsal gdab laḥ sprang byed yi ge drug las bdud rtsi'i rgyan 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa na ra ra byung: spri bor tshang bug nas

zhugs dbu ma'i klong brgyud laḥ sbyangs bya yig 'bru rnams la reg pa'i dang po snod kyi bag chags 'od rnams sbyangasaḥ de nas yig 'bru rnams bkru sbyangs byas la rigs drug giganas yul dang sa bon rnams stong par dmigs pa'oḥ mthar ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs la dngas ma ye shes kyi sgyu lus dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyagargyar sad par dmigs la skye med kyi yi ge 'bru gcig ma shin tu dal la snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gyer bar bya'o: mthar 'gro drug gi sems can gcig kyang ma lus par thugasamachog rdo rje sems dpa'i sa la bkod par bsam la bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab par bya'oḥ gnyis pa ni: dge ba'i lam 'khor ba'i gang zag gis dben par bya ba sgom zhingagasol gdab spyi dang bye brag pa gdab rjes ngo sprod bskul gdams brtsal rjes lus rnal du phab te rnam par snang mjad kyi chos bdun bca' zhingaḥ bya ba gzhan gsum btang nasabyar med kyi ngang la gnas pas sgom rang babs su 'ong ngoX ngag rnal du phab pa la bzang ngan bar gsum sma tshig brjod pa spangs nas pi waṃ gi rgyan thag chad pa bzhin tu brjod

—11 med rang babs su bzhag pas rlung dngas ba'oX yid rnal du phab pa la bzang ngan bar gsum gyi rtog tshogs thams cad btang la ston nam slong byed kyi rkyonagasum dang bral ba'i g.ya' dag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la bzo mi 'chos par khrig ger bzhag pas shes pa dngas shing gsal bar 'gyur roḥ de nas sems kyi glang po 'di yanapar mi gtong bar dran pa'i stod phur la btags nas bkol du btub pas thabs la mkhas par bya dgos de yang thog mar mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba rnams sangs rgyas pas chedadu sems bskyedaḥ bla ma yid la dran bzhin khyed shes kyi dad pa drag pos sgo nas gsol ba yang yang gdab bar byas la thugs yid 'dres pas ngang la lhan gyis bzhagaḥ rnam rtogagacur bkags dang dam 'dzin mi byaḥ ha cang yengs nas 'khrul 'byams su mi gtong bar mdun du shing bu dang rde'u la sems bzung nas tsen gyis bzhagaḥ gsal ba las rnamartog rbad chod dang dam 'dzin mi bya bar sangs se bzhagaḥ yun thung grangs mang du byas pas gnas pa 'byungaḥ yang bla ma dran bzhin gsol ba btab nas thugs yid bsres rjes

sten 'tshams su thig le dkar 'tsher gsal dngas la sems 'dzin 'khrul 'byams su mi gtong gtad log mi bya gsal snang zin pa'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag pa'i gnasanyams skye yang thig le las gzhan pas 'od lnga gsal ba la shes pa gtad rnam rtog gi rjes mi gcod dran bsam gyis gcer 'dzin mi byaX rang babs kyi gshis la rjen nerabazhag go yang rang lus phru ma phus bkang ba lta bu'i nang gi snying kha'i thad thig le dmar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba mar me tsam cung zad sngo mdangs chags shing reg bya tsha ba la zhes pa gtad de bzhagaḥ re 'ga' gtad med kyi ngang skyongasaḥ yengs 'khrul gyi dus su gong ltar gtadaX shes pa za zir gyur tshe rlung langs bas zas bcud gtong zin tshe shes pa cung zad 1da la rang babs su bzhagaḥ dge rtsa mkha' khyab kyi 'gro la bsngo zhing smon lam gdab yang nges 'byung dang skyo shes bskyed dal 'byor rted dka' la 'dun pa bzhag bla ma rnams la gsol ba gdab cing thugs yid bsreḥ dal gcig la mnyams par bzhag slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le tshom 'khrul gyi klong du

ge rdo dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam du che chung mtho gang tsam pa zhig gsal gdabaḥ de yang snang la rang bzhin med pashel 'od 'bar ba lta buḥ dkar la gsal ba gcig sa ler bsgom la de'i thugs gar rig pa gtad nas gsal ye re ba rjen pa'i ngang yun thung grangs mang du byas la gtadamed skyongasaX yang mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri steng du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa gser btso ma'i mdog can bkrag mdangs 'od lam me ba la rig pa gtadacing yengs med kyi ngang yun thung grangs mang du bsgom moX yang mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin dkar dang 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i klong 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs stong nyid namamakha'i rgyal po dkar lam me ba'i thugs grog hrī dkar po ring cha tshags drag dang ldan pa la sems ma yengs bar lhan ger gtadaḥ de ltar bsgom pa'i yon tan ni mdo lasagasung ba ltar yin pas rtog tshogs nyung phyam mer 'gro re 'ga' rnam rtog ce mang la 'ong 'dug snyams nas sun pa stes tshe smid lugs su mi btang bar sgom cung zad skyes pa'i

rtags su goḥ sngar 'khrul 'byams su shor bas rnam rtog gi mtshangs ma lon pa dngaḥ da lta dran pa'i zin cing skyon mthong ba lags na rtog pa zin thog tu bkag kyang mi bkag rjes su yang mi 'brang bar dmigs pa la gtad pas rtog pa ce phra ce nyung la 'gro ba yin noḥ re 'ga' rtog ngan thol thol 'phro na de dmigs rten du byas la cer gyis bzhagaḥ dugagasum ngan rtog gang 'phro ba de ngos bzung la de thog klod der lhod la bzhagaḥ des rtog pa 'phro rgod tsir gyis bzung la rang grol du khrol khrol btang gnyis gsum gang skyesangos bzung nas rjen grol la btang bar klod de lhodaḥ de'i gnas pa bzang po rgyud la skye ba'ang yodaḥ de tshe rig pa rtsar la bslab poX phal cher ni bag chags ngan goms 'di'adul dka' ba 'ong bas de la thabs du mas rnal dbabs 'di gal che'oḥ de yang lus gnad chos bdun dang ldan pas rgal rgyud drang por bsrangaḥ lag gnyis sa gnon bcasate sna bug g.yas nas rlang khams nagaX g.yon nas dmar nagaḥ cha mnyam nas sngo nag gi rnam pa dngaḥ gzhan yang sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon nasaḥ mdun mkhar ram̐ las
