—— ye shes kyi me mched de bag chags gdos bcas thul thul bsregs par bsam pa ni rlung dug dbyung ba'o de nas rlung tshur rngub de lte ba'i 'og tu tig semanan la dmigs med kyi ngang nas ci gnas su lhan rnar bzhagaḥ mi thub pa'i tshe sang sang 'bud la yang yang bskyar bzlos bya'oḥ khyad par rlung bum can rngub pas gnas pas 'bud pa hūṃ gi rang bzhin la rig pa yengs med du sems bzung yang gsal ba'i byin rlabasaspyod dkar po'i rnam par sbyor ba gnyis kyi drangs te nyi zla kha sbyor ba bum pa'i sbubasasu sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs63dmar po'i rang bzhin gsal stong ye re ba ci gnas su bzhagaḥ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs/ sngon po'i rnam par sbyor ba gnyis kyidabyung ba'ang sprul sku'i rnam pa mtha' yas pas gzhan don 'byung ba la 'dun pa bzhagaḥ thabs la mkhas pa'i nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'bru gsum skye med kyi bzlas par 'byung tsheyon tan ni brjod las 'das soX sdag smib dag rtog pa zhi gsal stong mngon par shes pa'i yon tan dang rtags tshad 'byung ngoX de dag ni mtshan ma can gyi zhi gnas ste thun

mtshams kun tu dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab par bya'o gsum pa ni 'jig rten chos la gdung zhen chod pas gang zag dag gis lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldanapas mig nam mkha' la ha rer blta dmigs pa ci yang mi bya bar stong nyid spro bsdu bral ba'i ngang la shes pa sang nge bzhag la gtad med nam mkha'i ngang skyongs resayengasamed 'dzin med hril gyis bsgrimasaḥ gnas bdo ba'i ngang la ngal bsoḥ skabs su bsgrims mkhan gyi shes pa ci 'dra ba 'dug rtsar bcadaḥ gtad med la bor yengs med dubasgrimasaḥ rtsol med du brtags des bying thug gi skyon sel bar bar 'khyil ba bshigaḥ 'byams pa gtoraḥ 'phro rgod bsal spyod lam kun tu dran pa yengs med du bstanapar bya'oḥ de nas yang lus gnad sngar ltar laX blta stangs thur du phab de sems klod kyi lhodaX 'di sgom bya ba'i dmigs pa ci yang med par lus sems gnyis ka khong stod la ma yeng tsam du rang babaḥ rang dwangasaḥ rang sangasaḥ gshis lugs ji bzhin nyid kyi ngang la bcos bslad dang bral bar lhan ner gnasaX shig gis bshigasaḥ basmims bzhag

dpa lhod mkhan gyi ngo bo la cer gyis blta zhing sems kho rang gi kho rang rjen la byung des gnas pa bzang po skyeX rig pa ngo 'phrod pa'ang byungaX yang shesapabasgrims la yengs med du hri li li bya yang lhod la ku yangs su byam mer bzhag bsgrims lhod res mos su byaX res nam mkha'i dbyings su cer rer blta bsgom tu med kyanga'adun pa der hrig ger gtad yang lhod res g.yas su lta stangs hrig ge dbyings rig ma yengs bar gtad de bzhin g.yon du'ang gtadaXres thur du gtad pa rnams resamos su bya gtad mkhan gyi ngo bo la blta zhing sems snying gi dkyil du phab la phyam mer bzhag pa dang:nam mkha'i gar khyab tu btang la goms pa'i tshe rnal pheb kyi rtags rigapa gar bzhag phyam me lhan ne hrig ger gnas pa byung na zhi gnas skyes pa yin bar bar dran med 'thum por song na byang 'thibs kyi skyon yin pas rig pa ngar bskyed gzengabastod lnga stangs bsgrar bar bya'oḥyang nasal rgod dbang la 'chor tshe lnga stangs thur du phab dbyings thog ta lhod pa gal che bsgom 'di yin rtog pa 'di yin med pas ting nge

ba byung na ldang bas skyon yin pas grim lhod res mos su bsgom zhing bsgom mkhan ngos bzung ngo skyon rnams ngos bzung zhing thad gar bsal bar bya'oX zhi gnas skyon bral nimar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu ste rig pa gar gtad du g.yo ba med par bstan pa bying rmug 'thib pa'i ma gos par gsal sang nge baX gang la'ang thog pa med pas rtse mo rnobaḥ glo bur gyi rtog pas ma bskyod pas drangs ba'oḥ de ltar byung na sgom skyon med rgyud la 'khrung ba yin pas rig ngo sprad kyang rtogs pa bstan de ltar yon tan med pa la rig ngosprad kyang go yul du lus nas dred por shor nyen yod pas ngo sprod ma snga bar gnas pa'i nyams myong bzang po ma byung gi bar du sgrubs bcug la de dus su dngos gzhi la 'jug go de ni mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas bsgrub pa ste dge rtsa mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba la yang yang bsngo ba dang smon lam kyi rgyas gdab par bya'oX bzhi ba nai: snang srid dag mnyam du lazlos pas gang zag skal pa can dag ni thabs kyi lam la 'jug dgos pasaX de yang ma hwa yo ga'i lta ba ni kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du blta zhing: de

dze ye bzod ma nas don dam par chos kyi dbyings dang gnyis su med par rtogs nas dben pa dbyer med blo'i spyod yul dang bral bar gtan la dbab palobasgo pa lam ni stong pa chen po sogs ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog phubaḥ phun tshogs lnga yi gzhi bzungaX sgog sdom gzer bzhi'i chings kyis bcing nas bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnala'abyor gtso bor byas la ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal rdzogs nas mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang des drangs bas rdzogs pa chen po la 'jug pa yin gyi de yang gzhi gtan la dbab pa'ilta ba dngaḥ lam nyams su len tshul spyod pa la'ang spros bcas kyi spyod pa phyi yi rdzas dang yo byad sogs rtsol ba mang po brten pa dang sems gnas pa'i thabs rim bzhinagoms pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can sgrub pa dngaḥ dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan dang lha sngags ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gtso bor nyams su len pa dang dbang la'ang blamed thams cad dbang bzhis smin par byed pa 'dra yang gong gi dkyil 'khor du phyi rol rdzas la brten nas dbang nod pa gtso bor byed pa dngaḥ dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi

bsdus pa'i bsrung bya dang bsgrub bya rnams dran shes kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du blang dor bgyid pa dngaḥ ting 'dzin shes rab nang gi yo byad phyi'i sgrub pa chen po'i yo byad de phyi nang giyo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas bsnyen sgrub byed pa dang phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod sman raka gtor mchod dam tshig gi rdzas dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyisprul ba'i mchod pa gtso bor byed pa dngaḥ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi thabs gtso bor byas te phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa dngaḥ bca' ba las kyi phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin lha sku'i phyagargya bsgom pa'i rtsol ba gtso bor byed pa dang: bzlas brjod gtso bo sngags kyi rtsol ba la gtso bor byed pa dang 'bras bu tshe 'di la rig 'dzin bzhi'i lam bsgrod de yi ge 'khoralo tshogs chen gyi sa la sangs rgyas par 'dod pa yin de yang sbyangs gzhi bde gshegs snying po la sbyangs bya khams gyi kun rdzob rang mtshan gol zhing don dam rgyab kyi phyogasapa sa dri ma dang sbong byed lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'jug pa'i thabs kyi snang zhen dang bral lha skur sbangs la sbangs 'bras ro mnyam rdo rje'i

shākya dbyings chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i ye shes la longs spyod pa'oḥ de ltar lhag pa'i lha la sems bzung ba sngon 'gro'i yan lag bdun pa dngaḥ dngos gzhi'i(dī bcu gsum dang rjes kyi bya ba bco lnga sogs rang gzhung gi khyad par ltar bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i yon tan mthar phyin par bya ba'oḥ rnam pa kun tu bla ma la gsolagadab thugs yid bsres nas mnyam bzhag dngaḥ dngos gzhi'i ngang bskyang nas bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtha' brgyan dang bcas dmigs bcas kyi sems lnga mthar phyin terdzogs rim mngon du 'gyur ro lnga pa ni rang lus bde ba chen po la brten nas steng sgo 'ju 'dul gyi lam la bslab par 'dod pasaḥ de'i lta ba snang cha ye nas dag pa kun tubazang po rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang ༷ stong pa'i cha kun tu bzang mo ye ji bzhin pa'i dkyil 'khor dngaX de gnyis so so ma yin tha mi dad par dbyer med pani sras bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor ste 'di ni snang srid kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs dag mnyam bde ba chen po zhes bya'o gzhe de las ma g.yos kyang gnyis 'dzin kyi

bslad pa can dag la rigs drug so so'i sgo gsum gyi rnam pa ris chad du snang ba'i tshe na rang snang dum bur bcing ba'i lus kyi dbus su bum nang gi nam mkha' ltar kun rdzob rgyuyi thig le rnams la brten nas don dam 'od gsal byang chub sems kyi thig le yang: rang gi ngo bo cha med kun 'gro khyab pa'i bdag nyid yin kyangaḥ sems can gang la snang bder chos can sgo gsum gyi dbang gis byang chub sems kyi thig le de yang der snying po'i tshul du 'od dang gdangs kyi rnam par snang ba'ang yod kyangaX dbyibs mdog sogs mtshanama'i rnam pas gos sa'ang med de bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ye shes yin pas phyir ro ji ltar gnas na gdod ma'i ye shes byang chub kyi sems nam mkha' ltar 'pho 'gyur med kyangastong pa byang chad min par 'od lnga la sogs pa'i 'char gzhi rig gdangs kyi cha yod pas de'i rtsal snang ba la gnyis 'dzin zhugs pa'i dbang gis rtsal nyid skyol byed las kyi rlungan nga phra ba'i kun rtog zung du 'jug nas 'grogs pa'i rnam par shar ba las khu rdzul rlang gsum gyi byed las: snang ba gsum dang 'grogs pas rnam shes je rags su song ba las

—tshuX khams gsum gyi bsdus pa'i sgo gsum 'byung ste de yang je rags su song ba'i byed las kyi rtsa gsum dang gnas lnga'i 'khor lo rtsa'i rigs phra rags dag labarten pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung dang thig le phra rags kyi khams rnams gnas pa'i byed las la brten nas nang du kun rtog sna tshogs bskyed pa dang phyi rol du snang ba snatshogs 'char bar byed pa yin noḥ'adi ltar nang gi rtsa rlung thig le 'di dag lam du slong na dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba dngaX lam du ma slong na ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'char b.rashes nas: phyi spros bcas kyi bskyed rim la mi ltos par nang rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas rags pa'i 'gyu ba thams cad thog mar gangalas byung ba 'gyur med ye shes kyi dbu ma'i dbyings su bstims pas sems nyid bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid lus thabs kyi rgyud la lam du byas pa lasamangon du 'char bar shes pa 'di ni lung a nu yo ga'i lta ba yin noḥde ltar shes nas sgom pas nyams su len pa'i thabs la g.yo ba rjang ga rdzogs rim rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang sbor

ba bzhi ldan gyi bum pa can la goms pas rlung rang byan tshugs na 'khor lo lnga la sogs pa'i gnas su dmigs pa gtad cing der rlung zin pas rtsa'i mdud pa rnams grol zhingarlung thams cad dbang bskur bstim par byed pa steḥ rlung la dbang thob na des sems la dbang thob cing tshe la dbang thob pa'ang 'byung ngoḥ khyad par rig pa ye shes la dbang thobapa 'byung nas yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab poḥ brten pa rtsa'i rdzogs rim ni rtsa gtso mo gsum dang 'khor lo lngar yid kyi dmigs pa gtad pa dngaḥ rlung bzung ba dang lus kyigazul 'khor la goms pa'i rim pa rtsa yi gnas so sor rtsa yi gnad la brten nas rlung sems zin pas yon tan gyi khyad par sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du gong nas gong 'phel dusnang bar 'gyur roḥ bkod pa thig le la byang chub sems kyi rdzogs rim ni 'bar 'dzag gi rnal 'byor zab mo kun dha lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems la brten nas rang lus dngagazhan lus kyi thabs las bde ba sbar zhing khams 'dzag med du bcing nas yas bab dang mas brtan gyis dga' ba drangs bas 'pho med lhan cig stes pa'i ye shes mngon du

—— gyur teḥ 'khor lo lnga'i rlung las su rung ba las lam lnga'i yon tan 'char ba dang: dbu mar ro skyang gi mdud pa nyer gcig grol ba las sa bcu gcig giyon tan 'char ba yin noḥ lam gyi rgyud la ni a nu yo ga'i zhu bde 'gyur med bsgrub pa'i mtshan bcas rdzogs rim la gtso bor lam du byed pa dngaḥ lha sngags brjod pa lha'i'akhor lo rdzogs pa'i bskyed rim dang zhu bde mtshungs ldan gyi lha sku dang rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu ma'i sku rnams kyis sgo nas snang cha bskyed rim gyi don thun mongs minapa dngaḥ bde ba'i thabs kyis drangs ba'i don gyi lhan skyes rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len pa'ang yin noḥ deltar gzhigatan la 'bebs pa'i lta ba dang lam nyams su lenatshulaḥ de'i dbang gis spyod pa la'ang phyi'i lta ba gtso bor mi byed par spros med kyi tshul du nang gi thabs zab mo la 'bad pas zhing sngags lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhanacig 'du ba thob pa'i nye rgya'i spod pa gtso bor byed pa dang de bzhin tu bsgom pa la'ang a nu rdo rje'i las la gnad du basman pa'i thabs kyis rlang sems bcings te zhi gnas

khyad par can myur du bsgrub pa dang gnyis ni rtsol ba dang bcas pa yin laḥ de bzhin tu bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la nyams len gtso bor byed pa dang: dbang nirdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor las yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub sems kyi dbang rdzas las dbang nod pa gtso bor byed pa dang: dam tshig thams cad la rang dbang 'byoraba'i bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i rten kun dha lta bu byang chub kyi sems mi nyams pa'i thabs dang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa sogs kyi bya ba gtso bor sgrub padang: ting 'dzin dang shes rab rang lus thabs ldan bsnyen pa gzhan lus thabs ldan sgrub pa ste rjes chags kyi brtul zhugs nyid gtso bor byed pa'i tshul gyis lha bsgrub pa dngagasang ba' mchod pa dhu ti'i dbyings su rlung dang rtogs pa gsod cing gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i bde chen byang chub sems kyi mchod pa gtso bor byed pa dang rlung sems la rangadabang thob pa'i sgog gzugs tshob pa'i sgo nas las bsgrab pa dang: rdo rje'i lus kyi 'gal basmod phyag rgya 'gro 'dug gar du shes shing gzugs gyi phyag rgya la brten nas bde ba'i

sgo brtul zhugs grub pa'i lam gtso bor byed pa dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang bum pa can sogs kyis srog mi shig pa'i thig ler sgrub pa'i sngags gtso bor byed/ rdo sa kyi khyad par roX'abras bu ni snyegs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la rang lam gyi lam lnga dang sa bcu po nang gi thabs mkhas kyis myur du bsgrod nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdaganyid bde ba chen po sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub par 'gyur ro de'i sbyangs gzhi dbyings ye sras gsumaḥ sbyangs bya rtsa thig rlung gsum sbyongs byed bde stong gi rdzogasarim bsgom pa sbyangs 'bras rdo rje gsum mngon du 'gyur ba'oX rnam pa kun tu bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su blang nas dge rtsa chags bcas 'gro ba yongs la bsngo zhing smonalam rnam par dag pa gdab po drug pa ni bya brtsal blo las 'das pa'i rang byung ye shes la lam du byed par 'dod naḥde'i lta ba ni rang gi sems kyi rang byung gi ye shes ngo bostong pa nyid la dmigs mtshan thams cad ka nas dag cingaX rang bzhin gsal khyab chen po ste 'gags las 'das par lcan gyis grub pa dang de ltar ka dag dang lcan tshob

dbyer med pa'i chos nyid de'i rtsal las 'khor 'das thams cad 'char bas thugs rje kun khyab bdag nyid du bzhugs pa de nyidaX bskyed pa dang mtshan bcas rdzogs rim kyi thabs la mi ltos par bla ma'i don brgyud 'pho ba'i byin rlabs dang sems nyid rang sar ngo sprad pa'i man ngag gi bsal bzhag med pa'i chos nyid thad shar ngos zin par byasapa sa 'khor 'das thams cad de'i rgyan dang rol par 'char bas dgag sgrub spangs blang mi dgos par rang sar grol zhing rig pa 'gyur med mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang las nam mang mi g.yo bar byed pa'oḥ de ltar lta ba rtog nas sgom pa ni rig pa de kho na chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid mthar thugs pa yin pas de'i ngang la rang babs ye nas lhun gyisagrub pa la rtsol bas bsgom du med cing de'i don la nam gnas pa na yengs su ye nas med pa'i rang bzhin babs kyis bsam gtan la gnas pas rnam par rtog pa glo bur ba nide'i ngang du rang shar rang grol yin pa'i phyir sems gnas mi gnas rtsol sgrab mi dgos par thams cad rig pa'i dbang basbyar ba'oḥ sprod pa ni ched du rtsol ba'i dgag sgrab gang

phra yang med par snang srid thams cad rang byung ye shes kyi rol pa nyid la lhun 'byams shugs 'byung gi tshul gyis spyod pa byed pa yin noX nyams len rig payesheX nyid ngos zin pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i bsam gtan la sems 'dzin gyi rtsol ba ci yang mi dgos pa'o: de bzhin tu dkyil 'khor ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i dkyila'akhor rtsol med du lam du byed pa dngaX dbang ni rig pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur thob med pa'i chos nyid ngo sprod pa rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur ba gtso borabyed pas khyad par dngaḥ dam tshig chos thams cad rang byung ye shes nyag gcig gi ngang lhun gyis grub par gnas pa'i bya ba dang mi bya ba'i bsrung mtshams med par phyal b.raganas pa 'da' nyams las 'das pa'i khyad par dngaX sher ting ni bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis su med pa byang chub kyi sems shes shing de la goms pa gdang du gyur pa kho nasabasnen sgrab byed pa dngaḥ mchod pa ye nas mchod bya mchod byed med par de kho na nyid mnyam pa chen po'i mchod pa gtso bor byed pa dang phrin las sems kyi chos nyid la dbang

'byor ba nyid kyi rtsal snang las rab 'byams rtsol med du sgrub pa dngaḥ phyag rgya chos thams cad ye nas phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub pas rtsol ba med paraphyag rgya bzhi'i don dang ldan pa'i khyad chos dang sngags chos nyid rang byung gi ye shes la dbang 'byor ba'i gzhom med rdo rje nā dwa'i gsung dang ye nas ldan pa'i phyir ngag tu brjodapa med kyang ma gsung mnyam par bzhag la sngags kyi rgyal po ni don dang ldan cing tshig tu brjod pa thams cad kyang rdo rje'i glu dang gsung sngags kyi ngo bor gyur ba'i khyad par dngabaskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum gyi gzhung gi dgongs pas bslab pa'oḥ 'bras bu ni rig pa'i gzhi la sku gsum gyi yon tan ma brtsal lhun gyis grub pa nyid ji lta ba bzhinamangon du 'gyur ba'oX lam 'di'i zab khyad khreg chod cog bzhag bzhi'i ngang las ma g.yos par mig las ye shes 'od rtsa'i lam brgyud deX nam mkha' dwangs ba'i dbyings sunang gi dbyings dang rig pa'i gdang rtsol med mngon sum snang ba las gnad du gzir ba'i snang ba bzhi rdzogs nas gdos bcas kyi sngabs 'od gsal du dengs shing gdod ma'i

—— dbyings su sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i khyad chos yang yod doḥ 'di'i sbyangs bzhi ka dag lhun grubaX sbyangs bya kun gzhi yid chos bag chags sbyangs byedarig stong thig le nyag gcig la mnyam rjes kun tu brtson pa sbyangs 'bras ngo rang thugs rje'i gshis thog tu pheb pa'o bdun pa ni 'jig rten gyi chos la gdung theg chod cingabya ba btang ba'i rnal 'byor ba dag la dgongs brda' snyan brgyud kyi byin rlabs reg pa'i rdo rje slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pasaḥ tshogs ston rgya cher spros la gnas dbenapar slob ma rnams lus gnad rdo rje'i chos bdun bca' ru bcug laḥ rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas rdo rje bcas te sdig mdzub nam mkha' la gtad g.yon mnyam bzhag tubyas la lta stangs dang 'gyeng tshul ldan pas dgongs nyams bskyang te thol byung tshigs gsal gyi kye ho skal ldan sems kyi bu dag khyod rang gi rig pa mdun gyi nam mkha' lagatod cigaḥ bzo med du ce re yengs med du hrig ge 'gags med du wal le dmigs med du sa le ba de ga'i ngang du zhog cigaḥ cesalan gsum gdab de ltar bzhag pa'i dus

su blo khyad kyisaḥ la la rtog med du rjen neX spros med du har reX la la rig thog tu hrig ge la la sems stong gsal du chi chu re 'gags med kyi rang mdangs lhug geḥ la la reg pa rjen 'bol le bar med du zang thal le la la ngang gsal trig geX bar med phyam brdal leX la la stong phyad phyadaḥ gtad med du khrol khrol la la bde phyam phyamaḥ rangarod gsal leX la la snang sems 'dres nas snang ba phyir ma lusaḥ rig pa nang du ma lus par dbyer med du phyal le bas nyams 'charaḥ de la sogs pa'i nyams snang re mi 'charami srid pa'i gang ltar 'dug 'dri'oḥ de nas yang bla mas ngo sprod 'di ltar gdamasaX 'oX skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams sems ma bcos par lhan rnar bzhag pa'i dus kyi shes pa 2di la cer gyis ltos shig 'o khyod rang rnams kyi sems rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas ma bcos pa'i ngang la lhan ner gnas pa gcig mi gdug gamaḥ 'oX 'di ni zhi bar gnas tha zhes bya ba de yin no sems kyi ngo bo rig pa dngos ma yin da khyed rang gi sems gnas mkhan gyi ngo bo kho rang la ce re ltos dngaX dngos po dbyibs dang kha dog ci yi ngo bor

ro ma grub pa'i stong seng ba gcig 'dug gamaḥ 'oḥ 'di ni ngo bo stong pa zhes bya de yin noḥ deligadang ma 'gag par gsal seng nge rjen khrol le ba gciga'abyed gamaX 'di la rang bzhin gsal ba zhes bya ba yin no ༷ stong seng thab dang gdangs gsal rjen ne ba de gnyis dbyer mi phyed par hrig ge bar lhang nge ba rig ge ba brjod mishes pa'i sa le ba gcig gdug gamaḥ de la zung 'jug gnyug ma'i rig pa zhes bya ba'oḥdran spyo 'gags med du 'dug pa'i dran pa byung rgyalaX rtog pa zang thal du rgyu bas semasagashis grolaḥ dmigs pa'i gtad so dang bral ba'i dbu ma dmigs med0 phyag rgya ye shes kyis byin dbab pa'i phyag rgya chen po gting gsal ye shes kyi mtshan ma'i sbubs grolabs rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba yin noḥ yigam ho e ma hoḥ e ma hoḥ a ā āX rigs kyi bu rnams da lta'i shes rig ma bcos pa 'di la yid dpyod kyis bzo bcos rdul tsamayang ma byed par gtad med rang babs su zhog dang rtag chad mtha' grol gzung 'dzin ris med stsang stong dbyer medaḥ rang gsal 'dzin medaX sus kyang ma basmad pa'i rang

byung gi rig pa ye re ba gtad med yongs grol dmigs med rgya yan chen po 'di la bsam du medaḥ brjod du med 'pho 'gyur med re rtogs med spangs blang med blo semasamed blta ru medaḥ gnyen po medaX ting 'dzin med ci yang ma grub pa'i rang gsal rjen pa blo bcos las 'das pa 'i rang byung gi ye shes rang gsal baḥ gang gis kyang michod paḥ mi shig paḥ mi 'gyur baḥ mi 'gags paḥ 'gro 'ong med pa ཿ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i zung 'jug chen po brjod mi shis pa'i rig pa phyogs thams cad las rnamapar rgyal ba 'di nyid dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i klong chen po ye nas rang la gnas pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: de ltar chos nyid yul sems sprosapa las 'das pa'i ngang du ma lta ma bsgomaḥ ma dpyad ma bcosaḥ nges shes thams cad dang bral bar rang babs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang du zhog cigaX de ga'i ngang du dbang potshogs drag gi yul snang bzang ngan sna tshogs su 'char ba thams cad gsal la ma 'gags pa me 41nga ngos la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar snang yang de la bden par ma 'dzinaX sgru

phra mar ma 'dzin blos dag par ma 'dzinaX rang yal rjes med 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba lta bur shes par gyis shig rig pa'i rang rtsal las rtogatshorno phra rag bzang ngan gyi rnams pa ji ltar shar yang ma spangasaX ma dpyadaX ma bzungaḥ gang shar thams cad zhen med rang grol chen po chu dang rba rlabs lta bu rang dag rjesagazhig las 'das pa mkha' mnyam yangs pa chen po'i ngang du la bzla bar gyis shig de ltar na bu khyod mtshan ma'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las yongs su grol te rang byung gdodama'i dbyings su 'tshang rgya bar the tshom med doX rang ngo gshes thog 'phrod par byaX sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba yis rnal ma'i nyams len tshad du 'khyolaX spros dang spros medamanyam gzhag skyongs rang ngo shes pas rdzogs sangs rgyas ma rtog 'khrul gzhi ma rig pasaX khams gsum 'khor ba yongs su mchedaX bde sdug kun gyis gzhi ru gnasaX da ltayar mar sa mtshams 'diraḥ kun gzhi rang grol nyams len byaḥ srid pa bar do rang grol 'khyar ༷ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gnyis pa rmi lam bar do'i khrid 'khyal ba rang grol mun

khang sgron me btags pa lta bu'i man ngag la gsumaḥ nyin par sgyu lus kyi khrid snang ba rang grol dngaḥ mtshan mo rmi lam gyi khrid 'khrul ba rang grol dngaḥ rjes 'od gsal gyi khridagati mug rang grol dang gsum lasaḥ dang po la gnyis ma dag pa'i sgyu lus dngaX dag pa'i sgyu lus soḥ dang po ni mi med dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste ma namamakha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par byaḥ de'i ched du sgyu lus 'khrul snang rang grol 'di bsgom par bya'o snyams du sems bskyedaḥ rang girtsa ba'i bla ma de ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru mngon sum du bkra lam me ra mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas bzhugs par bsam la gsol ba lan gsum gdab tshe ngo sprod kyi gdams pagand byang ltar du gnang bar bsam la thun gcig 'dugaḥ yang snying khung rus pa'i gting nas ༷ bdag gi sgyu lus 'byong bar byin gyis brlabs du gsol sgyu ma lta bu'i rtogasapa bskyed par byin gyis rlabs du gsolaḥ ting nge 'dzin 'byur med 'byungs bar byin gyis rlabs du gsol bag chags kyi 'khri ba chod par byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ zhes

——1 gsol ba lan gsum gdab tsheX slar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam la smra bsam brjod med kyi ngang skyong bar bya'oX yang 'di snyams du semasasnang ba dkar dmar gyi gdab tshe 'di dag med la yod par bzungaḥ a 'thas bden grub du bltas dngos med dngos por 'thasaḥ de lta'i 'khrul ba 'di rtsad bcad nas medasnang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan sgyu ma lta bu la blo spyongs bar bya'oḥ dang po mdun du shing gcig btsug la der me long btags nas rang nyid brgyan chas bzang por spras nas bltasapas gzugs bzang po snang tsam sgyu ma lta bu la blo sbyangasaḥ mdzes pa'i ro gzugs la chags pa mdo med me long nang gi gzugs brnyan la chags pa dang 'dra'o snyams du bsam la 'khri ba bcadaḥ yang rgyan sdug hral hrul bsgos nas me long nang la bltas pas gzugs bsnyan dman pa la'ang snang tsam bden med sgyu ma lta bur blo spyongasaḥ dman pa'i rogazugs tha chad du blta ba'ang mdzes gzugs sgra ma dang 'dra mtshung bas thams cad ro stoms su bzhag go de ni lus sbya mar sprangs pa'oḥ yang lung stong zhig tu phyin la smra zhig

bsgrags nas brag cha 'byung tshe che brjod byaX de bden med grags stong yin pa la blo sbyangasaX yang ngan smad byas te grags stong skad cig ma snying po ci yang med pa la blo sbyongs 'di snyams du sems ngas smra tshig la rang mtshan du bltas bltas thams cad snying po med pa brag cha dang 'dra bas 'dis baspusaḥ da ni sgra tshig ro snyoms su nges par 'byeng b.rabya'oḥ snyams du yang yang sems ngag sgra sgyu mar sbyangs ba'oḥ yang rang babs su bzhag te smig rgyu mthong ba'am yid kyis bsam te thog reg snying po ci mchis snyams du yang yangasemasaḥ de ma grub snang tsam la blos gzhig nas ngas dran bsam gyi rtog tshogs thams cad 'di dang 'dra'oḥsted snang sgyu ma blo 'dis baspus baspusaḥ da ni rang grol kha yan lagatong rgyu las dug gsum bden med shes pas mtshang grol bar bya'o snyams du yang yang sems ༷ mdor na rnam pa kun tu lus snang la rang bzhin med par gzugs brnyan lta burablo sbongasaX ngag sga grags tshad rang bzhin med pa brag cha lnga bur blo sprangs sems byang tshor bde sngag bar ma'i rtog tshogs smig rgya lta bur blo sbongs bar bya'oḥkhyad par sgo

badz+ra gsum gyi bya ba 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu mar sbyangasaX snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa rmi lam ltar du sbyangasaḥ gnas 'gyur 'gro ba'ibams dri zas grong khyer du sbyangs lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya spyod smig rgyu brag cha gzugs brnyan lta bur sbyangs snang tsam chu zla dang 'khrul snang mig yor a 'thas chu sbu lta burasbyangs med snang sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul sprul pa lta bur shes pas yang yang bden med bsgomaḥ dngos su grogs la smrar bcug des rtog pas gcun la bden 'dzin gyis mtshangabashigasaḥ bar bar rkyen dang sprad la bden med du rtsal sbyangasaḥ chags sdang gi mtshan 'dzin phug blor zhi nges pa'i bar rtsal yang yang sbyangs nasaḥ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya bathams cad sgyu ma'i dpe bcu dang 'dra bar rtogs tshe rgyud la skyes pa'oḥ yid sems sgyu mar sbyangs ba ste don gsum gyi ma dag sgyu lus 'byong bar bya'oX gnyis pa niḥ 'gro ba'i donal sems bsted cing bla ma'i rnal 'byor basbom la gsol ba yang yang btab nas thugs yid bsres la mnyam par bzhag de nas lus smil tshong dang ldan pas mnyam gzhag lta

stangs bya khri gdan mdzes par bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyan chas mdzes par spras la bzhugs su gsolaX de nas slob ma rnams kyis man shel sbyar nas bla ma rdo rje sems ) pa' la bltas pas 'ja' 'od lnga klong rdor sems gnyis brtsegs dang sum brtsegs kyi tshul du 'char ro sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de blo yul du lam mer bsgomaḥ de nas sta sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la blo gom tshe rang gi lus la bstems zhingaḥ rang lus de ltar sgyu mar gsal la yang yang sbyangs snod bcud thams cad zhing khams dang lhar bsgom zhing gsal nas 'byangs ba la nges par brtson noX de ni dag pa'i sgyu lus sbyangs ba yin te rtsal rdzogs par gyur naḥ bar do zhi khro rab 'byams shar dus su nges par grolaḥ skye gnas bar do'i nyams len la'ang 'di gal cheX rmi lam dang chos nyid bar do'i sngon 'gro ni 'di la rag las pas shin tu 'bad par bya dgos ma dag sgyu lus ni srid 4 bar do'i sngon 'gro mchog yin pas shin tu gces skya lus zhen pa rang grol gyi khrid doḥ gnyis pa mtshan mo rmi lam gyi khrid la rmi lam bzung baḥ smral zhing bsgrur ba

ge rdo gegs bsal ba'oḥ dngaponi rmi lam gyi snang ba nyin mo'i bag chags kyis khrid pa yin pas nyin snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur sbyangs nas khong duchud par bya zhingaḥ ngag nas kyang rmi lam yin no zhes brjod rmi lam gyi snang cha kho na yin pa'i 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su bya'oḥde nas srod dus mnal du phyogs tshe ma namamakha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin nyams su blang nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob bar bya: de'i ched du rmi lam sbyangs snyams dusems bskyed cingaX gzhog g.yas sar phab mgo byang du bstanaḥ lag g.yas gyi mthil gyis mgo gdan byaḥ g.yon daphyi steng du bzhagaḥ sngas yi dam du gsal snang dang bcas tebasgomaḥ ma gsal na yin na snyams pa'i nga rgyal byaḥ lus su bla ma rin po che mngon sum du bzhugs par mos la zhabs spyi bor blang nas yod par bsnyamasaX mgrin par gu ru rin po che tshon gang ba 'dzum zhal can snang la rang bzhin ma grab pa zhig la sems gtad deḥ bla ma dang o rgyan pad+ma mkhyen noḥrmilam zen par byin gyis brlabs du gsol rmi

lam rang ngo shes par byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ bag chags zag pa zad par byin gyis brlabs du gsolaX ces lan gsum brjod laḥ seng ge'i nyal thabs su byas te rmi lam rmilam du ngo shes par bya'o snyams pa'i 'dun pa drag po'i ngang bskyang nas 'khrul rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid du 'gro bar bya'oḥ lan rer ma zin na'ang yang yang bskyarazhing 'dun pa drag por sbyangs la nan tan du bya'oḥ sad tsa na mdangs rmi lam snang ba thams cad da lta gcig kyang mi 'dug de dang 'dra bar de rang nyin snang thams cad do nub rmilam du gcig kyang med pas snang ba gnyis ka rmi lam tsam las ma grub pas sgyu ma yin no rmi lam yin no snyams pa'i 'dun pa la yang yang sbyangasaḥ de lan mang du bsgom kyang mazin na gzhan sngar dang 'dra rang yi dam rdo rje sems dpa' zhig bsgom pa'i mgrin par ting 'dzin sems dpa' nam mkha'i mdog can tshon gang ba gcig gsal ye re ba lashes pa drag tu gtad la rmi lam rmi lam du shes par bya'o snyams pa'i 'dun pa drag pos gnyid logaX des kyang zin par dka' na mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi ba'i dbus su

——1 maḥmadun dus g.yas su na rgyab du taḥ g.yon du ra ra dang bzhi bsgom laḥ dang po dbus kyitsa la 'dun pa gtadaḥ de nas gnyid tham thom du mdun gyiphal shes pa gtadaX gnyid du zin nye tshe g.yas kyin la gtad gnyid cher yur tsa na rgyab kyis la gtadaḥ gnyid khrul 'gro tsa na g.yon gyi raX la gtadaḥ gnyid dus dbus kyi.oḥl gtad nas rtog pa gzhan gyi bar ma chod par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bzung la mnal bas rmi lam zin noḥ yig 'bru rnams mi gsal zhing des kyang ma zin na mgrin par 'odakyi theg le gsal ye re ba gcig la dmigs pa gtad cing rmi lam gyi 'dun pas gnyid log par byas na zin noḥ dmigs pa de rnams res mos su bsgom zhing nyin snang rmi lamadu 'dun pa yang yang sbyangs bas zla gcig tshun chad la rmi lam zin par 'gyur roḥ deyang dang po rmi lam mang du 'groḥ de nas je gsal la 'groX de nas zin par nges soḥ de yang 'jigs skags kyi rkyen gcig la brten nas rmi lam yin no snams du ngos zin par saḥ rang shugs su zin dka' zin na bstan pa yin noḥ thabs de dag gis kyang ma zin

na dam tshig chags nyams yod pas bskang bshags dang yig brgyaḥ tshogs bsagasaḥ phyag skor sgrib sbyangs la 'badaḥ grib la'ang 'dzem shing yang sngar ltar bsgom pas nges parazin no ༷ gnyis pa niḥ rmi lam zin pa'i dus su da lta rmi lam gyi dus yin pas gang du'ang bsgyur du rung snyams du rmi lam du 'dre'i cho 'phrul spre'u 'am mi khyi la sogs pa gang byung ba deyi dam gyi lhar bsgom pas der 'gyur ro yang de mang du sprul zhing gang 'dod pa der bsgyur ba la bslab par byaX yang rmi lam zin pa'i tsheḥ shar mngon par dga' ba'amaḥ nubaphyogs o rgyan gyi zhing sogs la 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po gtad pas ༷ der 'gro zhing chos zhu nus pa dngaḥ klu dang sa bdag gi gdon gyi cho 'phrul la khyung sprul nas btul nus padang sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul du rta mgrin sprul nas btul ba dngaḥ la de ru bsgyur nus pa sbyangs bar bya'oḥ gzhan yang mang po gcig tu bsdu ba dngaX gcig mang por spel bsogs la sbrang ngoḥ yang rmi lam thog brdzis bya ba la bslab pa ni: rmi lam zin tsa na chu chen po' 'gram du phyin laḥ bdag rmi lam yid kyi lus yin pas chu'i khyer ba med pa

—— bsnyams pas chur mthong bas chu'i khyer ba med par bde stong du phril phril 'char ro dang po bdag tu 'dzin pas the tshom na'ang goms tshe yang yang mi 'byungangoḥ de bzhin tu me dang g.yang sa gad brag 'phrang gzar gcan zan la sogs pa thams cad la de'i thog brdzis byas pas thams cad ting nge 'dzin du 'char roḥ de dag 'byungaba'i gnad nyin snang du sgyu lus la sbyangs shing rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po yang yang bzhagaḥ gnyid khar bla ma'am yi dam yig 'bru thig le gang zin pa de la dmigs pa gtad pagal che zhing bag chags 'khrul 'byams kyi bar ma chod pa shin tu gces so gsum pa la bzhi sad 'byamasaḥ brjed 'byams 'khrul 'byamasaX stong 'byams soḥ dang po 2 las dang po bas rmi lam yin no snyams nas ngos zin ma thag gnyid yal ba sad 'byams moX de sel ba la dmigs pa snying kha man chad la bzung zhing rkang mthil gnyis su munapa'i yi ge bya ba thig le nag po sran 'ja tsam la sems gtad de gnyid pas sel loḥ gnyis pa ni yang rmi lam zin pa dngaX de ka la 'khyal zhig rmi lam rang ka mar 'gro ba'o

de sel ba la nyin par sgyu lus sbyang zhing rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po la goms par byaḥ gnyid khar yang rmi lam rmi lam du shes shing ma 'khrul b.log cingaX rmi lam zin dus su ma 'khrul bar sa 'dzin no snyams pa'i dran pa brtan po byas pas sel loX gsumapa ne+e bag chags ngan pas 'a( sa ma zin na nyin par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po dang sgyu lus la nan cher sbyangasaX sgrib sbyangs bskang bshagasaḥ tshogs bsags la 'badaḥlus tshugs bsrengs 'od gsal gyi rgyun bskyangs ba'i sel lo bzhi pa ni 'dun pa drag po'i gnyid yar ba dngaḥ shes pa ting nas gnyid thu nga ba na ོ 'a ོ ge ‘

——1 zhen ma chod nas 'du 'dzi la g.yang chos brgyad la 'khyolaḥ tha mal ba ltar du khrel gyi song nas dred po chos rus mkhan du red pasaX gzhan gyi chos dnganyams len gang byed pa thams cad la dag snang mi skyeḥ log lta bskur 'debasaḥ nga yang rtogs pa 'di 'dra 'byung yang da 'di ltar gol bas thams cad de dang 'dra'o zhes logapar gyer stong lta bshad rgyu 'bras 'chol ba sogs ni dred por 'byams pa'oḥ de sel thabs ni dal 'byor rted dka' bsgomaX 'chi ba mi rtag drag dran bskul 'khor ba'inyes dmigs la bsam paḥ dben gnas ri khrod la spro ba bskyed cing rtse gcig tu badren paX bsnyen sgrub dang sgyu lus sbyangs ba rmi lam sbyangs ba la 'bad pas sngar gyi nyamasartogs sor chud nas rmi lam yang zin par 'gyur ro: gzhan yang nyams rtogs kyi rkyen bla ma la mos gus med na rmi lam mi zin0 dam tshig nyams na mi zinaX goms pa chungan mi zinaḥ gdams pa'i gnad med na mi zin pas de'i bcos thabs shes pa gal cheḥ de ltar rmi lam bar do 'di sbangs pas chos nyid dang srid pa bar do yang rmi lam 'dra bar

bar do ngos zin nas grol bar 'gyur ro rmi lam lan bdunangos zin na bar do ngos zin par 'gyur la rmi lam zin pa de rgyun du brten pa dang: rmi lam 'od gsal du brgyuraba'i gti mug rang grol 'od gsal gyi rgyun mnyam bzhag gi 'od gsal gyi rgyun dang kha sbyor nas yang yang bsgom par bya'oX goms pa'i rtsal 'byung tshe 'od gsal gyi ngo bo ni rtogapa rgyun chad de gnyid du song na'ang rmi lam gyi dngos po gsal stong nam mkha' dwangs ba'i dkyil lta bu yul med de rjen par gnas pa yin te gnyid sad kyi rgyu yod pa tsam las ting 'dzin 'khor yug tu 'ong ba'o nyams kyi 'od gsalani gnyid du song yang mthong snang zin par mngon sum ltar rang gi gnasaḥ lung pa yul khams la sogs pa gsal bar mthong zhingaḥ ma gnyid do snyams na ni sad rgyu yod doḥ gnyid do snyams na khyim nang gi kwa cha yo byad thams cad gsal bar mthong ba'oḥ de la rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gyi rgyas thebs na mchog tu gyur te bar dor grol bar nges pa'oḥ 'di'i sbrangs gzhi chos nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de'iX sprangs bya bag chags ban bun gyi 'khrul snang ngoX sbongs

byed sgyu lus sprul bsgyur 'od gsal loḥ sbyangs 'bras sgrib med mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur ba'o sa ma yā nga grol dwa phrug ma dang 'phrad pa'am mi gsal ba gsal 'debs pa sgeg mo'i me ma nga la blta ba lta bu'i man ngag la gsumaḥ nam 'phrod par bya ba dang thag gcig thog tu bcad de rig pa rkyang ded kyis mnyams rjes bsre ba dang gdeng grol thog tu bca' 1dang po ni dben par sgo gsum bag pheb nas bde bar 'dug steḥ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangams bskyedaX dkon mchog kun 'dus gyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che mkhyen noḥ skyabs su mchi'oḥ thugs rjes bzung du gsol zhes

tsheḥ bla ma'i zhal nas ngo sprod gdams rjes su bzung bar bsam la thugs yid bsres mnyam par bzhag goḥ de nas phyi'i nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings su nang gi nam mkha' rtsastong pa mig dang 'brel ba de'o gsang ba'i nam mkha' tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas khang dang gsum mo lam dus su shes rig mig dang bsreḥ mig nam mkha' la gtadaX stongagasal rjen ye re ba'i ngang du grangs mang yun thung ngu rjen dzaḥ sang nge shigs seḥ khrol le zang ma de ga'i ngang skyong bar bya'oḥ rtog pa shar grol la song bying rmugs 'thib rkyonadang bral ma 'gags bar med du yan pas rang bzhag chen po la gnas yun bsreng bar bya'o thun mtshams su thon tshe har langs mi bya bar dran pa'i rgyun brten nas ngang mashor bar spyod lam skyong bar bya'o gang snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dngaḥ gang shar la gcer gyis bltas pas 'dzin med rang zhig mos gus dang dag snangaḥ bsngo ba dngasmon lam gyis rgyas gdab bcas pa nan tan gyis 'dab par bya'oX gnyisapa ni stan bde ba la sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu sprags su btang nas bag pheb par gnas shing bla ma yid

da rdo la dran bzhin gsol ba lhang lhang btab nas dbang bzhi blang la thugs yid bsre bar byas la rang babs su bzhag goḥde nas rang gi sems nyid 'di rangababs su ci yang mi bsam par bzhag nas dran pa'i rgyun bskyangs tshe btang snyom lung ma bstan gyi shes pa mun ne thom me ba zhig byung ngo 'di la de shes 'di shes kyi lhag mthongazang ma yang ma skye pa'i ma rig pa'amaX 'di 'dra 'di yin gyi ngos bzung smra ma shes pas lung ma bstan pa dngaXci la gnas dang ci bsam med pa'i tha mal btang snyamasaXdon lakun gzhi'i ngang du tha mal rang gar bsdad pa yin pas sgom gyi dngos gzhi ni ma yin kyang bzhag thabs 'di 'dra ba la brten nas mi rtog ye shes 'char dgos so cir yang ma dran ma 'gyus pa'i shes pa thom me ba de 'dra sems kyi myong bas shes rab kyi phyi gdangasaḥshes pa gcer mthong tsam yin gyi rang byung ye shes dngos ni ma yin no de 'dra'i donashes mkhan dang mi bsam par 'dug mkhan kho rang la babs kyis bltas pas 'byu dran bral ba'i rig pa phyi nang med par zang thal le ba nam mkha' dwangs ba lta bu dngaX phyong bya

myong byed gnyis med rang gi rang bzhin rang gis kho thag chod nas 'di las gzhan ci yang mi 'dug snyams pa byung naḥ de la bsam brjod gyi 'di 'dra zhes smrar med pas mtha'abral brjod 'das dngaḥ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal dngaḥ rang rig rang gsal byang chub kyi sems zhes bya baḥ rang ngo 'phrod pas ye shes shar bas dmu thom me ba'i mun pa dwangs denam lang nas khyim nang mthong ba ltar rang gi chos nyid la nges shes skyes pa na ma rig rgong nga'i zubs 'byed pa dngaX chos nyid de lta bu ni rang bzhin babs kyi ye nas gnas pasargyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa dang dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa yin par shis shing de las gzhan du gyur pas sems rang mtshan du gyur pa ni yod par mi dgos soḥ snga ma munathom me ba brjod du med kyang kho thag ma chod pa yin laḥ rig ngo la brjod du med kyang brjod med kyi don la the tshom med pa'i kho thag chod pas khyad mig med dang mig ldan ltaradabye ba che bas kun gzhi chos sku'i dbye ba'i gnad kyang 'dir 'dus soḥ lar sems ngos ngang du rang babs su bzhag tshe gsal tsam rig tsam sbongs rgyar byas te yid shes kyi

—11 gsal lo snyams pa'i ngang du 'jog pa dngaX yang stong cham me ba shes pa stong seng ba lta bu la sems 'dzin mkhan kyang 'ga' yangaḥ 'di gnyis ka yid shesakyi cha gzung 'dzin gyi nyams la zhen pa tsam yin pasaḥ de'i gsal stong gi babs dang 'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa dran 'dzin gyi rgyud breng nge ba de'i babs la bltas pas gzunga'adzin du zhen pas rnam shes kyi rten phur byung nas ye re ba gsal stong mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i rang bab kho thag chod de dngas sangs nge ba byung na de la rig ngo skyongs zhes bya la 'dzin pa can gyi nyams kyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig pa ye shes rjen par shar bas na srid pa'i drwa ba gcod pa zhes bya'oḥ yid dpyod nyams kyi sbun pa sna tshogs dang bral ba'irig pa 'bras sne'u lta bu chos nyid rang babs rang gsal gyi sgo nas ngos zin par bya ba dngaḥ rig pa'i babs ngo shes pa tsam gyi mi chog par de ga'i ngang du gom pa'i gnas chabastan dgos pas shes pa rang babs bzhag pas dran rgyan ma yeng bar sgongs ba gal che re 'ga' ci yin med pas mi rtog min poḥ bar skabs lhag mthong gi dwangs cha thon

pas mi rtog zang thal yang bde nyams zhen pa can dang res zhen medaḥ yang gsal nyams 'dzin pa can dngaḥ dngas gsal 〈snags med 'dzin bralaḥ res rtsub nyams mi sdug padang yang 'jam nyams yid 'ong du 'char ba dang re dga' rnam rtog cher 'tshub phyir 'brang nas sgom ltor shor ba dang bar bar 'thib dwangs mi byed pas rtogs pa can sogasa'abyung ba yang ༷ thog med nas gom pa'i rnam rtog dang las rlung gi rba rlabs sna tshogs nges pa dang tshad bzung med par 'byung ba niḥ lam rang por zhugs nas bde gzar sna tshogasakyi gnas mthong ba dang 'dra bas gang shar ched 'dzin dang bral bar brkyang ngoḥ lhag par ma goms pa'i dus na rnam rtog sna tshogs me ltar 'bar ba la g.yo ba'i nyams des masun paraḥ grim lhod ran pos rgyun ma btang bar brkyang na thob gom bstan pa mthar phyin gyi bar rim par 'byung ngoX khyad par gyi zab gnad sems dang rig paḥ kun gzhi dngazos skaX rnam shes dang ye shes kyis khyad par bla ma'i man ngag gis nyams myong gi steng nas ngo 'phrod pa zhig gal che bas de gdengs du byas nas smongs dus su chu ma brkul na

—— dngas ba ltar rnam shes rang sar bzhag pa de'i chos nyid rang byung du gsal ba'i man ngag gtso bor bya dgos soḥde las bdag gis bsgom rgyu rnam shes yeshes gang yin zhes spangs blang gis dpyad ra dang dpe che'i go rtog gi 'du shes spel bar mi bya steḥdes ni zhi lhag gnyis ka cung zad sgrib par 'gyur ba yin noḥrang babs su'ajog pas dran pa'i rgyun bstan pas zhi gnas kyi gom cha dngaḥrang ngo rang gsal du shes pa'i lhag mthong rang shugs kyi 'bral ba'i tshul du goms pa bstan por song ba na rangabab ye gnas kyi zhi lhag gamaḥrang bzhin 'od gsal gyi zhi lhag ye nas dbyer med pa rang byung gi ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa 'char bar 'gyur ba de la mkha' ltaramanyam pa nyid kyi man ngag rnam par dag pa'oḥdeni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid dang tha dad med pa gnyug ma don gyi 'od gsal yang yin noḥdes na rang bzhag dang rang ngo shesapa'i rig pa'i sems kyi ngo bo sgrong tshul 'di gnad brgya 'dus pa'i 'gags mdo man ngag dam pa yinaḥrgyan du'ang de smongs la gom tshad ni mtshan mo dang rjes thob kyi 'od gsal

la brtagasaḥ nyams len gnad du song ngam dad dang snying rje dag snang mos gus shes rab sogs la dpyad pas rang shugs kyis 'khrungs shing 'phel bas rtogs bde la tshegasachung ba ni rang gi nyams su myong bas shes par 'gyuraḥ zab cing myur ba ni shin tu 'bad rtsol chen po'i bsgrub pa'i lam gzhan la zhugs pa'i skyes bu rnams dang rtog tshad bsdurabs gsal ba dang rang sems 'od gsal bsgom pas 'bras bu thob rgyu'ang de'i steng gi rnam rtog de'i bag chags kyi dri ma rang sangs la grol nasaḥ mkhyen gnyis rtsol med durgyas nas gdod ma'i mgon po'i rgyal srid thob pa yin noḥ gsum pa ni de ltar ngo rang thog du sprad pa de'i thog tu byar med blo 'das bsgom med gcig thog tu bzhag nas sgomapa'i dus suX nyon mongs pas rtog tshogs gang shar gang 'gyu thams cad gcer mthong rang grol du 'gags med du sharaḥ zhen med du rol rten med du grol ba rang byung ye shesakyi dum bur ngo 'phrod pas cir snang sgom du 'charaX gang shar ye shes su grolaX sgom pa la sogs su btsal ma dgos par zhi gnas sems 'dzin 'jur bu gshis sangs la grol

—— rnam rtog skad cig skye med du grol ba rtog tshogs ci snyed pa skye med du grol bas na rtog tshogs la rgyas gdab mi dgos par skye med rig pa'i ye shes lalabazlos shig rtog pa spangs ba'i pha rol na rang byung ye shes btsal du'ang medaḥ rtog pa sgrub pa'i rang ngo na rang byung ye shes ngos bzung ba'ang med rtog pa dang rtog med lasa'adas par gcer byung rtog med 'bar ba lags soḥ gdeng grol thog tu bca' ba dngos gzhi la bzhi ste ༷ rtog pa gang zhig skyes kyang ga sa ye grol du gnas pas da grol gzhizhig bskyar du med rtog pa kho rang gi kho rang la sus kyang ma bsgral bas rang gi rang grol bas gnyen po gzhan gyis bkrol du med rtog pa kho rang gi kho rang la cer gyis bltasapas rang bzhin gang yang ma grub la cir yang mthong rgyu med pas cer grol du grol bas tshug mi thubaḥ rtog pa shar grol byung rgyal du thal thal skyes pa rang byung du skye med 'gagasamed grol med la 'dug pas grol ba'ang yongs grol du lhag ger grol bsaḥ gcig stes ye grol gnyis ste rang grolaḥ cer grol yongs grol du 'dug goḥ da sngon grol tshul ma

rtog pas tha snyad 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo 'byams la grol ba'i dus ma byungaX da grol lugs gzhi'i don mthong grol ba la nges shes skyes pas sems 'dzin rtod phur gyi sgom gyi cibyed shar tshad rang grol la thongasaḥ phyal bar zhog cigaX grol bzhi yang bla ma'i gdams zab kyis gsar sgrub min khyed cag pho sgo mtho bas rnyed pa minaḥ kha rje che bas glo bur durted pa minaḥ ye nas snang sems thams cad gshis grol lugs chen po gzhir gnas kyang 'dzin pas bcing nas ngo ma shes pa'oX 'khor bar 'khyams kyang grol lugs chen pobazhi las nam yang 'da' ma myongaX 'da' mi srid 'da' bar mi 'gyur roḥ de bsarang rig stong gsal gyis ltos dngaḥ snang shes thams cad rig pa'i grogs su shar ba ngo mtshar cir snang yul med zang thal du 'dug pa ha haX rig stong zang ma kun grol gyi ltos dang rang gi gnyen por rang che ba 'di ngo mtsharaḥ nyon mongs spangs med rang grol du thal ba hahaḥ rig stong ye grol kun khyab la stos dang 'bad med rtsol bral 'bras bu rnyed pa 'di ngo mtsharaḥ gcig zin pas 'khor 'das dag mnyam du thal ba ha haḥ lta ba rang byung gi

—1rdo ye shes la ltos dngaX dge sdig lta bsgom las 'das pa ngo mtsharaX tha snyad gzhi med du 'dug pas phan gnod dang bral ba ha haḥ gshis lugs ma bcosapar ltos dang snang lugs bsgyur bkod dang bral bar ngo mtsharaX bde sdug mi g.yo bas ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pas ha haX kun 'byung ye shes 'gags med la ltos dang dranabasam shugs 'byung gi spyod pa sna tshogs ngo mtsharaḥ thams cad 'gags med kyi klong las skye med du grol ba ha haX des na rtog pa rang sar grol ba las lta ba medaḥ ma yengs rangabazhag bsgom pa las bya rtsol medaḥ rang byung rang sar grol ba las 'bras bu medaḥ des na bcing grol dang bral ba'i ngo bo sa cir yang spangs blang med par chos nyid rang kharayan zhing bsal bzhag bral ba rin chen gser gling phyin ltar thams cad chos nyid stong pa chen por grol nas sgom 'khrul dmigs 'dzin mtha' dag rang sar grol te bar do medapar sangs rgyas pa yin noḥ de yang rabs gdeng kyi grol lugs bzhi mngon du gyur te tshe 'di la zag pa dang bcas te phung po mi snang bar chos skur sangs rgyasaX 'bring 'chi khar

ma pang bu 'jug pa'am chos nyid bar dor rang ngo shes nas longs skur sangs rgyasaḥ tha ma srid pa'i bar dor sprul sku'i zhings khams la dbugs dbyung ste sangs rgyasaḥ yangathabs mngal sgo bzang po zhig bsdom nas skye ba gcig blang te chos rdzogs pa chen por 'phrad nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro de yang lam 'di'i sbyangs gzhi chos sku dri bral chen po: sbyangs bya btang snyoms lung ma bstanaḥ sbyongs byed rig stong zang mar ngo 'phrod nas bsgom pa sbyangs 'bras sku gsum gyi ye shes la longs spyod pa'oḥ las can skal ldan bud nga 'phrad par re gaḥ sa ma yuḥ spyi don bzhi pa 'chi kha bar do'i khrid rgyal po'i bka' them bskur ba lta bu'i gdams ngag la ༷ dus la bab pa'i 'pho ba dngaḥ lam dus su sbyangasapa la 'bad pa dngaḥ 'chi ltas brtags pa dngaḥ man ngag 'chi bsluḥ lus la sbyor ba'oḥ dngapo'i dal 'byor thob kyang lam log 'khrul bar 'phyan nas mi tshe stong zad la btang mi dge bcu la dus 'da'aḥ dkar po'i yon tan gyi sma phabaX nag po'i las kyi gzings bstodaḥ dbang gral du 'tshang la mkhon 'dzin slongaḥ dam tshig 'chal nas bla ma dang

——1 'galaḥ grogs la 'gran sems byas sgrub po'i zas nor 'phrogaḥ dad pa can gyis 'dun pa bshigasaḥ bsod nams can gyis tshogs bsags bcad bshad sgrub zab mo'i sgo bshigs mtshams med pa'i las sna re bsags pa'i gang zag nyes pa can dag 'chi nad kyi btab nas dbugs ngar la thugs pa dang 'phrad tsheX bla mal gsol ba 'debasaḥ yi dam chos skyong ra mdar sbran sangs rgyas byang sems la snyan gsan phab bde gshegs ngan song thams cad sbyongs ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/sdig po che 'di btsan thabs su 'pho bar mdzad du gsolaḥ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'dren mdzad lcags kyu can la phyag 'tshal loX sdig po che 'di btsan thabs su sangs rgyasari dbang spos dri bsnams pa be+eḍūr+ya'i 'od ltar snang ba sman gyi bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo sdig po che 'di btsan thabs sangs rgyas gser 'od snang ba dam pa'i rtog ldan rin chenagatsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo sdig po che btsan thabs su lan bdun re brjod la shes pa rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs gar bsre 'pho bya'oḥ thabs des ngan song gi ste sgo kheg

mtho ris thar ba thob phan yon shin tu che gnyis pa ni khrid gyi dus sam 'pho ba'i dgos khrid lam khyer gyi dus gang rung la dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' la bsam nas 'khorab la yid skyo nges su sbyangs ring du gnas khoms med pa'i 'chi ba la yang yang bsam de nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug sems dpe'i skyil krung dang ldan pas 'di snyams dusemasaX tshe yi 'du byed zadaḥ sman dpyad rtsis bon gyis bsgyur du ma btub par 'chi ba'i dus bab yid la byaX dngangs skrags gis zin tshe rgyal po'i bkan phrin lta bu'i man ngagabyung phyir bla ma rdo rje 'chang spyi gtsug gi nam mkha' la mngon sum du byon nas bzhugs par bsam la gnad byang ltar gsol ba yang yang btab tshe bla ma'i zhal nas 'pho ba'izhal them gnang bar bsam moX de nas 'khor ba'i sgo 'gags pa niX lus drangs por bsrang lag gnyis sa gnon phyag rgyas pus mo gnyis bkabaḥ dpung pa bskyang de nasarang gi sming gar tram̐ mazing 'od zer dang lngan par gsalaḥ tram̐ mthing gcig chad gshang lam du 'phros dmyal smo dgags par bsam yang hūṃ dmar 'phros srid sgor song yi

tsha dwags kyi sgo 'gags par bsamaX yang hūṃ ljang 'phros chu lam dud 'gro'i sgo bkagasaḥ hūṃ ser gcig spros lte ba 'dod lha'i sgo dgagasaX yang hūṃ smug ser/zla kha lha min sgo 'gagasaX yang hūṃ ljang sngon zung spros sna bug g.yon mi lus gtsang ma dang g.yas gnod sbyin gyi sgo 'gagasaX yang hūṃ ser ljang zung spros rna ba gnyis gzugasakhams kyi sgo 'gagasaX yang hūṃ dmar ser zung spros mig gnyis 'khor bsgyur gyi sgo bkags par bsam moḥ hūṃ de rnams bkrag mdangs ldan pa nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa:sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung bkag nas bsil bu tsam yang mi rgyu bar bsamaX sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po' lam spyi bor tshang bug nas nyaḥdakar po mgo thur du bstan nasabakags par bsamaḥ lus kyi dbu ma rtsa mda' snyugs 'bring po'i tshad tsam drangs srab snum gsal gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan paḥ dkar dmar mthing ga'i kha dog 'char ba mar snelte 'og du 'gags paX rlang gis dwangs ma ljang sma ye gis mtshan mchanaX yar sde tshang bug tu zug paX g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang gnyis mar sne gcig tu lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus

mdor rig pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar la 'tsher baḥ gsal la dngas baḥ dbugs kyis kyin 'phar lhab lhabaḥ yar la khad yod par bsamaḥ spyi bor steng gi nam mkha' la gonganas spyos ltar bla ma rin po che rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su 'dzum mu le byin thib thib bkrag yer yer bzhugs par bsam la lus shed ro stod la bsgrimasaḥ gshang lam drag tubasdams mig gyen la bzlog lce ya gan la sbyar lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin lag gi 'phar rtsa mnan bzhin khu tshur drag tu bcalaḥ lte 'og nas yar drag tu 'phenabazhin ngag nas hikaḥ hikaX zhes khong shed dang ldan pas yar drangs bas 'og rlung gi thig le de yar dpag te dbu ma'i lam nas hri li li yar drangs nas hika sgra bdun gyisaste bar drangs yang hika sgra bdun gyis snying garaḥ de nas bdun gyis mgrin pa: de nas bdun gyis smin mtshams su de nas hika zhes tshang bug gi nya de la gtugs thug pa dang yang thig le mar babs te lte 'og tu ngang 'byil ler gnas par bsamaḥ cung zad ngal bsoX de ltar lan mang por sbangs bas 'pho ba thebs rtags su tshang bug tu drod tsha chil

dze gyi 'ong ba dngaḥ g.yo ba za ba sbrid paḥ skrang ba chu ser thon pa dngaX khrag thon pa la sogs pa 'byung de'i tshe bla ma'i tshang bug legs par btsal nas rmabyas dngas sam 'jag ma btsug pas ltems se nub par gyur la de ni 'pho ba 'byung ba'i rtag yin teḥ de tsam gyi tshad ma bzung na tshe srog gis bskul mar 'gro bas dmigasapa'i 'phro bcad nas spyi bor 'bru mar gyi bsku mnye bya rtags ma byung na rtsol ba drag pos yar 'dren grangs mang du byas pa'i rtags 'byung ngoḥ tshang bug ma rnyed na tshang bug gi kha'ihaṃ phyes nas thig le tshang bug nas yar rgyangs se thon pa dang bla ma'i zhabs pad la gtugs yang tshang bug nas mar byung ste lte bog tu gnas par bsam pa lan 'gar brtsonapas tshang bug phyeḥ khrag chu ser 'dzag 'jag ma btsug na zug par 'gyur roḥ tshang bug haṃ gis bkags pa ni tshe srog mi nub pa'i phyir roḥ hika tshe bstung bas sngags te 'pho bathebs par brjod la rtags byung nas hika 'dren par mi bya'oḥ rtag par sbangs drag pas shes pa yar la khadaX rnam shes stod du 'tshangs ba dang mgo yu 'khor ba sogs byung na

rkang mthil la khu tshur bsnun rkang mthil gnyis su gser gyi mchod rten lci ba la dmigs pa drag tu gtadaḥ 'bebs mang du byas pas zhi bar 'gyur roḥ de ni sbyangs ba'i 'pho bsteḥ nad med cing 'chi ltas ma byung nas snga thog nas gnad du bsnun par bya dgos soX gsum pa ni nam 'chi cha med pas 'chi ba brtags dgos pasaX bla ma dang tshe bdag riga'adzin rnams la gsol ba gdabaX rang lus la khrus dang gtsang sbra byas nasaḥ drang sgong bden par grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal loX rten 'brel mi baspu bar brtags pa'i bzang na gyi ltas bstan du gsol lan gsum gdab la gzhig goḥ ri rtse'i nyi ma nub bam mag ga rang 'od mchan nyams sam brtagasaḥ khung stong sgra ba'i rang sgra mchan nyams sam nub bamabartags rgya mtsho'i sprin nyi shar dusakhamasayor nang gi dri chu'i blang pa mchan la brtagasaḥ dge sbyong gi du ba dra ོ gya mchan chad dam ma chad brtags nam mkha'i tshe tshas bco lngar sgra tsham rgyan du mchanagazugs nyams sam ma nyams brtagasaḥ dpag bsam shing chags gam ma chagasaX nang bar nyi ma dros dus nyi ma la rgyab bstan pas grib ma'i gyi por rlang pa yod dam mid mchan lngag pa'i bdud 17

dzaX lang ngam ma lang skra r+yā yo du lang mapha dar dmar lasne'i rtsemo mthong 4 mapha nyi rtse'i reg gamaḥ stong zomasna rtse ga ges mthong ba mimathong mapha la 'od kyis 'khyudardo rdo rnam 'gram pa gnyis po nigargas mapha rgyal khang bzang po 'am gnams steng 'og goso 'tham na mapha kha sbyor ramaX daralhol go linag po mapha dmar la dug gi thig le bkod dam/rgyu mig nas mchi ma mi thub bar 'dzag mapha skar spos dri ngadasna gnam nas leb mor song mapha ldan la sa g.yo 'byung ngamaḥ tshes bdun gyi zlarna ba leb mo mgo la 'byar na mapha ba ri ngos su 'pho 'am/rdza brag lasna g.yasagayon la yo ba dang 'gram pa yo na mapha shwa 'ud byung ngamaX nyi zla gnyis goleg 'am btsum med par 'byu tshugasadu blta mapha la dang bral lamaḥ gang dkar la g.ya' chag gams rtsar drag pa nag po chagasasam mas rdza ri'i brang sgosnyen sna nam pa mapha rgyud snyil lamaḥ de ltar rtags gang 'byung yang 'chi ba la nye'adidag rna nad 'byung tsho nyebs 'a ltas la brtagasadaka' ba rga pasagag ltar las 'dir ma spros mapha ba pa niḥ rnal 'byor ba'i 'chi lhas banog thabs la sa sna chu sna shing stsa bsreg pa'i thal ba: srog chags mang po'i kha rlang dang kha sna'i chu mig

rnag rna spab snabs lud mchil ma bdud rtsi che chung 'dus drag rnams sbyar ba'i zan gyi glud bca'aḥ lag g.yas su khram ris 'o1 grangasaX g.yon par dar thags sna tshogs gnasalngar eX ram̐ḥbaṃ lam̐ ye re gzhug bla glud lo grangs bskoraX chang bu gtor chung 'brang rgyas mar me khrag rkong rnams bkodaX mar gyi lug la mda' dar 'dzugaḥ 'jims pas ra lanam mkha' nag po btsug bdag gis g.yas bskor bcu gsum dang g.yon bskor dgu byas laX bden pa'i tshig brjod pa niX e nyid stong pa chos dbyings nam mkha' che 'byung ba nam mkhar ma brten gang yang med thams cad de yi rgyu las 'byung 'gyur ro rten 'brel sgyu ma'i lus la 'pho ltas byung dus min rkyen bzlog nam mkha' mdzod 'di'aphrulaḥ rang snang 'khrul ba'i gzugs brnyan la chags pasaX lha 'dre rang rang yid tshim rang grol te skye rga na 'chi'i rgud pa zhi bar mdzod e e ye ye ram̐ ram̐ le le baṃ baṃ sa ma yabh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ brgya rtsa brjod phyogs bzhir gom pa bcu gsum ri'i sar glad khyer la ri mthon po'i rtser bskyal la zab mdo dgu bzlog tu byas la chos nyid bden pas

—11 ngang skyongs bar bya'oX lan gsum bskyar ba'i tshe rkyen yin na sel bar 'gyur zad par gyur na gsor btub pa ma yin noḥ lnga pa la chos sku'i 'pho ba/longs sku'i 'pho baḥ sprul sku'i 'pho baḥ tha mal ba'i 'pho ba dang bzhi'o dang po ni 'chi kha bar do'i dus 'dir sbyangs gzhi ka dag nam mkha' dngas ba lta buX sbyangs bya 'chikha'i snang shes phya phyod yud de baḥ sbyong byed chos sku'i 'pho baḥ sbyang 'bras 'od gsal ma pang du bu 'jug ste ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas thob pa'oX de yang nges par 'chi ba lababs dus su rtsa ba'i bla ma'am dad yul khyad par can zhig gdan drangs nas ci yod kyi dngos po thams cad tshogs dang mchod pa'i tshul du phul nas chags yul mtha' dgadang bral bar byaX rang gi 'khor tshe thogs med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshangs bas bshags sbyangs bya phyin chadatshe rab thams cad du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che'i dga' ston la spod cing gzhan phan phrin las byed por 'phor bas smon lam rnam dag tu gdab po de nas rnal 'byor ba

yang rabs bu chung 'chi ba ltar de rig pa ma bcos pa 'pho bya 'pho byed kyi rten dang bral b.raḥ rang rig bzod med du ye re yengs med du brig ge gsal stong rjen neX zangathal du ce re ba la ba'ag dus dbugs song na gzhi'i 'od gsal dngaḥ lam gyi 'od gsal ma bu zung du lajug ste chos sku skye ba med pa thob pa ni skad cig la grol bar 'gyurabs ngo sprod mi dgos 'di la lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba zhes bya laX nyams rtog med pa rnams la btab na'ang dmu long la rdzas bstan pa dang khyi la skar ma bstan pa dang 'drabs blo tshod dang mthun pa'i 'pho ba dang gsal gdab gal che ba yin noX yang gang zag rab sprang bo ltar 'chi ba'amaX 'bring ri dwags ltar 'chi ba la 'od gsal sbub 'jug dang 'pho ba'i gdam pa gang rung la gom pa des grol dgos pas sku dang ye shes sbubs la 'jug pa ni seng ge'i nyal thabs su gnas shing: shes pa mig la gtad mig dbyingasarig la gtad nas ka dag spros bral spro bsnga bral ba'i ngang nas shes pa gtad med du bzhag pas nges par grol ba yin noX 'pho ba ni tha ma'i rlang phyir 'gro ba'i dus su snying gar

—— rig pa ā dkar po zhig tu bsam laḥtshang bug nas yar rgyang gyi song bar bsam la hika nyer gcig brtsegs mar brjod pa'i grol loX de gnyis la ngo sproda'adi bla ma'am sbun dam sel med pas brjodaḥkye rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cigaḥkhyod la da lta chos nyid dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char nas yod doḥrang byung ye shes sangs rgyas kunabazang yab yum dngos yin noḥngo shes par gyis shigaḥd lta'i rang rig stongs gsal 'od kyi phung por bzhugs pa ni skye 'chi med pa'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba 'di ka yinanoX de ngo shes pas chog goḥrang shes kyi rig pa la blta ba ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa la 'jog pa yin noX zhes lan gsum gdab pas dang po'i sngags kyi bla ma'i ngo sprad padranaX gnyis pas rang rig rjen pa 'od gsal du ngo 'phrodaḥgasum pas rang ngo shes nas chos sku 'du 'bral med par grol bar nges soX der blo'i spros pa ma zhig na khyed rang girig pa āḥdakar po'i rnam par tshang bug nas dpag chen gyi mda' 'phang ba ltar song la steng gi phyogs na nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams yod do ༷der sangs rgyas nam

mkha' rgyal po zhes bya ba yod kyi der ma 'jigs par lta ba'i gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang yod pas0 dbang de zhus la chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i gzhi snang la bzhudacigaX de tshe khyod ka dag gi dbyings su sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro grol sa gnyis pa'i ngo sprod doḥ gal te ma grol na chos nyid kyi snang ba thams cad rang snang du ngo shes par gyisashigaḥ rang ngo shes ma thag tu ka dag gi dbyings su bde bar gshegs shigaX ces gdab grol sa gsum pa'oḥ chos sku'i 'pho ba thebs rtags su phyi'i nam mkha' g.ya' dag padangaḥ nang phung po bkrag mdangs yun ring du mi yal zhing mdangs gsal ba dang gsang ba'i rtags āḥdakar po dang hūṃ mthing la sogs 'byon par 'gyur roḥ gnyis pa 'o/ngas sku'i 'pho ba ni bskyed rim la gtso bor byed pa dngaḥ stong nyid la goms 'dris chung na longs sku'i 'pho ba brtsam par bya steḥ lus gnad thub na tsog pur 'dug ltangs bcas la 'pho ba'i dmigs pa'ang 'byung na gsalaX khyad par spri bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla'i khar bla ma nyid longs sgod rdzogs smra rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can namaḥ yang na yi dam gang

roX yin des rnal 'byor gsal bar bsgomaḥ rang lus kyi zubs su rtsa dbu ma dngas sang nge ba'i mar sne lte 'og tu rang bzhin gi ngo bo thig le dkar po'amaX yi/dro gang rung gi thugs sgog gi rnam par gsal gdab sgo dgu hūṃ gis bkag pa byung na legs kyang ma 'byung na bu ga rnams yid la mi byed par dbu ma'i nang du shes pa rtse gcigatu gtad de lus shed stod la phyungaX 'og sgo drag tu btsum mig khyen la bzlogaḥ lce ya rkan la sbyaraḥ 'og rlung steng du 'thenaḥ dbu ma'i nang du shes pa gtad de ༷ hika zhesabasgrags pa dang mtshungs par rig pa'i rten de dpag la spyi bor haṃ gis bkag pa kha phyes nas dkar sang nge ba'i nang nas yar la mda' ltar 'phang te yi dam gyi thug gar sibakyis bstims rig pa yi dam kyi thugs dang bsres la mnyam par bzhagaX mar mi dbab par yang yang 'dren zhing bstims: de nas yi dam lha yang mi dmigs par bzhag go/delingang la dbugs song na yi dam gyi lnga dang dbyer med par rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang la sbor nas longs spod rdzogs pa'i sma ru sangs rgyas par 'grur ba yin ngo spod ni yi dam

kyi bsgom khog slog yang na kyeX rigs kyi bu khyod rang gi yi dam 'di nyid sgom shigaḥ ma yang zhig 'dun pa drag po yi dam de la gtod cigaX snang stong zung 'jug tu la zlos shigaḥ gdos por grub pa can du ma sems shigaḥ thugs yid bsres la mnyam par zhog cigaX ces gsal gdab poḥ yang thig le stong sgron mtheb mdzub kyi sbyor bas brda thabs bstan la 'di skad brjodaḥ kye skal ldan sems kyi bu stong gsal brjod med zhig 'char ba 'diḥ rang la bzhugs pa'i 'od gsal longs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'di ka yin noX lus dang bral ba'i tshe na 'di la tha mal sgo gsum gyi sgrib byed med pas chos nyid bar dor sgra 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rnam par rgya cher 'char na'ang rang snang las ma 2das so: de ngo shes par gyis shig rig stong rjen pa de zin na ngo bo'i grol sa yin noḥ 'od gsal lhun grub kyi ngang la gtad tshug na rang bzhin gyi grol sa yin no 'di'i ngangal ma 'gyur bar gyis shig: snang ba de mthong ngamaḥ gdams ngag de go 'amaḥ zhes yang yang gdab pas skad dam brda byung na theb pa yinaḥ de ltar longs sku'i 'pho ba theb

sgo rtags phyi'i nam mkhar 'ja' dang 'od kyi gang ba dang nang rtags spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu khrag dang chu ser thon pa zil ba chags pa rkyang ba la sogs pa'abye : gsang ba'i rtags su gdung rigs lnga'am gang rung lha'i sku gzugs zhi ba dang khro bo phyag 'tshan la sogs pa 'byon par 'gyur ro gsum pa sprul sku'i 'pho ba ni lusagand g.yas sa la phab pas sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu bar 'gyur ba'i de'oḥ dedus rang mdun sprul sku thub pa chen po 'amaḥ o rgyan pad+ma sogs kyi sku blugs 'bur bris gsumagang rung bzhugs su gsolaX mchod pa rgya cher bshams la dad pa'i yid kyis 'bul dmigs bya 'o bdag da lta 'chi ba 'di la brten nas 'gro don du sprul skur skyes nasasems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar shog cig: sku de la mtshan dpe tshangs zhing tshe dang mdzad brin la bar chad mi 'byung zhingaḥ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob nus pas rig 'dzin chenapor ste bar gyur cig: ces smon lam rnam dag tu gdab la yid kyis lhag bsam bzang po'i rgyas btab po lus nang rtsa dbu ma dngas sang nge ba gcig bsam pa'i nang: lte 'og

chos 'byung gru gsum du yod pa'i khar rig pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar la dmar ba snum la 'dril baḥ yar la khad pa gcig gnas par bsamaḥ 'og sgo 'ub kyis btsum la 'then padang 'og rlung gis thig le yar la phul ba dang: hika zhes ci nas kyis dpag nas sna bug g.yon gyi sgor gleb pa naX rig pa rlung dang bsgrags te skad cig gi mdun gyi skugazugs gang yin pa de'i thugs gar 'phang la yang yang bstims rlung rig tshur mi bsdus rnam shes ma song gi bar yang yang bskyal bas theb par nges soḥ de'i ngang du rnam shes song na phyi ma sems can gyi don byed nges pa'i sprul sku gcig tu skye bar 'gyur ro yang ngosprod ni kye rigs kyi bu snang sems kyi cha gang la yang chags zhen ma byed cigaX khyodagados bcas kyi sha khrag gi lus dang bral bas chos nyid bar do' sgra 'od zer gsum la skrag dngangs 'byung don ni med doḥ rang snang rang bzhin med par rang la shar ba yin pasashes par gyis la btsan sa zung shig de ltar ma nus na shes pa rjang zhon thog med yin pas nub bde ba can kyi zhing khams yid la gyis shigaX mos gus bsted la der song

'o/ zhig: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang zhal mjal ba la the tshom med doḥ zhes yang yang gdab0 de ltar sprul sku'i 'pho ba thebs rtags su phyi'i namazlorjod la sprin 'ja' ljon shing lta bu dang: dar dkar brkyang ba lta bu dang dar gdug rgyal mtshan gyi rnams pa dang them skas kyi tshul la sogs pa 'byungaḥ nang rtags sna bugagayon nas khrag gam chu ser ram byang sems thon pa'am zil ba phram pa sogs 'byungaX gsang rtags rang bsrel mang po dang dbu'i thod pa ma zhig par hril bor 'byung ba dang lha'i phyag 'tshan la sogs par 'byung ngoḥ de dag ni rim gyis 'chi ba'i 'pho ba bshad pa yin laḥ skad cig mar bdag la dang sa sgrag thog bab tu byung dus dang skad cig ladran pa phur tshugs su byas la nga 'chi ba'oX 'dun pa spyi bor gtad dgos snyams nas yang yang sbyangs rkyen thog babs su tha na me rtag tsam phog na'ang de tsam gyi dus su bla mamakhyen zhes ngag nas 'byung ba dngaḥ shes pa spi bor bla ma'i thug gar gtad thub pa zhig la sbang ngoX dus su rkyen ngan thog babs su g.yang sar lcang ngamaḥ me yis tshig gamaḥ chu

la lhung ngamaḥ mgo la thog phog gamaX snying la mda' bab pa lta bu'i dus su yang bla ma dran nas mkhyen zhes sgrogs nus laḥ shes pa spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa la gtad thub payin de ni dag pa mkha' spyod kyi lam ste spyi bor tshangs bug nas 'pho ba yin pas 'di la skad cig ma'i 'pho ba dang btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba zhes bya'oḥ shin tu zab cing gal cheba'i legs par blo la sbyangs bar bya'o bzhi pa tha mal ba'i 'pho ba niḥ stong nyid kyi don ma rtogs pa dang bskyed rdzogs la sbyangs ba med pa rnams la mgo byang du bstan g.yas sa la phab0 khams kyi (1gas na skyabs 'a17 dang sems bskyed du gzhugs0 sdig pa bshags pa la dge bsnyen gyi 17ma pa phog laX 81ngas byung na gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur dam sdom ma nyams par shi na ngan song las thar de yon tan dpag tu med doḥ de tsam ma nus pa la'ang dal bu'i ming nas bos la khyed rang gi spyi bor jo bo thugs rje chen po bzhugs nas yod doḥ mos gus gyis shigaḥ ces brjod la spi bor reg reg bya tshangs bug gi sma la ran tsam 'then no rnam shes spri bor tshangs bug tu thon nas 'pho bar

—— 'gyur ba yin noḥ gzhan yang tha mal ba spyi la 'byung ba'i thim rim cung zad bshad naḥ sa sa la thim pas lus lci zhing ldang mi thub pa dang: chu chu ru thim pasakha chu dang sna chu 'dzag me me la thim pas kha sna skam la drod mtha' nas bsduX rlung rlung la thim pas dbugs ngar la yan lag g.yob pa dang mig gyen la bzlog par 'gyur ro 'di dus snang ba la du ba dang mig rgyu me khyer mar me'i 'od lam ltar mched pa na phyi nang gi 'byung ba'i thim rim mo ༷ yang 'degs byed kyi rlung bros pas lus mi theg yan lag mi'adus smra ba dka' mig sdog dbugs phyi ru 'phul ba dngaX bkrag mdangs bskyed pas rlung bros pas lus nyams kha sna la bal dud chags sha tsha kha sna gshin dri bsgoms pa dang dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i rlung bros pas bza' btung mi len lus stobs 'chor ba dang me mnyams kyi rlung bros pas lus drod mtha' nas 'chor bkrag dang gzi mdangs nyamasapa dang: bskal pa las kyi rlang bros pas lus la za zi phyad phyod mang zhing rtsa phran gyis khrag ni srog rtsar 'du ba dang khyab bya 'byung ba'i khams lnga dang khyab byed ye shes thig le'i

rgyab gyis yul lnga yid shes la thim pa'ang chun sgos bzhin tu 'ub gyis 'du tshe 'di snang la zhen chags mi bya bar bla ma dang gdams ngag dran dgos pa'i dus yinaḥ rag pa rtsa thigarlung gsum gyi tshogs pa gyes tshe phra ba snang mched thob gsum gyi thim tshul ni dkar cha thur du babs tshe snying stobs sam bde ba las byung 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhe bcu 'gagasapa ni rnam shes snang ba la thims pa dkar lam 'char roḥ de bzhin tu dmar cha gyen du sdog dus rdul lam sdug bsngal las byung ba'i zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum 'gags pa nisnang ba mched pa la thim pas dmar lam 'char pa nyer thob la thim pas nag lam 'char ba steḥ de tshe rig gdangs snyeng ga'i rig par thimaḥ rlung gi cha ma lus par dkar nag gilam nas kha snar 'thon la tshur 'ong mi shesaX rlung sems rgyab gyes pa'am sems dang ye shes rgyab gyes pa zhes bya ba de'oḥ 'di dus man ngag gis ngo sprod ni dran nyams de'i kha snagasum dang rang gi kha dang sna bug gnyis po gsum sprad nas rlang dum bur gsum du 'phang pa'i dang pocas dkar po bsam la 'phangaḥ gnyis pa'i tshes dmar po bsam la 'phang

phra gsum pa'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la 'phang shingaXkun la tshur sdud tshe hū mthing ga'i rnam par kho'i shes pa yul drang ba dang chab gcig ngag tu'ang hū zhes rgyurte(1 rgal ba la bcal ba'i shugs kyis drangs bas pha rol po mig hril gyi byung ba'ang yodaḥde tshe dbyings thig rigs gsum gyi snang ba lhug par byung la phaṭa brjod la mnyamapar bzhag pas skad thon pa'am brda byung na theb pa yin noX yang na tha mal pa de'i dbugs 'gro khar kho'i snying nang natso dkar po gcig bsamaX de'i spyi bor rang gi kha gtad lalo grangs kyitsosasnyan la dal bar brjod rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstunaḥdabugs khrog ger chad ma thag paratsosanyer gcig brjod pas rlung phyur phyur 'ong ste sdig can yin yang mthoris su 'drong bde 'gror 'thon pa rnams gong nas gong du 'drong ba yin no yang sdig can dmyal bar skye rtags can yin na mar gyi zang thal bkag pa'i phyir dbugs dang bralaba'i tshe kho'i rnam shes snying gar ar gsal ba'i ngangatsosabarjod pa dang lhan cig tu 'od lngar mer gyis zhu ba dang rang sems bsres te mnyam par bzhag pas 'dren pa po rtogs pa

mchog dang ldan naḥ kho'i rnam shes rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal la yod pa dang chos nyid kyi bden pa rtogs pa 'phrad nas 'drongs bas gnad khyad par can yang yod pa khyad chosasoḥ phal mo che la gnad de dag ma 'byeng bar rgyal po gdan la bzhugs la blon pos rgyogs phog pa'i dpe ltar las kyi khrag rnams sgog rtsar 'dus khrag thig gsum brgyabadabugs ring thung gsum gyis tha mar phyi dbugs chadaX rig pa snying dbus brgyal nas dran pa med pa'i tshe nang dbugs chad pa'i skabs te brgyal sang tsa na chos nyid 'od gsalagyi bar do 'char ba yin no rmongs pa dud 'gro dang khyad med pa 'chi ba dang 'phrad tshe mgo phyogs nas sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal loḥzhes mang du brjod pas ngan song las nges par grol baḥ sangs rgyas 'di'i sngon smon lam btab pa'i tshe bdag gi ming 'di thos pa thams cad ngan song las thar bar gyur cigaX ces smon lamabatab pa'i phyir ro yang sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+eḍār+ya'i 'od gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal loḥ zhes mang du brjod pas mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sngang bsngal sbobs par zhal gyi

tshaX bzhes pas ngan song gi skye sgo khog par 'gyuraḥ gzhan yang sangs rgyas gyi mtshan gang shes dang yi ge drug ma la sogs snying po byin rlabs can gang shes/rdor+sha btags grol bzlas thos grol 'don smon lam shes tshad brjod pas las 'phro bzang po bzhag pa yin pas yon tan shin tu che'o tha na'ang g.yas sar phab margabyang du bstan nas shi ba kho nas kyang ngan song du mi 'gro bar gsungs soX chos byas tshad 'chi dus la phan nges dgos pas 'chi thabs su mkhas pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos soX deyang rnam pa gcig tu na sbyangs gzhi ka dag dang lhun grub zung 'jug gi gzhi sbyangs bya 'chi kha'i snang ba zim rims snang mched thob gsum gyi cha phra rags sbyongs byed 'pho ba'igadams pa spyi dang bye brag sbyangs 'bras sku dang ye shes la mnga' dbang brgyur ba'oḥ shin tu zab pa'i gnadaX gal bo che'i man ngagaX gnad brgya 'du ba'i sa mtshams bloyisagatad so 'chi kha bar do'i khrid bstan pa'oḥ sa ma yā spri don lnga pa chos nyid bar do'i khrid rang snang la yid ches pa ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag laḥ sngon 'gro dra

shan dbye ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gzir baX gnad gsum la brten nas rang thog tu babs pa nyams su blang bas snang ba bzhi 'char tshulaX mtha' rten rjes kyi mnangag bar do 'char tshul ngo sprod dang drug lasaḥ dang po ni 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba dge sdig shan dbye dngaḥ las dang po bas sdig sgrib bsreg sbyangs bya ba dang sgo gsum gyiru shan dbye ba ni mtshan bcas dang mtshan ma med pas zhi gnas lhag mthong bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len bya ba dang khyad par gyi ru shan dbye ba ni khreg chod kyi nyamasalen la rang spyan tshud par bya ba'oḥ gnyis pa niḥ lus gnad dang: ngag gnad dang sems gnad gsum moḥdang po lus gnad gzir ba la gsum lasaḥ dang po sprul sku'ibazhugs stang drang sgong tsog pur rkang mthil sar phab pas las rlung bcil lag sor bsnol bas dbyings rig 'dresaḥ rgal rgyud bsreng bas rlung sems drangasaḥ pus brang sbyaraba'i bde stong khod stom mo gnyis pa longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen bde lugs su nyal thabs su bcas la rkang mthil gnyis phyir phud pas rtog pa dbyings la bor

—tshuX pus brang sbyar la sar zubs pas las rlung bcal la gnonaḥ lag mthil kyi 'gram pa btags pas gsal stong zung 'jug gi rtog pa 'charaX tshig bzhi sarabatsug pas mu bzhi'i mtshan ma rang grol la gtong ngoḥ gsum pa chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge 'brug la rngams pa lta bu'i rkang mthil sbyar bas stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char lag sor brgong ba'i las rlung ar la gtadaX ro stod gsang la bor bas dbyings thog rig pa 'phuraḥ rtsar 'byangs pa la bor bas nyams rtogs myur du 'char bar 'gyur zaganyis pa ngag gi gnad la gsum lasaḥ dang po bslab par bya ba ni rnam rtog kha 'phru zhing je nyung la gtong gnyis pa gnas pa ni gzhan tshig ma 'dres par ngar khrig ger bcad gsum pa bstan pa ni ci yang mi brjod par lkug pa ltar gnas par bya'o gsum pa sems kyigand la gsum las dang po sngar 'dris gyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar rnam rtog ceragyis grol gnyis pa sbral gyi mdud pa bzhin rang zhig rang grol la 'groḥ gsum pa khang stong rdu rman bu zhags pa lngar phan gnod dang bral ba shar grol la 'gro ba zhig dgos so

ཿdang po la gsum las chos sku'i gzigs stangs gyen du bzlog te gas cing bag chags thur la sel ba'i gnad de dang po'o longs sku'is ro mnyam du bsre ba'i gnad ste gnyis pa'oḥsprul sku'i gzigs sta sa kyi snang ba dngos su pheb pa'i gnad dang gsum moḥ gnyisapa ram̐

sgo dbyings kyi gdangs snod kyi dngas ma rnam par dag pa phyi nang zung 'jug gi dbyings su 'char zhing nam mkha' sum sprug gi man ngag la bslab pa'oḥ gsum / rterte gi gnad la gsum las dang po bzung ba ni rlung zhes bya ba gya gyu can te rnam rtog gi bzhon par gyur nas chos nyid bde gshegs snying po can bslu bar byed pas de'i rgyu'agags par byed pa'i thabs su rlung sna nas mi dbyung bar cung zad bzung la kha nas dbyung bar bya ba dang gnyis pa 'phang ba niḥ rlung sna nas 'dren pas man ngag dag gisa'akhor lo bzhir sbyangs bya'i rlung stobs su gyur bas gegs dang rkyon 'byung ba'ang yod la: de phyir 'dir glo ba'i rlung 'gro 'ong gi rnam pa can rang babs su dag pas gdangs snyingagar thimaX sbyangs bya'i rlung rang sar dgaX 'khor lo so so'i yon tan lhun gyis grub nas ye shes kyi rlung 'od gsal du grol pa'i gnad yod pasaX de yang shed ma bskyed par rgyangarang por mda' ltar 'phang ba dang gsum pa rab tu 'phang ba niḥ kha nas mchu so ma reg pas bar nas shin tu dal bu'i 'byung 'jug byed pas khyad chos la brtan pas dbyings

rig mi 'gul bas gnad shin tu dal bar bya ba yin noḥ bshi pa la nyams su len tshul dang snang bzhi 'char tshul dang gnyis lasaX dang po laḥ 'char gzhi sgron ma ngos bzungab dang man ngag gi gnad la brten nas skyong tshul rig pa btson du 'dzin tshul dang gsum lasaḥ dang po niḥ tsit+ta rin po che snying mchong gur phub pa lta bu gsang sngags 'byungaba'i gnas gyi sgrol ma dang rtsa ka ti shel kyi sbu gu can rtsa ba phra ba rta rnga brgyad gshag gi cha tsam rtse mo gyes pa ba min gyi rwa lta bu dbus rtse dbu ma stong nyid dang mthong rtse shelasbugs 'od gyi sgrol ma dang grag rtse stong pa rang grol ste ye shes lnga rtsa ba gcig paX khyab brdal chos dbyings rtse mo lnga ni gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa ste gsang chen gyi sgod rangabyung gi sgrol ma dang: rig pa bde gshegs snying po chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa'i 'char gzhi shes rab rang byung ni thugs ye shes kyi sgrol ma dang yang nang 'byung gi dngas ma thigale 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor rang byung ba dang lus gnas de las ma skyes pas bdag nyid can ni stong pa sku yi sgol ma dang rig pa dngos po rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag nyid can

tsha mkhyen rtse ye shes kyi gter chen por bzhugs pa de dang rtsal klong rdol shes rab bsam gyi mi khyab pas sgo 'bar ba dngaX gdang rdo rje lu gu rgyud gser rkudabazlo ba lta bu phra 'khyogs thig le thig phran rlung gi bsgul bskyod dang bcas pa ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud ye shes chos kyi sgrol ma dang klong nas dngas gsal mngon du gyur byed ye shesakyi rgyang zhags dang: dbang por ma 'dres 'gags med du gsal ba dbang po 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags dang ngo bo'i stong gdangs rang bzhin thig gdangs rig pa'i zer gdangasabarda dpe mi nub par 'char ba lam rang gsal gyi sgrol ma dang tshad pheb kyi snang ba rtsal rdzogs pa dang chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snang cha 'gags med ni bar do dusakyis sgrol ma'oḥ gnyis pa laḥ ngo sprod pa dngaX bzhag thabs bstan pa'oX dang po ni ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bla ma la dga' ston maṇ+ḍal dang mchod tshogasargya mtshos mchod cing gnyes pa bskangasaḥ gser gyi marbal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa niḥ kye mirtog yeshes bcom lngan 'das ༷ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dgongasaḥ kun

nga po'i gsang lam mchogaḥ rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab rjes slob dpon he ru ga'i chas su zhugs thug gar zhwabakod slob bu rnams kyis rnam snang chos bdun bca'aḥ mig mi 'dzum par thugs ga'i ul blta zhing shes pa gtad med du bzhag go rdo rje slob dpon gyi ḍa dril la zhi khre'i spyi sngags brjod la byin dbab poḥ yid la med pa gcig tu bla ma'i phaṭa drag po zhig brjod de ma thag par sems gang yin zhes lan gsum du rangarjod slob ma'i ci zer gtad so bral bar lus tsheḥ rig pa ma bcos lhag ger shar ba ni ma mthong bas mthong ba chen po'oX zhes chos sku'i ngang du ye shes dbab pade nas 'jug pa dngos ni slob ma rnams drang sgong tsog pur 'dug migadabyings snang rten med du bzhag cing rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams yid la byar bcugaX

—13 mdangs 'bar la gzigs pa nub med kyi 'khor tshogs sdul rted kyi grangs dang mnyam moḥ chos kyi 'khor lo nub med du rang rang gi 'khor tshogs labaskor bar mdzad doḥ rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston noḥ bu khyod zhing de dag la drang srong gi blta stang gis ltos laX stag mo'i mchongs stabasakyis mchongs shigaḥ a a ā pāṭaḥ de nas slob bu rnams glang chen nyal thabs su 'dug cingaḥ mig bar snang la har rer bltaḥ rgyan sdug po bkod pa'i zhing khams yid la byedadu bzhugs bla ma rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing 'di skad gdabaḥ e maḥ skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams nyon cigaX rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams de dag gi 'char gzhirgyan stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ye shes lngas kun nas khyab cing 'od gsal baX shin tu mnyam zhi mi g.yo ba naḥ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dgapar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' ltar dag pa 'od dpag tu med pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba laḥ 'khor sangs rgyas bye ba dpag tu med pas bskor nasaḥ chos nyid

shin tu rnam par dag pa la longs spyod pa zhig yod kyisaX bu khyod der glang po che'i blta stangs kyi ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stangs kyi songs zhigaḥ a ā a phaṭaḥ zhes stong panyid kyi don las slar mi ldog par rgyas gdabs so de nas slob bu rnams seng ge'i 'dug stangs kyi 'dug la mig gyen thur g.yas g.yon thad drangs du bltas teḥ rig stongarjen pa'i ye shes gsal gdab la ngo sprod ni bla ma'iḥ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cigaḥ gzugs sku gnyis las 'das pa'i pha rol na de gnyis ga'i 'charagazhir gyur pa rang rig bsam ngo dang bral ba'i ngo boḥ thim la ma rmug pa'i ye shes gang du'ang ma phye bas chos nyid tshad med dpag tu me da pa dmigs su med nga/'i tshul du bzhugasakyis bu khyod 'gro sa med pa'i gshis la rdo rje 'chang gi blta stangs kyi ltos la 'gro mkhan dang bral ba'i rig pa nam mkha' lding gi 'phur stangs kyis 'phur zhigaḥ ma 'gagasapar 'khya ba'i rtsal sbongs shigaḥ sna tshogs shar ba la ma zhen cig bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du a a a pāṭa/ ces rig pa ye shes su rgyas gdab cing mngon sum du bsgom

——rji pa la dbang ba yin no yang sgob bu rnams bzhugs stangs gsum gang bder bca'aX gzigs stangs gsum gang 'os su bya sgo yul rlung rig bzhi'i gnadagacun du gzhugs la rdo rje slob dpon gyis ngo sprod niḥ e ma nyo kye nyo skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams tsat+ta rin chen gsang ba'i sbubs na thig le ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ngo bostong zhing bdag med paḥ rang bzhin gsal zhing 'gags pa medaX thugs rje'i rtsal las sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa bum na gi mar me ltar gsal ba 'di'i 'od gdangasadabyings gsum zung du 'jug pa'i klong der 'thon pa'i sgrol ma bzhi'i rang bzhin du gsal ba 'di'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khorala'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob srid pa'i grong khyer gyi rgyun chadaX yid dpyod las 'das pa'i thar lam zinaX gzhan nas ma btsal ba'isangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong sma tshig dang bral ba'i dam chos khong du chudaX dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i dgongs klong ma nasal bar rang la rnyedaḥ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang
