po dang skal pa mnyam pa yin noḥ som nyi yid dpyod the tshom skad cig kyang ma byed par zab mo'i don la bzod pa'i dpa' gdangs bskyed nasaX 'di las gzhan pa'i srid zhiganyis kyi bya ba thams cad chom gyis bskyur la dus rtag tu dbyings rig gi snang ba dang ma bral bar gyis shigaḥ des na 'bad med tshul gyis don gnyis lhun gyis grub par gdonami za'oX zhesango sprad par byas la slob bu'i bka' drin gso phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing dam bca' bzung bar bya'oḥganyis pa ni phyi nang gi g.yeng ba thams cad spangs bar byas layid khyed shes kyi dad pa drag po'i bla ma la gsol ba yang yang gdabaḥ bka' drin can gyi bla ma de'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas ngo sprod yang gnang bar bsam mthar 'od dultem gyis zhu la 'ja' 'od thig le thig phran dang bcas pa'i rnam par rgyang zhags kyi lam nas zhugasaḥ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangasaḥ ka ti'i lam brgyud shes rab rang byung gidakyil 'khor la thim par bsam laḥ mi 'gul ba gsum la gzhi bca'aX sgo yul rlang rig gi gnad gzir bas dbyings thig rigs gsum gyi snang ba lcag par mthong ba yin

——rji da lta'i dbyings thig gi ra ba rig pa brjod med smra bsam dang bral bar bzhagaḥ dbyings thig rigs gsum rig cha ye shes kyi ra ba las ma 'das par gangashar zhen med rang grol 'dzin med du skyongs ba na gol sa chod pa yin noḥ gsum pa ni nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dngaḥ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis lasaX dang po ni 'char sgo rgyangazhags ni phyed btsum zum bur gcun la skyon bral mkha' dbyings dngas gsal sur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa'i mdangs sogs 'char gzhir gtad cing rlung dal bur dbyung zhing dran rig ma bcos somar yul la 'dzin med lhug par gtad la btang bzung bral bar bzhag goḥ de'i sgyu lus rin chen gzhal yas khang mjes kyi nang nas mi shigs rdo rje'i srog gi gdangs su lhunagrub rang byung gi snang ba lhug par mthong bar 'gyur ro phyi 'byung gi dngas ma dbyings rnal par dag pa'i sgron ma dang nang 'byung gi dngas ma thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang gsang 'byung gi dngas ma shes rab rang byung gi sgon ma ma bcos rig pa ther la phud nas lugs rgyad rdo rje'i ra bar btsud pa dngaX dbyings thig gi dgongs rgyar rig dang rig

gdangs bcas btson du bzung nas yid dpyod dang bral bar shes rab rang byung gi ye shes kyi rtsal phyogs med du 'bar bar 'gyur roḥ gnyis pa niḥ sgod la drang sgong tsog puraganas shing dbang po gnad du bsdu ba laḥ lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus su aḥthung dmar po me yi rang bzhin reg bya tsha ba las bde ba'i me g.yos dbu ma nas yaramachedaX spyi bo'i haṃ la phog thig le'i rgyun 'dzag pas me gsos bde stong dga' bzhi 'baraḥ las dang bag chags bsregs yab yum bde ba'i rang bzhin la mnyam par bzhagagoḥ nam gung glang chen 'dug stangs kyis shes bya bum bsdud ni0 a wa dhu ti'i nang snying gar 5dkar shin tu 'tsher ba da : spyi bor de 'dra ba gnyis kyis bar spyodakar bcudagu brtsegs mar gnas pa rnams gcig thim gyi tshul du snying gis a la 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis rgya skar la nyi zhur 'dren pa ltar sgom pa ni gnyid 'od gsal gyi sbubs su sba ba'igand do tho ring lngang ma thag tu haḥzhes dbugs ring ba gsum bus la dug gsum gyi dri ma sbangasaḥ lus seng ge'i 'dug stangs bcas la spi bo' nam mkha' la gzhu gang gi thad

sgo tsam du snying ga'i āX las āX dkar po gnyis pa zhig chad de sang nger 'dug pa la sems bzung ngoḥ 'byung ba lnga dang khams lnga bsam gtan rlung lnga'i bgabyedrodas zad par byed pa'i gnad a dmar po lnga brtsegasaḥ dkar po bzhi brtsegasaḥ ljang gu gsum brtsegs ser po gnyis brtsegasaX mthing ga rkyang ba la sogs pa'ang rimasapar bsgom pas a skye ba med pa la don gyi rtogs pa gtad pa me dang 'dra baX dga' bde'i nyams chu dang 'dra ba: dran 'dzin rlung dang 'dra baḥ de dag zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge'adzin la la bzla ba ni thun mong ma yin pa'oḥ gnyis pa snang ba bzhi 'char tshul la snang bzhi'i yon tan bshad pa dang rtags sgo gsum la 'char tshulaḥ tshad rmi lam gyi bzungatshul bstan pa'oḥ dang po ni chos nyid mngon gsum nyams gong 'phel rig pa tshad phebaḥ chos zad blo 'das soḥ dang po rnaX de ltar nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tugoms pa'i tshe: shes rab kyi mig gis mthong bar grur na 'phel dang zad pa'i go rim brjod du med kyang rgyang zhags kyi mthong ba la dbyings snang 'ja' ston lta bu'am rma bya'i

mdongs lta bur 'char ba dang thig le stong pa'i sgron ma chu gnyer lta bu'amaḥ 'theb gor dang kham phor lta bu'i nang du thig le nyung 'bru'am sran 'bru tsam du 'char roḥ de'i mtshams sam nang du rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud rta rnga phra ba la mdud pa byas pa lta bu dngaX mu tig shin tu phra ba bstar la brgyas pa lta bu dngaḥ a lung sbrel ma lta bu dang: me tog gi drab rlung gis bskyod pa lta bur gnyis 'brel dang gsum sbrel dbyings rig nyi ma dang zer gyi tshul du gnas soḥ de yang dbyings zeg rig gsum rab tu bstan pa dang: sminamatshams nas bral gar gtad du 'du ba dang yid dpyod gyi 'dzin pa dang tshig dang blo la spros pa bsnub la shes rab dri ma med pa mthong ba ni mthong lam gyi rtsal rdzogs pa dang mtshams ma chad na rang bzhin sprul sku'i dbyings su sangs rgyas par 'gyur roḥ gnyis pa la snang nyams dang shes nyams gnyis las shes nyams ni bde gsal mi rtog pa snatshogs 'char la mi bstan par 'byur zhing nyams sna tshogs na bun bzhin du rang yal 'gro ba'i gang yang gtad med shar grol du gtong ngoḥ rtogs pa mtho dman nyams snang gi

——3 bzung dgos pasaX snang nyams la dbyings rig res gsal res mi gsal ba dngaḥ dbang bo'i dngos po dang bral bar stong sgron rtsol med du sran ma 'pho tsam dngaḥ rig gdangs 'dab chags 'phur rkyen pa tsam dngaḥ yang sbyangs pas yon tan dbyings snang 'od lnga gyen 'grengs rtsib shar mdung rtse re lde rnams nas ye shes gru chad kyirnam par rang mdun tsam khyab par snang laX thig le me long cher tsam nas yar 'phel ba dngaX ri dwags sha ra ṇa rtsibs su rgyugs pa lta bu dngaḥ yang sbyangs pas yon tan gyisagong 'phel du song nas dbyings snang rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa phyedaḥ 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram dung dkar nyi zla gur khyims gzhal yas khang gi rnam par mched nas lungab de gang bar 'gyur ba dngaḥ thig le rnga chung tsam nas phubs kyi sba 'khor tsam 'od lnga mu khyud dang bcas rnam par 'char ba dngaX lha sku rkyang ba dang gdong phyed tsam snang bar 'khyar ba dang rig pa shel phreng chung ba lnga bu 'akul 'khrig med par 'char ro de lhar shar bas bar do'i snang ba srungs ba'i phyi'i bar do med doḥ gting gsal shes rab phyogs

med du 'char bar 'gyur ba yin pas0 de ni longs spyod rdzogs skur grol bar 'gyur ro0 gsum pa niḥ de ltar gom pas rig pa tshad la pheb nas gang snang gang mched pa ni 'odalnga'i rang bzhin las dngos po mi snang ba dngaX thig le lnga tshom gyi klong du rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yumaḥ sems dpa' sems ma thub drug sgo skyongs sogs zhi ba dang khro bo'i tshogasarnams snang ba dang: rig pa 'od lnga'i thig le shel phreng che ba tsam drwa ba drwa phyed gyi rnam par 'char zhing g.yo zhing 'gul 'phrig dang bral bar 'char roḥ rims kyis de dag grangasalas 'das par snang zhing ma bsgom kyang 'char bar gyur pa ni rtsal rdzogs nas gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rgyun 'gags de ye shes rang snang tshad la pheb nas lus 'od gsal dugrol zhing mtshan dpe 'char 'byung ba rang dag tu song gdos bcas kyi phung po rang sar grol snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur rang grol te lnga ldanalongs skur 'byor bar 'byur roḥ kun rtogs dbyings su nub spran dang mngon shes 'char zhing bsam yas ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba dang: ste ba dang 'jug pa la dbang

sgo 'byor nas mdzad pa phrin las rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa la mnga' dbang 'byor bar 'gyur roḥ bzhi pa niḥ de ltar rig pa tshad pheb kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogasarte rnos dwangs ma'i snying khar āḥganas pa la nyi skar 'phrod ltar 'od zer chen po' dbang nod tshe: rlung nam mkhar mda' gang dpag ye shes kyi rlung dwangs mar sad spyi boragatsug tor 'od kyi rnam par mched la mtshan dpe 'charaḥ lag sor 'od kyi dkrigs la dngas mar 'charaX bar do'i gang zag sum stong la dgongs pa gtad pas grolaX sdig poche mtshams med pas las bsags pa'i gang zag la yang dgongs pa gtad pas grol nus pas sprul pa sum stong 'gyed nus pa dngaḥ rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byer ba sogs 'ongalaX de nas dbyings thig rig gsum gyi snang ba ce phrar gyur nas ye shes lnga ldan gyi khong seng gi lam nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i rtsal chen rdzogs te nyams zad gdos bcas kyi las zad dbang po'i 'dzin pa zadaḥ na la ba'i stogs tshogs zadaX tshob mtha' dang 'khyal snang thams cad dag nas zag phung mi snang bar sangs rgyas pa

yin pas chos nyid zad pa zhes bya la ci yang med pas chad lta lta bu ni ma yin te mkhyen brtse ye shes dang mdzad pa phrin las yon tan ni brjod kyi mi lang ba mngon du gyur temador na sku gsum gyi yon tan mtha' yas pas rtsal rdzogs pa yin noḥ snang ba gsum gyis ni nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs pa tshes gcig nas zla ba nya gang ba'i bar gyi dpe dang gnam stong gi zla ba ltar phyir gsal gyi cha dag nas nang dbyings la 'ub chub pa yin noḥganyes pa la phyi'i rtags dang nang gi rtags soḥdang po la bar chad bdud kyi rtags 'phel 'grib nyams kyi rtags mi 'gyur ba gsang ba'i rtags dang gsum lasaX dang po ne+e de ltar nyams dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i dus su bdud kyi b.rachad 'byung bas ngo shes par byas la ro snyoms brtul zhugs gyi spyod pa la bslab pa dang sna tshogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul dang mtshan ma sna tshogs 'byung bas na dgongasapa dbyings su gtad cing re rtogs dang bral ba'i 1nga du ar gtad bya'oḥ gnyis pa niḥ rlang sems 'dus tshul gyi rkyen la yid brtan mi rung ba'i ting 'dzin glo bur du ste ba dngaḥ

shā nam mkhar lha sku dang 'od snang 'khrigs paḥ re 'ga' chu dkyil du sdod pa sogs nyams chal chol du 'byung tshe tsan+tan gyis mar khus bsku mnye bya ba dang nga dal ba'i kha zas la brtenaḥ skye med kyi snying potsa yag bsgrangs bas sel ba'oX gsum pa ni lus shing bal ltar yang zhing sgra dkar dang gnyer ma med cing bkrag mdangasa'abar ba skra sen skye ba'i rgyun chad pa: lus la rigs lnga'i phyag rgya dang sku gzugs yi ge'i rnam par gsal ba dngaḥ gzhon sha chags shing sgra dkar nag por 'gyur ba dang sothaskye ba sogs lus shin tu sbyangs ba'i yan lag la dbang ba'oḥ ngag la bden pa 'grubaḥ 'khrul ba'i tshig dag gtam rgyud sgra skad shes rig drug so so'i sgra skad shes pa dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gsung thos shing dbugs phyi nang gi rgyu ba chad pa sogs 'byung ba'oḥ semasa'abyor bas zas gos mi dgosaX ting 'dzin lo zlar brtan rlung gar gtadadu 'drongs dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags ༷ tshad med snying rje steḥ nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs 'gagasaX mdor na bzang ngan gang la'ang re dogs kyi mthar ma lhung bar dgag

sgrub dang bral ba ni gnad kyi dam pa'oḥ gnyis pa ni snang bzhi'i yon tan 'byung ba'i rtags sgo gsum la 'char tshul ni lus rus sbal mkhar gzhong du bcud pa lta bu dang ngag skug pa ltar gyur pa dang sems mkha' 'gro snyi yis zin pa ltar gar gtad du sdod tshug pa rnams ni chos nyid mthong ba'i rtags so yang skyes bu nad kyis gdung ba ltar dulus rgegs chos ngo tsha dang bral ba dang ngag spyon pa rang tshig rdol pa ltar chos tshig 'chol tshig sna tshogs pa dang sems skyes bu dug gis phyos ltar 'gags med shugs 'byungagang shar rang grol du 'phel ba ste nyams gong 'phel gyi rtags so yang glang po 'dam las thon pa ltar du lus ri brag zang thal la 'gro ba dngaḥ ngag grul bum gyi glu dbyingasabazhin gzhan snang dge la sbyor sems 'byum nad byang ba'i skyes bu bzhin 'khor bar lhung gyi rtogs pa dang bral ba ste rig pa tshad du pheb pa'i rtags dang yang lus dur khrod kyimi ro bzhin gshed ma brgyas bsgor yang ya nga bag tsha med ngag brag cha'i rjes su bzlo ba las tshig rang rdol du mi 'byung sems mkha' la glogs 'khyags pa lta bu skad cig

phra mar snang sems kyi go skabs byed pa tsam las mi snang bar dag pa ni chos nyid zad pa'i rtags soḥ gsum pa niḥ rab la rmi lam dbyings su dag nas 'odagadro la gyi 'khor lor brdal ba ni chos skur grol ba'i rtags tshad dngaX 'bring gis rmi lam zin nas sprul bsgyur gyis gom pa la nges pa dag ni longs skur grol ba'i rtags tshadadangaḥ tha mas bag chags ngan goms rgyun chad nas dag pa'i zhing khams mthong ba dkyil 'khor 'bri ba rdul tshon blugs pa sogs bzang po sha stag mthong ba ni sprul skur grolaba'i rtags tshad dang gsum 'byung ngoḥ lnga pa mtha' rten rjes kyi man ngag laX sdod pa gsum thob ba gsumaḥ gdeng chen bzhiḥ grol tshul loḥ dang po ni phyi sgyu lus sdod pasarlung sems dal zhing 'khor bar mi 'jug nang rlung sems sdod pas dbyings rig dal zhing brtan pa dang ba/sang ba dbyings rig sdod pa'i rtags tshad ma lus pa mthar phyinapar 'khyar roḥ garnyas pa ni phyi snang ba la dbang thob pa'i rkyen snang zhing khams gsum 'charaḥ nang skya lus la dbang thob pas gdos bcas 'od gsal du dgaX gsang ba rlang

sems la dbang thob pas mtshan med lnga dang ldan pas rnam par shes pa yang rig pa gtad pas 'drongs ba'oX gsum pa na ngan song gi sdug bsngal tshe tshad sogs thos kyang rangangor gdod nas 'khrul ba ma mchis bde sdug shes bya la ma grub par thag chod pas ngan song la bag mi tsha ba'i gdeng dngaḥ rig pa gzhi thog tu pheb tshe 'khor ba'i ming ma grub parargyu 'bras rnam smin la mi re bas gdengs dang chos nyid kyi gshis la 'di grol bde snyams pa'i myang 'das rang mtshan pa med par thag chod bya la re ba med pa'i gdengs dang/rgyal ba'i khams na yon tan bsgrangs las 'das par bsgrags kyang rang ngo rig pa las sangs rgyas rgyu spu rtse tsam yang med par gshis thog tu pheb pas dga' brod mnyam pa nyidadu dag pa'i gdengs ste rnam pa bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur roḥ bzhi pa niḥ dbang po rabs rnams tshe 'dir mngon sangs rgyas pa la gnyis lasaḥ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas ni phung po lhag ma med par sangs rgyas pa ni bī ma dang o rgyan chen po sogs kyi 'ja' lus brgyad pa gser phreng gi tshul de'oḥ mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i stes bu de

—1༷ la 'od dang sgra dang gdung dang sku dang sa g.yo ba sogs 'byung nas mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi stags ma tshangs ba med par bstan nas gdod ma'i saragashegs pa'o drug pa bar do'i 'char tshul bshad pa niḥ de yang chos nyid bar do ni gdos bcas kyi bcing bas thim rims thams cad rdzogs nas lus sems 'brel ba 'chadapa'i skabs su rtogs pa dang ldan pas rnal 'byor bas 'di skad gdabaḥthub reg kyibu khyed kyis kun gzhi'i shes pa dran bya dran byed dang bral ba'i nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltabu 'char ba ni nyer thob nam mkha' la thim pa'i skabs yin pas gzhi khreg chod kyi dgongs pas sa zungs la ma pang bu 'jugs pa lta bu'i don rtogs par gyis shigaḥ gzhi'i 'odagasal shar ba yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig ma bcos par rang sar zhog cigaḥ khyad chos drug ldan gyi nang dbyings la longs spyod par gyis shig zhes lan gsum gdab de yang don dam par chos kyi dbyings su thim pas smabs smad cig ma rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal sngon nam sgong byed kyi rmon gsum dang bral ba'i nam mkha' lnga buḥ rgya gar yang ma

chad phyogs gang du'ang ma lhung ba'i stong gsal sgrib g.yog dang bral ba de ngos zin par byas te gshis thog tu bcas bcos med par bzhag pas gdod ma'i grol gzhi chen poradabang bsgyur ba yin no der ma grol na nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa yin pas ngo sprod ni kye rigs kyi bu dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams nyon cigaḥ khyod kyis grol sadang po ma zin pas snang cha thams cad za 'og gi ber khyims kha phyes pa lta bu 'char ba ni ka dag gi gdangs lhun grub gyi sna yin pas der btsan sa zungs shigaḥ rdo rje semasadapa'i gsang lam skyongs shigaḥ rang bzhin med par shes nas yid ches par gyis shigaḥ rang sa ru grol bar gyis shigaḥ grol thog tu btsan sa zungs shigaḥ ces nyams len dngabastun nas ngo sprod bar bar gdabaḥ de yang phyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal nyi zla dang bcas pa'i brtan g.yos snang ba rnams ni nub gang du bltas kyang za 'og kha phyes paltar shin tu bkra ba kha dog sna tshogs pas phyi nang yang dog med par mgul 'phrig gi rnam pa rab tu 'tsher ba 'char ba la rang snang du ngos bzung nas rang bzhin bsam gtan

sgo la gnas naḥ skad cig dang por rang snang rang bzhin med par yid chesaḥ gnyis par rang sa ru grolaḥ gsum pa grol thog tu btsan sa zin pa yin noḥ da ltabyerdo r+shal ji tsam gom pa'i yun de tsam du grol long yod pa dngaX gom 'dris med pas phal ba la skar mda' rgyugs pa'i yun tsam las med pas grol thub dka' der ma zin na'od gsal zung 'jug la thim pa steḥ de dus ngo sprod niḥ kye rigs kyibu khyod gyi nam mkha' ka dag kyang ma zinaḥ 'od gsal ris med kyang ma zin pas da ni zung 'jug gi snangab sgra 'od zer gsum sku zhi ba dang khro bo'i dal gang snang yangaX rang snang rang la shar ba yin pas ma 'jigs ma sngangs ma sgrag par0 'od thams cad rang 'od sgra thams cad rangasgra zer thams cad rang zer sku zhi ba dang khro bo thams cad rang chas yi dam kyi lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du snang ba yin pas ngo shes par gyisashig: gdang tshug par gyis shigaX brnan pa thob par gyis shigaḥ ngo shes pa dang grol ba dus mnyam du 'ong ngo khyod lus sems kyi 'brel ba ni chadaḥ yi dam lha'i sgra lus ma yin

mang 'od lus su snang ba yin pas skad cig nyid la rang snang lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor du longs spyod par 'gyur ro zhes bsam gtan gyi zhag cig la ngo sprod gdab rabazhags gsum nas grol 'bring lnga nas grol tha ma nyer gcig gi dus su grol pa yin noḥ da lta rgyu dus su lha sku nyung 'bru tsam pa'ang 'di dus khro bo rnams sku 'jig rten khyab patsam la mgo brnyan dang mtshon cha sna tshogs dang sgra 'od zer gsum rngam brjed gsal la 'tsher ba bkrag la nyam nga ba 'char ba la ngo sprod ni sku dang sgra 'od zer gsum thamasacad chos nyid kyi rang mdangs su shes par gyis la sngangs sgrag 'jigs snang thams cad spangs bar gyis la yid tsam 'di rang snang 'gags med la shar ba'i rang 'od rang sgra rangazer rang snang du ngo shes par gyis dang skad cig nyid la grol bar 'gyur ro zhes kyang gdab par bya'oḥ de yang cung zad spro na bsam gtan gyis zhag dang por snang ba thams cad 'od mthing ga'i khyab cing brdal ba'i dbus su thig le be+eḍār+ya'i bkrag 'bar ba'i klong du sku rnam par snang mdzad sngon po 'khor lo 'dzin cing yum dbyings byug ma dang 'khril baḥ

sgo thugs ka nas chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang 'od mthing gsal dngaḥ lha'i 'od dkar po gnyis gshib mar 'char roḥzhag gnyis par 'od dkar po'i klong midrozlod rdo rje dang yum sangs rgyas spyan ma rang rang rigs kyi sems dpa' sems ma dang me long ye shes rang 'od dkar po gsal 'tsher dang dmyal ba'i 'od dud kha gnyis gshibapar snangaḥ zhags gsum par 'od gser mdog gi slong rin 'byung ma ki 'khor sems dpa' sems ma bcas pa'i thugs ka nas mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang 'od ser gsal dngami'i 'od sngon po zung du 'char roḥ zhag bzhe par snang ba thams cad 'od dmar po'i slong snang ba mthas yas yum gos dkar mo dmar mo la pad+ma rigs kyi sems dpa' semasam dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas sor rtog ye shes kyi rang 'od dmar gsal dang yi dwags 'od ser po gnyis 'char ba dngaḥ zhag lnga pa la 'od ljang gu'i sang du don grub sgrol malngang mo la las kyi sems dpa' sems ma rnams dang thugs ka nas bya grab ye shes kyi gsang lam 'od lngang dang lha min gyi 'od dmar bcas gshib nas 'char ba yin noḥ de tshe

gnad gsum gyis grol dgos pas rang yid lus kyi snying kha'i 'od shin tu phra ba sku de dag gi thugs gar 'brel bar shes pa zin cing mi rtog par gnas pas rig pa 'od la'ajug snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i thugs ga'i gsang lam nas thig le phra mo grangs med par 'char ba dang rang gi snying ga nas 'od thag tshon rkud sbril ba tsamazhig 'char la de tshe 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i 'od la chags zhen med pa dngaḥ ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la rig pa gtad gsol ba gdab mos gus thob pa'i sku de dag rang gi yidalus la zim pa'i snang ba 'char pa ni 'od rig pa la tshur 'jug pa zhes bya'oḥ rang snang la yid ches pas ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu'i thabs mchog tu gyur bas rigs lnga'i zhingadu grol bar 'gyur roḥ der brtan pa ma thob na zung 'jug ye shes la thim pa zhes bya ba steḥ bsam gtan gyi zhag drug pa la rang gi snying kha nas 'od thag shin tu phra ba zhig 'charanas de steng gi nam mkha' la zug par snang ngo der mig ma yeng bar bltas pas snang ba 'od lnga'i klong na rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma thub drag sgo sbongs yab yum

sna dang bcas pa'i sku 'od thig shigs se0 gsung chos nyid kyi sngags sgraḥ thugs mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa dang bcas te 'char laX de tshe 'od mazing snam bu'isteX du thig le zer ldan me long kha sbubs pa tsam ye shes kyi gting mdangs dang ldan pa gsal 'tsher rang 'od kyi zig le lnga lngas brgyan pa'oX desteng dkar po'i snam bu'i stengathig le gsal 'tsher shel gyi phor ba kha sbubs pa lta bu ye shes kyi gting mdangs dang ldan paḥ de'i steng ser po' snam bu la thig le gser gyi phor ba kha sbubs pa tsam dngaX desteng dmar po'i snam bu'i steng pad+ma rwa ga'i phor ba kha sbub pa lta bu ye shes kyi gting mdangs dang ldan par 'char ro de'i steng du 'od zlum po shin tu gsal ba rma bya'i gdug phubapa lta bur 'char ba la rig pa'i rang so ma yengs bar bzhag pa'i grol ba yin noḥ de dag la ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba zhes bya ste bya grub rtsal ma rdzogs pas mi snang ba'o 'dil rdo rje sems dpa'i khong gsang gi lam zhes kyang bya'oX de'i tshe sngar 'dres kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lhar rang snang yin par rang ngo shes shing the tshom dang bral bar mi 'tshor gser gyi

thur ma'i dpe bzhin du rig pa'i rang sa las ma g.yos par btsan sa zin na mi sdog pas rtsal chen thob pa yin noḥ de nas bsam gtan gyi zhag bdun pa la rig 'dzin chen pornam smin tshe dbang phyag chen lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams he ru ga'i cha byad can rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing dar dpyangs dril g.yel mdzes par snyan pa ḍa drila'akhrol bzhin bde chen ye shes kyi yum rnams la rol bzhin bro gar bsgyur zhing nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi gang bar snang zhing thugs ka nas 'od lnga bsgrims ma dngaX duda'agro'i 'od ljang gnyis gshib mar snying shar zug nas 'ong bar 'gyur laḥ de tshe 'od lnga la gus 'dud dad nga/sa rig pa gtod zhes bskul pa dngaḥ dud 'gro'i 'od la ma zhen cig ces pa la sogs gong ma rnams su'ang ngo sprod gdab na shin tu legs so de ltar zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la brtan pa ma thob na khro bo'i lha tshogs 'char ba yin noḥ de yangazhag brgyad pa na ye shes kyi me rjang dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong du dpal chen bud+dha he ru ka smag nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhab bzhi bsgrad paḥ yum bud+dha kro ti shwa ri ma dang

shā 'khril sbyor rol pa rngam brjid mi bzod pas bkrag mdangs 'bar ba 'char roḥ debazhen du zhag dgu par badz+ra he ru ka yab yum mthing nag bcu pa la/rte dhe ru ka yab yum ser nagaḥ bcu gcig par pad+ma he ru ka yab yum dmar nagaX bcu gnyis par garma he ru ka yab yum ljang nag de dag gi 'khor du ko ri ma brgyad seng haphra men brgyad sgo ma bzhi dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad thams cad sku mdog phyag 'tshan mgo brten khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang bcas shar kyang ༷ thugs snying rje ye shes rangamadangs kyi rol pa las rang snang rang la shar ba yin pas tshul rtogs na ngo shes pas grol bar 'gyur bsaḥ de nyid rtsa tshig ltar du ngo sprod gdab par byed pa'ang gal che'oḥ dedag rnams su brtan pa ma thob na zhi ba rnams gnas 'gyur mgon po nag por snang pa dngaḥ khro bo rnams kyang gshin rje chos kyi rgyal por snang zhing las mkhan pho nya shin tu'ajigs rung grangs med pa'i rol par stsang yang ya nga bag tsha bas tshom pa gang yang mi bya bar rang snang bden med sbya ma lnga bur shes na grol bar 'khyar roḥ ngo spod kyang gdab

khyad par rang gi bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing thugs yid bsreḥ yi dam lha la gsol ba lhang lhang gdab cing snang ba de dag lhag pa'i lha'i rol par bltas pas grol bar 'gyuraroḥ der brtan pa ma thob na ye shes lhun grub la thim pa steḥ de yang sngar kyi snang ba de dag dang rig pa steng gi 'od zlum la 'dus snyams pa'i rtsal las steng na ka dag gi snang banam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu dngaḥ de 'og longs sku khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rngam brjed bltar mi bzod paḥ de 'og longs sku zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'tsher lhun sdugaphyogs 'tshams na rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams bkod legs pa: de 'og rigs drug gi snang ba gzugs brnyan lta bu la 'dul byed thub pa drug bcas gzhi las mgayos par gzhi snang 'char lugs thugs rje ltar de snying rje 'khor bar 'jug kyang ris su ma chadaX 'od ltar de nang gdang phyir shar sku ltar de 'gags med mnyam nyidaḥ yeshes ltar de rang snang zang thalaX gnyis med ltar de shes rig rtse gcigaX mtha' grol ltar de ngo bo nyid sang se ma dag pa ltar de srid pa'i 'byung khung ma 'gagasaḥ dag pa ltar

——༷ shar bas ye shes ma bu 'brel ba'oḥ de ltar lhun grub sgo brgyad ltar du snang ba la yid ches shing yang med chen po'i btsan sa 'dzin tshul gong du smos pa ltarasngar 'dres kyi mi dang gser gyi thur ma 'dren ltar yid ches thogs las gzhan du mi g.yo bar sa bzung ༷ dpag chen mda' phyir la mi ldog ltar btsan sa bzung ba'i gshis thogatu mi g.yo bar bzhag pas grol ba yin noḥ de ltar lhun grub sgo brgyad kyis snang ba rang mtshan pa brgyad du bzung ba'i go don phal cher byung na'ang yang dag par mi rtogs 'di dus su mngon shes brgyad ni lhun grub rin po che'i rang snang ye shes kyi don rtog pa dngaḥ rjes dran drug ni lha rjes su dran de yi dam lha zhal de nyid du mthong lam rjes su dranade gom pa'i 'od gsal des lam 'bras la dbang bsgyur skye gnas dran pa'i dbang po tha ma rnams rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la dbugs 'dzin bsam gtan dran pas zhagalnga'am nyer gcig tu gnas bla ma'i man ngag dran pas rang snang gnyis med du smodaḥ lnga ba rjes su dran pas sngar 'dres pas mi la byis 'phrad ngo shes pa lta bu dang drag go/

bskyed rim pa la 'dra min khyad par mchis pa dang mngon shes drug kyang 'byung la de ni sngon kyi skye gnas shes pa dang 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa dngaḥ pha rol po'i semasashes pa dang snang ba lkog gyur shes pa dang rig drug gi gnas mthong zhing shes pa dngaḥ dbang po rnams rnam par dag pa'i mngon par shes pa dang drug 'char roḥ gzhan yang mibarjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i yon tan rnams kyang rgyud la skye steḥ de yang sngon gyi chos rnams rgyud la dus gcig tu skye ba dngaḥ sngar ma thos pas chos rnams kyang 'char bas na chosanyid bar do zhes bya'oḥ sngar shar ba'i lhun grub kyis snang ba nang du sdud pa'i tshe thim lugs brgyad dus gcig la 'byung tshul ni thugs rje nyid la thim pas dpe nyi ma nub pa'izer lta bu'o zhes 'khrul snang drug rang ngo la mi gnas pas bag chags ming med pa 'oḥ ye shes nyid la thim pas dpe ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu ste chos nyid ma bu 'dres pas yeshes log na ma mchis soḥ 'od nyid la thim pas 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yar ba lta bu'oḥ sku nyid la thim pas dpe bum pa'i lha sku lta bu'oḥ mtshan ma'i gdos mtshan dang bral

sgo bar ye shes nang du gsal ba'i don noḥ gnyis med la thim pas dpe chu bo la chu bo thim pa lta bu'o mtha' grol nyid la thi((1 thim pa lta bu'oX zhes thim bya thim byed 'dres nas stong pa la gtad pa'i yul med bsam 'das chen po'i dgongs pa la gnas pa'i tshul lo thim pa ni dpe seng ge'i gangs zin pa lta bu'oḥ de yang rig pa'i rang thog tu sa zin nas ya nga bag tsha med pa'i tshad doX ma dag pa'i sgo dag pa ye shechon thag bsdus pa lta bu'oX de yang thig le nyag gcig tu 'dus pa'i dpe don ste grol byed kyi gnad rig stong zang thal bsam brjod dang bral pas mthar thug gi grol sa gcer mthong yin pas rang thog tu ngo shes dgos yin thog tu thag chod dgosaḥ grol thog tu gdeng bca' dgosaḥ 'a bzang ngabos pas nge tshe nge la sing pa meng nge ris pa ngang po'i 'khal ga'i las 'phasasaḥ rang ngo'i chos 'ing ri sasalaḥ so so rang ris pa'i be+e bab

du byed thog grolaḥ 'bras bu gzhan byung gi rkyen la rag ni ma lusaḥ thad ga'i chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gshis su gtan la pheb pa gang yin pa de ni gdod ma'i grol sachen po ste rang sar gnas pa'i khyad chos dang drug 'dzoms nas phyi gsal gyi mkhyen cha shel 'od nang du nub pa ltar thim la ma rmugs pa chos sku'i ngo boḥ rang bzhin gsal la mirtog gzugs sku gnyis kyi 'char gzhi thugs rje 'jug pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i chos nyid gdul bya'i khams laphrin las rgyun mi chad par 'jug cing nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod pa ni chos dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i gter la longs spyod pa'o0 'de'i sbyangs gzhi ngo bo rang bzhinathugs rje gting gsal du bzhugs pa'oX sbyangs bya sgron ma rnams rtsa thig rlung la brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'oX sbyongs byed gnad gsum kyis gzar zhing sgo yul rlung rigagis thabs la brten nas snang bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs nas sdod thobs kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'oḥ sbangs 'bras chos dbyings gzhan nu bum sku'i dkyil 'khor la longs sprod

phra pa'oḥ de ni chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar do spyong ba'i man ngag zab khyad can la longs spyod pa ni las can skal pa bzang po'i spyod yul lo sa marten spyi don drug pa srid pa bar do'i khrid srid pa rang grol las gyi 'phro mthud pa yur ba rkang chad pa la wa 'dzug pa lta bu'i man ngag laX 'jug byed kyi gang zag dgags paX blam yab yum du dmigs pas mngal sgo dgags pa dang: dga' ba bzhi nyams su blang nas mngal sgo dgags pa 17la lam pas spang sems kyi gnyen po'i mngal sgo dgags padang 'od gsal gyis mngal sgo dgags pa dngaX sgyu lus kyi mngal sgo dgags pa dang0 srid par dbang med du 'khyams tshe de la phan pa'i gdams ngag bstan pa dang bdunalas dang po la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las: dang po ni lar da lta nas lha'i sgom rim la sbyangs pa son pa cig yin na bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i dus su yangaḥ kha char 'tshubasapa dang bu yug lang ba ri bo nil baḥ chu sna shwa 'ud 'phyo ba rlang dmar gsags pa pho nya mang po byung ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: lha'i gsal snang dran par 'khyar laX dran ma

thag par snang cha thams cad yi dam lha ru 'char bar 'gyur ro: de phyir da lta nas bar do sbyangs phyir rtsal sbyangs la 'bad dgos de yang dben pa'i gnas su rang nyid gcigapur 'dug la 'di ltar sgom par bya steḥ ga re snang ba 'di ci yin snyams nas 'o bdag shi nas bar dor 'khyams pa yinaḥ gnas grogs longs spyod sogs snang ba yad yud 'disrid pa bar do'i snang ba yin par 'dug da snga phan chad bar do ngos ma zin nas 'khrul song ba yin nges da ni yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor la 'bad par bya snyams pa'i bla ma'i rnala'abyor bsgom bar do dbugs dbyung ba'i gsol ba yang yang gdab la ltems rkyang med pa'i mos gus kyis bskul tshe bla ma ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can mngon sum du mdun gyi namamakha' la byon nas ngo sprod gnang bar bsam la dal gcig gnasaḥ de nas phyi snod 'jig rten 'di dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams su blta ba dang ༷ nang bcud kyi skye 'gro 'di dag yidam lha'i gsang ba gsum du blta ba dngaḥ sgra grags pa thams cad yi dam lha'i sngags su khyer zhing 'dun pa sprangs sems rtog yi dam lha'i thugs kyi ting 'dzin la mnyam par

41 bzhag goḥ rjesasu thamasacad dmigs med du bzhag la bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'oX de ltar yang yang sbyangs pas srid pa bar do'i snangadro zlochar tsheḥ dang pos bar do ngo sa zinaX bar du bskyed rim dranaḥ tha ma bar do lha'i skur ldang ste mngal sgo kheg nas rig 'dzin gyi sa la spyod par 'gyur roḥ gzhan yang semasacan gyis chags pa spyod pa mthong nas chags pa skye 'am/ bud med yid 'ong la chags pa skyes samaḥ des bdag la dga' gdung gis nyams byung ma thag paraḥ a tsa ma khyod re'akhrulaḥ bdag srid pa bar dor 'khyams nas mngal gyi grong khyer la 'jug grabs byed par 'dug pas: da ni mngal gyi sgo sdom par bya'o snyams nas 'dug goḥ gnyis pa 'jug byed gang zag 'gags pa niḥ spyir bar dor pho mo chags pa spyod pa mthong tshe rang phor skyes na pha la mig ser skyeḥ ma la chags pa 'byungaX ra mor skyes na ma la mig ser dngaḥ phal chags pa ste sdeX de'i dus su da lnga nas bsted rim la goms pa gcig yin naḥ chags pa mig ser ste ba'i dod du yi dam lha'i snar drong nger dran par 'grur laX de gsal ba

dang chags pa 'byung ba dang mngal sgo khegs pa dang lha'i skur smin pa rnams dus mnyam du 'byung ba da lta nas sbyangs pa la brtson dgosaḥ de yang chags pa zhig lhang nger skyes mthag par skad cig dran rdzogs su yi dam gyi lha skur lhang lhang dran par bya ba dngaḥ yang bud med yid 'ong mthong ba na chags pa skye ba'i smra brjod dang spyod lam bya de tshe chags paskye pa dang rkyen des bskul nas rang lus lha'i gsal snang lhang lhang dran nas bde stong mnyam pa'i ngang la lhod der bzhag na zhen med rang grol la song nas 'dod chags ma spangasagrogs su shar ba ste 'dod chags ci tsam che ba de tsam du lha'i rnal 'byor la de tsam 'byang bas bar dor grol ba la tsheg med pa yin noḥ gzhan yang skyes pa pho mo sogs gang mang rung bas sbyor ba byed pa mthong tsheḥ chags pa dang mig ser skyes ma thag ṣā kye ma bdag ni srid pa bar do la 'khyams gyin 'dugaḥ mngal sgo dgags nas dag par ru logadu sbrangs ba la thug pa yin pa la 'dun pa rtse gcig par yi dam gyi lha la sems bzung bar bya dgos so0 de yang snang cha pho mo de yi dam lhag pa'i lha yab yum du lhang nger dran

hoX par bya: mkha' gsang bde ba chen po'i dal du shes pas phyag 'tshal: gsol ba gdabaḥ mos gus drag po bya: dbang skur zhu ba'i 'dun pa dung dung byed pa/ )shems par byaḥ dbang rdzas 'od zer dkar dmar rang la reg pa'i mod la chags sdang gi spros pa dag ༷ lha dang gnyis su med pas skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsamaX yangachags pa spyod pa ma mthong yang yid la de ltar du dran par bya zhingaḥ yi dam gyi lha yab yum la gsal snang rtse gcig tu 'jog cingaX bde stong chags pa dang bral ba'i don la mnyamapar bzhag pas da lta bskyed rims kyi grogs su 'gyur zhing sbyangs pa mthar phyinaḥ srid pa bar dor mngal sgo kheg par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do:gnyis pa nai yang re 'ga'achags pa spyod pa mthong ngamaḥ chags yul dran nam rang chags pa drag po skye ba'i dus su0 chags pa'i yul de nyid bla ma o rgyan pad+ma dngaḥ ye shes mtsho rgyal yab yum rol pachen por mdzad par mos laḥ mig ser gyi smo ngan spangasaḥ yid khyed shes dad pas gsol gdab bya mos gus tshad med pas phyag phul zhing dbang bzhi zhu ba'i 'dun pa drag po

bya: khyad par dbang gsum pa'i don dran par byas nas mig ser spangs la bla ma yab yum bsgom nas 'od zhu byas la rang sems dang dbyer med par bsres nas lhan skyes bdeb chen po'i don dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag pas srid pa'i mngal sgo kheg nas bar dor grol bar 'gyur roḥ gsum pa niḥ thog mar shes rab kyi me'i bde ba'i thig lebazhus pa'i dbu ma'i lam brgyud lte 'og a haṃ btsan thabs su 'dres pas bde stong gi nyams bzod med du 'bar ba la mnyam par bzhag yang 'dres pa'i thig le dkar dmarasngo mdangs chags pa'i mdangs 'od 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor klong chen ma'i khongs su gnas pa la bde ba'i rgyun dngul chu'i thig pa lta bu rim gyis sib sib thim pa ra bsgom la rlungagis gcun zhing sbas sbyor bskyedaḥ nyams skye tsa na thams cad mnyam par bsres nas bde ba'i ye shes chen por ci gnas su bzhagaḥ mthar bde stong ka dag gi dbyings sud migs bsam dang bral bar mnyam bzhag bya'o de ni rang lus thabs ldan ste sngon du song nas gzhan lus phyag rgya la brten par bya dgos de nas mtshan ldan gyi mu tra btsal

sgo ba la spangs blang gnyis las snga ma sgo gsum gyi bya ba la mi dge ba mang zhing bcos su mi btub pa bzhin ngan la rigs nyams paḥ gsang spyod log lta cheb de kha mang tshig 'chol rgyud gyong spro thung ngan smra 'dren paḥ bde rtsa zhig zha rgud gsum canaX ma smin pa mi dge ba yid du mi 'ong ba'o spyor bud med bzang ngan thams cad rigasacan lngar 'du yang skyon gyis phyur bor 'dug pa las yon tan sna gcig med pa dag ni spangs bar ma byas na rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad gcod cing mi 'dod pa'i char gyisagadung la tshe thung nad mang bkra mi shes par 'gyur zhing gsang sngags kyi che ba nyamasaḥ bstan pa la gnod 'bras bu ngan song dmya ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par spyod dgos payin noX phyi ma blang bar bya ba la mkha' 'gro ma'i rig can dngaḥ phal ba'i rigs gnyis las snga ma ni yon tan byis phyur bur gtams paḥ skyon kun dang bral ba ngag snyan pa rgyad drangs shing 'khor ba la mi 'jug paḥ dpa' brdzul che zhing sgod lam stoms paḥ de lta bu ni mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs zhes bya ba la brten na mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la

thob par gdod mi za ba yin no 'di'i tha ma ni sha za mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin pas brten na rgyud brlag par 'gyur zhing tshe la bza' bas spangs bar bya'oḥ phyi ma pha'arigs la phyi nang gsang ba gsum la lnga re phye bas dang po la rgyal rigs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang rje rigs rdo rje rigs dngaX dmang rigs rin ngo che'i rigathabram ze'u rigs pad+ma'i rigs dang gdol ba sha zan mngon spyod kyi rigs su shes par bya ba dang0 gnyis pa gnod sbyin ma dngaX lha mo dngaX klu mo dang tshangs pa mo dngaḥbyin gyi bu mo rnams ti snang ba dbang bsgyur gyi rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod yul yin noḥ gsum pa pad+ma can la ni rtsa pad rnal ltar yod pas pad+ma'i rigs dang dung can ma ni can ltar 'khyil ba ste rin po che'i rigs dang: ri mo can ni rtsa ri mo ltar yod de las kyi rigs dngaḥ ri dwags can ni rtsa gla ba'i rtsi lta bu'i bkab pa ste rdo rje'i rigs dngaX sna can ni glang po'i sna ltar yod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs soḥ na tshod ni bcu drug nas sum bcu'i bar la brten na tshe bsod 'phelaḥ nyams rtogs rgyasaX sheja

——rjo klong nas rdolaḥ dad dang snying rje'i rtsal rgyasaḥ tshor ba bde nad med lang tsho daraḥ khams 'phel las stobs rgyasaḥ mkha' 'gro mnyes nas dngos grub thamasacad 'bad med du thob par 'gyur roḥ de yang grong pa'i chos dang nyes skyon gyis ma reg pa ni gnad kyi dam pa'oX mchan ldan gyi rig ma la brtes thabs mi bya zhing dam tshig dngaldan pas rtag tu brten par bya'oḥ de ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rig ma ni gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba'i grogs su med thabs med pa yinaḥ 'di sa gzhi dang 'dra ste mabasten na sangs rgyas pa nam yang mi sridaḥ phyag rgya ni nam mkha' dang 'dra ste 'bras bu'i yon tan gyis skabs phyed par byed0 rig ma ni kha zas phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste 'dibasten pas sa lam rtags kyi yon tan rgyas par 'gyur roḥ gzung ma ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ste yon tan gyi chos thams cad 'byung bar shes nas dam tshig ldan pasadangs du blang bar bya'oḥ de 'dra phyag rgya mtshan nyid can mthong tshe dgugs pa'i cho gas dbang du bsgrar la dben pa'i gnas su khridaḥ sngon 'gro'i chos kyis nges 'byung gi blo

bskyed sdom pa dang ldan pas byang chub kyi sems gnyis bslab de nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhing dam tshig 'bogs lam rim gnyis gom du bcug la drod rtag thon parabyas te las su rung bar bya'oḥ de ltar ma yin pas phyag rgya phal bar brten pas yon tan mi skye sa lam gyi grogs su mi 'gyuraX rang gzhan la don chung ba byis pa'i rtsed mo dnga'adra bas thog mar sbyangs smin rdzogs gsum gal cheḥ de nas lus la gos gsar ba bgo zhing rgyan bzang pos sprasaX dri zhims chus khrus byaḥ 'bras bu mar dang bzang drug khyadapar dza ti sbyar ba'i bsku mnye bya: kha zas ro bcud ldan pas lus zung bskyedaḥ rtsa rlung gi 'khrul 'khor la sbyang ba ni yab yum gnyis gas bya'oX de nas nyin zhag 'ga' la bsilabang du 'dug cing chang bzang po dang 'o ma bskol bar bstenaX dus la bab pa na bde ba'i gdan gcig tu yab yum 'khod nas sgo gsum gyi spyod pas bde ba bslang 'du shesagasum gyis rang mtshan pa'i 'khrul zhen phral sbor thabs kyi sbya rtsal la mkhas pas byang sems 'khor lo bzhi ru rbal nur 'gros ltar dbabaḥ dga' ba bzhi ngos bzung de'i

—— drangs pa'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhagaḥ rtsa gsum dam can rnams bdud rtsi'i mchodaX tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib bzhi dgaḥ dbang bzhi thob sku bzhi'i sabon theb par bsamaḥ byang sems lte 'og tu gsang ba zin tsam la dbab pa dang rlung gyen du drangs shing bu gar yi ge gnas pa nyid shin tu gsal gdab rgyu ba'i rtsa gtem pasogs kyis thig le 'dzag med du gsang ba'i sna rtser bcings te rgyas gdabaḥ kha sbyor gsum ldan gyi bde ba chen po'i drangs pa'i lhan skyes ye shes la mnyam par bzhagaX thig lerdzas sgod kyi them bu dgag pa ltar bskyil ba gnad yinaḥ de nas thig le cung zad kyang ma nyams par sgo gsum 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba'i rtsal chen gyi mda' ltar btsan thabs suspyi bor ldog la mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i drangs pa'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag yang 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor bas yur chu zhing la 'byed pa bzhin thig le rtsa gnas thamasacad la khyad par bkram mthar thams cad sming kha'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su dngas ma 'od lnga'i thig le gdos bcas dang bral ba'i rnams par bsnas teḥ de la rtse gcig tu mnyam

par bzhag mthar bde ba dang sten dang bsten pa myong ba'i shis rig rgyu ba'i rlung sogs 'dzin rtsol thams cad ka dag bde ba chen por la bzla zhing stong nyid ngos bzung med pagasal la der 'dzin bral ba zung lajug brjod du med paḥ rang gsal lhun grub khyab brdal chen po'i ngang du rang babs su bzhag goX rjes kyi dam tshig la rig mar dngos po'iyon gyis mchod cing nyam myong gi gnad la sbyor bas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don grub par bya ba yin no rang nyid kyis kyang zas dang sman sbyor sogs kyi thig le 'phelathabs bya zhing rgyun du thabs lam bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya'oḥ de ltar gom pa'i dpe yi ye shes rtsal 'byongs bas don gyi 'od gsal la spyor ba yin noX de yang tshogs lam du 'dun pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor brnyes te rlung sems lus su rung sbyor lam gyi dus su rigs chen 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor brtes te rlung sems zung 'jugaphyag rgya chen po'i skur 'thab mthong lam du dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rnal 'byor brnyes te ye shes rang mtshan pa mngon du gyur bsgom lam du lung chen thob pa'i rnam par brnyes

—— te rigs kyi phyag rgya rtags kyis spras pa'i skur snangaḥ mthar lam gyi sa gsum du rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor brtes te dri ma sra ba spangs nas ye shesachen po mngon du gyur te mngon rdzogs he ru ga'i skur byang chub pa yin noḥ de ltar ma nus kyang yang yang goms pa'i mthu dang ldan na rab 'chi dus su 'byung ba thim rims kyibasdus nas mthar ma las thob pa'i rak+ta gyen du 'byung pha las thob pa'i byang sems spyi bor nas thur du bab ste snang mched gnyis kyis khu rdul snying gar 'phrad tshe rnam shesagator brgyal la mi 'gro bar dbang gsum pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bas gang zag des nges par ngos zin nas skad cig nyid la yar gyi zang thal du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ni gsangasngags thabs kyis lam yin pa dang pho nya'i nye lam myur ba'i gtan tshig de ltar roḥ der ros ma zen na'ang 'bring rnams chos nyid kyi bar dor zhi khro rab 'byams yab yuma'akhril sbor gyi ska mthong ma thag sgo dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi ye shes lhan cig stes pa'i dga' ba'i 'od gsal ngos zin nas grol bar 'grur roḥ der ma zen pas tha ma dag

gis kyang srid pa bar dor pho mo chags pa spyod pa mthong tshe mig ser dang chags rtog mi byed par lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes dran zhing ngos zin nas mngal sgo kheg te nges parabar do chod cing rig 'dzin gyi sa la spyod par 'gyur ba'oḥ de yang gsang sngags gzhan las zab cing ches myur ba'i phyir roḥ bzhi pa ni da lta dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gangayin rung sdom pa gces par bsrung zhing bskyang bar byas nas: gzhan gyis chags pa byed pa mthong ngam thos samaḥ chags yul dran pa'amaX bud med mthong ba la rkyen byasa'adod chags g.yo ba'i tshe mi sdug pa bsgom pa'am/ spangs sems drag pos bslab pa gces par byas pas mthusaḥ bar dor pho mor chags pa spyod pa mthong ngam dran tshe bslabapa dran pa dang spangs sems dran te mngal du mi 'jug par mngal sgo khag pa'am0 yang dag pa'i mngal du skyes nas mtho ris thob par 'gyur roX 'ad ni lam gong ma las cungazad dman zhing blo rtsing ba dang thag dman rigs pa can kyis sgod yul loḥ lnga pa niḥ de ltar gzhi khreg chod kyi lam la sbrang ba son cing stong nyid kyi don la gom 'dres dang ldan

dpa pa rnamasaḥ rab 'chi kha'i bar dor gzhi'i 'od gsal ngos zin nas bar do med par ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i grol sa mngon du gyur padangaX 'bring rnams nyer thob nam mkha' la thim pa'amaḥ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim tshe gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal zung du 'jug te ma pang bu 'jug pa ltar grol bar 'gyur padang tha ma'ang lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang ba nang dbyings ka dag tu bsdus nas rig pa 'od gsal mtha' grol chen po la gdengs tshug te chos dbyings gzhon nu bum skur byangachub pa yin no shin tu tha na'ang srid pa'i bar dor chags pa spyod pa mthong ba na snang stong yul med lta ba'i gding thog tu pheb shing rig stong zug 'jug sgom pa'i 'od gsalagyi mthu lasaX shar grol dus mnyam rjen pa'i spyod pas la dor nas nang dbyings su grol ba thob par 'gyur roXdrug pa nai de ltar ma dag pa'i sgyu lus dang: dag pa'i sgyu lusasnang ba rang grol la sbrangs pa'i yon tan gyisaX bar dor 'jigs smags dngaḥ mngal sgo shar ba'i tshe na'angaX sbya ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes te grol bar 'byur roḥ de

rnams kyi nyams len rtsa ba mdor bsdu na skye gnas bar do'i snang ba thams cad bskyed rim pas dag mnyam lha dang lha mor sbyongs ba dngaX rdzogs rim pas bde stong zug 'jugabyang chub sems kyi dal du sbyongs ba dang: khreg chod kyis rig stong ka dag rol par la bzla ba dngaḥ zod rgal bas dbyings rig thig ler nyams su blangs shing rtsal sbyangs bdangaḥ bag chags kyi snang ba sgyu lus dang 'od gsal sprul brgyur du sbyangs ba des 'chi kha dang chos nyid bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i bar dor grol bar 'gyur roḥ gzhan yang dus rgyunadu nyams len bya tshul la snang ba so ma 'di ma bcos ka dag gi ngang la phyam me bzhagaḥ rtog pa 'phro na grol lugs chen po bzhi'i gdeng gi zin par byas la cir snang gang shar dubaskyang ngoX rnam pa kun tu da lta'i snang yul mched tshe nga shi nas bar dor 'khyams pa'i snang yul zing zing srid pa bar do'oX skye 'gro sems can 'di dag kyang bar do'i skye 'gro yin gang snang gang shar gang grags thams cad bden med rmi lam rgya ma lta buX gtad med mi bden pa'i rang bzhin yin no snyams pas smrabs 'gro nas bzung ste bsted rdzogs zung

—— 'jug don dam phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la phyam phyam du bzhag la bag chags goms 'dres yang yang 'jog goḥ ngag nas kyang bar do yin zhes brjod bdagabar dor 'khyams nas 'dug pas bla ma mkhyen bla ma mkhyen bla ma dkon mchog gsum mkhyenaḥ zhes brjod la bar do'i rtsa tshig dang: 'phrang sgrolaḥ ra mda' sbran pa dang/'jigs pa skyobs pa'i smon lam brtson zhingaX mdor na bar do'i chos la blo sbyongs bar byed pa dang: 'dun pa sbyangs ba de las lhag par bsgom rgyu med pas bar do'i 'dun pargyun chags dang sems nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam bzhag byed pa la brtson noḥ des rab tshe 'dir 'bring 'chi khar tha ma chos nyid bar dor yang tha srid pa bar dor las kyi'aphro mthud nas grol bar the tshom med doX bdun pa ni 'char tshul bshad pa dngaX ngo sprod gdab pa gnyis las: dang po niḥ phyi lus kyi srid pa yid lus dbang po kun tshang thogamed du rgya nang sems kyi srid pa smems byed kyi com par rdog pa du ma la yid 'jag: lus sems gnyis 'das kyi cha can de srid pa rdo rje'i gdan dngaḥ ma'i mngal gnas

gnyis po ma gtogs gang du'ang thogs med du 'jug pa yinaḥ de yang rdo rje'i gdan ni ka dag mi 'gyur ba'i nang dbyings dang sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgya ba'i gnas mchogad ga pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgor zhugs pa der 'dod ma'i mngal ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo 'gro drug gi skye gnas gang rung la 'dod pa yin la de lta'i bar do'i srid pa can denyed ri brag la sogs pa 'byung ba gang la'ang thog med du 'jug pa'i nus pa yod pasaḥ sngon 'byung skye ba'i sha gzugs can dbang po kun tshangs la thog med du ldan pa dngos lusalta ci dang yid lus kyang ma yin teḥ rang ngo la yod yod 'dra yang rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bur 'char bas cha la btag par zad de ni rigs mthun pa dang lha'i mig thob pa mgatogs gzhan gyis phar mi mazong zhing des tshur sems can kyi gnas rigs thams cad mthong laḥ ming bzhi 'du phung las rlung gi bskyed pa can des bya sgro rlung dang 'dra ba zhes pa phyad phyod sngar bas dran pa bdun 'khyar gyis gsal la nga shi'o snyam tsam gyis sngag bsngal drag po 'byung ngoḥ de yang bar dor ci tsam gnas pa'i yar byed snga ma'i gzugs

dze snang gi rnam pa can dngaḥ mar phyed phyi ma gang skye de'i lus dang rnam 'gyur can du snang ba'oḥ re 'ga' bdag dam tshig nyams pa dngaX mtshams med pa'i las(rgos spyod rnams bar do med par mar gyi zang thalaḥ phal cher rtogs pa dang ldan rnams yar gyi zang thalaX 'pho ba 'byung ba'i skye gnas du'ang zang thal ba'i bar do med do zab mo'i gnad ma mthong ba dngaḥ log lta the tshom can dngaḥ dam tshig la skyon zhugs pa dngaḥ nyams su ma lon pa rnams la chos nyid bar do yun thung bas grol longs med do bred sngang kyi gdung ba dang bcas srid pa'i bar dor kha 'khyal la zhag bdun la skye 'chi'i snang ba re shar nas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o bar srid kyi tshe ring mtha' zhe dgu dngaX thungamatha' bdun du spyir bshad kyang re 'ga' dge ba'i stobs kyi glo bur du 'pho ba dngaḥ kha cig pa mtshams rgyang ring ba yod pas mtha' gcig tu 'dzin bar mi bya'o: gang ltarayang 'di dus su yur ba rkang chad pa la wa 'dzug pa lta bu'i man ngag gal che steX de yang mngon shes dang rjes dran nyi tshe ba dang ldan pas bla ma la mos gus bsted ༷ phyogs bcu

sprul ba'i zhing khams yid la dran par byas te zhing der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po gtad pa'i shes rig rlung zhon gang du'ang bsam pa'i yul la skad cig sleb pa'i rdzu 'phrul nyi tsheb dang ldan pas rang snang zhing der dbugs dbyung zhing grol ba thob par 'gyur roX der rang dbang ma thob par 'khyams na skye gnas ngan pa rnams la brtags shing 'brel bgacod dgos soX dmyal ba la sol bas sdong dum lta bur snang ba dang yi dwags la 'od du ba 'dra ba dang byol song dud sprin khrag mdog dang rang rang la rang mdog gi 'od bcas snang na ngan 'gror lhung ba'i ltas su shes teḥ de bzhin tu lha min la kha char drag po'i snang nyams dngaX mi la 'od 'doms gang ba dngaḥ lha la 'od dkar po dpag tshad tsama'achar ba dang khyad par 'dod par skye na lus la sred pa dngaḥ gzugs kham su skye na 'od la sred pa dngaḥ gzugs med du skyes tshe sems gnas la chags par 'gyur ba dang gzhan yang 'byur ba'i log pa'i ste gnas de dag la rtse gcig tu bsgrim te 'jug pa spangs pa ni gnad dam pa'o phal cher gyi snang bar lus 'phags por stes na ngang pa zungs

—— dngaḥ sgra mi snyan la nya zungs dang: ba glang spyod la glang po zung: 'dzam bu gling la mi pho mo chags pa spyod pa mthong ba la rabs kyi chags sdang dang mig serasmrangs nas snang ba bden med du rtsal sbyongs shing ka dag gi don la gdangs tshugs nas grol ba dang 'bring gis dbang don gyi ye shes dran nas bde stong gi don la mnyam parabazhag nus pa'amaX bla ma dang yi dam yab yum kyis bskyed rim dran nas mngal sgo ru 'o ga la dag pa'i zhing khams mched de dgags bsdams kyi mthu las sras bde ba chen porabyang chub pa dang: tha mas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam ltar 'dod chags la mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes dang zhen log gi gnyen po brten zhing dag pa'i zhing yid la byas pasapangal sgo kheg te mngon dga' dang bde ba can la sogs par pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skye bar len par 'gyur ba dang shin tu tha na'ang 'dzam gling dbus kyi char man ngag dmadros dar ba'i yul du rigs lngan dag pa'i mngal gnas btsal la spral ska'i rnal 'byor nyid kyis 'jag cing dam chos byang chub smom sgab kyi las la rang smran tshud pas smon lam

med sprul pa'i skuX dbyer med mnyam pa nyid la bstodaX chags pa'i ma gos mnyam pa'i zhalaḥ 'od gsal phyogs ris bral ba'i skuḥ kun la snyom pa'i thugs rje canaḥ bla ma'i gsang ba gsum la stodaX dpa' bo pho tshogs lta mgur sgrogasaḥ dpa' mo'i nyams dga' snang glu gyeraX king dang ling ga'i bro gar bsgyur ༷ gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs la bstod:ye nas gnyis med bde chen zhalaX ma rig dbang gyur rtog pa'i nongs: gol shor nor sogs 'khrul ba'i skyonaḥ mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings su bshags0 sa ma yā āḥ 'dzab naḥtrīḥ rang nyid rig 'dzin bla ma yi thug gar nyi zla ga'u'i sbug rigs pa hrī la sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas rtog sgrib bag chags sbyangasaḥ grimed ye shes mngon gyur ngang skyed ma hā gu dza bī ma la mi tra sarba sidhi hrīḥ dgongs pa skye med don la bzhag spro bsdus gzung 'dzin rdul bral 'gyur sa ma yāḥsgrub 'dzab niḥhrīḥ bla ma'i thugs che ga sngags 'khor lasaḥ spros pas 'od kyis rgyal kun mchodaḥ sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyangs snang grags rigs gsum bde ba cheX lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: rme badz+ra ma hā gu ru bit+ya rda ra sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ

mtshan ma sna tshogs pa ka dag dbyings su bcom par mdzodaX gsang ba las kye dgra gsum kyang chos zad chen por dul bar mdzod lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i rdzongs spros da nga bral bar zin par mdzod bsgom pa nor 'khrul gol shor 'phrangaḥ rang rig bla mas bsal bar mdzodaḥ spros pa 'khor 'das ro mnyam sgogs 'phrog lugs bzhi ldan gdeng thob shog 'bras bu bral thob mi dmigs pa snang shes gzhir stong ye grol mdzod tha snyad rjes 'brel 'dul zhing kunaḥ rang snang dpal rir grol bar mdzod: bde stong nyams rtsal rdzogs pa'i 'khor longs sku'i zhing la mnga' brtes shog 'od gsal rig par gdeng thob nasaḥ nang dbyings chos skur byang chub shog: de ltar gsol bawa don gnyis 'grub bslu ba med do dngos gzhi'oḥ sa ma yuḥgasum pa rjes kyi rim pa la rnam grangs bco lnga dag gis bstan dang po tshogs dzos yo byad bsags byin gyis brlabs par bya ba na rterteḥ bde chen byedad mchog ka pa lar bza' ba tshogs pa'i dga' ston bkodaḥ rnam rtog dri kun rab gcod cingaḥ khyab brdal ye shes 'dor lo spelaḥ tshe u/ ha ho trīḥ spyan 'dren ni ka hrīḥ rang snang mi shig

sgo don gyi zhing rnam dag 'og min chos dbyings nasaḥ brgyud gsum bla ma sras dang bcasaḥ ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs ༷ sa ma ya dza dzaX tshogs phud (༄1 bde bar gshegasapa bcom ldan 'dasaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgyes ston 'diḥ mnyam pa chen por 'bul lags naḥ thim pas tshul gyis gzhes su gsolaḥ a la la ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ bar༅gas niḥho ma reg gnyis 'dzin dbang gyur teḥ sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa dngaḥ lta ba dman zhing sgom yun thungaX spyod rtsing 'bras bu mngon rlom byasaḥre togs a 'thas dri ma kun ཿ ye shes tshogs kyi bskang zhing bshags oṃ ga na tsakra sa ma ya shukhye a bsgral ba naḥhūṃ hūṃḥ bdag tu blta ba'i rtog pa can re dwogs a 'thas gol ba'i gdonaḥ mtshon chen shes rab phur pas bsgralaX 'khrul ba skye med dbyings su bcomaḥ sarba rū tra ma ra ya phaṭaḥ bstabs pa ni trīḥ chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhalaX bde stong zung 'jug e sang duX log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabasaḥ mnyam pa nyid du 'dren rol cig ma hā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha ram̐ khā hi lhag ma ni gertsi stong pa chos nyid

srog 'chang zhing phrin las bzhi yi las la rgyuḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi tshogs khang 'grimasaḥ dam tshig can la snying nye zhing 'gal ba ston la bdud byed pasaḥ ma sring ging ling dbang phyug rnams pham phab gtor ma 'di bzhes laX rnal 'byor bzhed don yongs grub mdzodaḥ 3sna ma ma hrīng sarba uṣ+ṭi ṭa bha mi ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ bskul pa niḥshā bye skyemed chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥ 'gags med sgyu ma'i gzugs sku dzasgyu bzhengs shig rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha snyigs ma'i rgud pa kun sol la 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa dngaḥ dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar mdzodaḥ tshadatho na ཿ bh+yoḥ thogs mtha' bar gyi dus tshigs laḥ spyi dpal dbang chen rig 'dzin gyiḥ spyan sngar khang blang dam mnos bsaḥ dpal mgon dregs pa rgya mtshos tshogs don du nges don mthong mod kyangaḥ da dung 'jig rten tshul 'dzin pa'i sgrub mchog grogs su 'bod legs kyi brtse gdung ma bu'i 'du shes kyis gtor ma long la sdong grogs kyis 'gal zla bar chad bsal ba dang rnam bzhis phrin las char ltar phob sa lam spel ba'i grogs po byosaḥ 'ja' lus 'od skur skyel ma

sgo mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāX bstan ma ni bye tshoges kyi bdag po he ru ga'i bka' nyan bod khams skyong mdzad pasaḥ ma yam bstan ma g.yog dpre casaX brtse gdung gus 'dud bran bzhin duḥ skad cig nyid du 'dir pyon nasaX rnal 'byor spyi bor blang bcas teḥ bshal chu brngan gtor 'di bzhes la dkar po dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzod nag po'i phyogs rnams sma phob laX 'jig rten bde skyid ldan par mdzodaḥ ma ma trīng hrīng bha ling khā tīḥ rta0ni hū hūḥ chas nyid stang pa'i sgrom rgya ru rnam rtog gnyis snang rū tra brubaḥ dbang chen rta glu bro gar bsgyuraḥ byang chub thob par ldang med rgyaX ma ra ya nan bzod gsol niḥnyo rdze btsun bla ma sbyan snga rtsa dad dang mos gus chung ba dang ༷ the tshom log lta brtes thabs shor rtsa ba yan yag dam nyams bshagasaḥ sa ma ya shukhye āḥ bsngosmon ni nyo dus gsum dge spyad ci mchis paḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngoḥ gnyis snang srid par 'khyams rnams kunaḥ ye shes chos skur sad par shogaḥ bsduldang na ཿāḥ snang cha thabs kyi 'khor lo kun shes rab stong pa'i

dbyings su bsduḥ slar yang ye shes sgyu mar ldang: rjes thob thabs mkhas thugs rjes spyodaḥ aX ā phaṭa phaṭa shis brjod ni na re byen rlabs yod tan sprin 'khrigs shing dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs dad ldan gdul bya'i myu gu sminaḥ bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyasaḥ sems can bde legs dpal dang ldanaḥ yangs pa'i rgyal khams chos kyis 'tshoḥ rnam kun dge ba'i shes pa rtsolaX stong zhing bdag med lta bu'i klong: gsal la 'dzin med bsgom pa'i ngang thugs rje rgyun 'byung spyod pa'i bab: lhun rdzogs 'bras bu'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar bkra shis rgya cher bya bsngo ba smon lam rgya yi gdab 'di bsgrub rnal 'byor nyes skyon byang tshe dang nyams rtog yon tan 'phel srid pa'i bag chags zag pa zad ye shes dwa sa ma'i sgyu lus 'grub zab pa'i rno nus bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal sa ma yāḥ e maḥ 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i brda chos nyid nam mkha' rnal 'byor gyaḥ sred len bral ba'i brda ris las bstan 'gro'i dpal du gsal bar bya sngags kyi bdag mo' thub par srung bka' log lag tu mi 'chor bar thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa

47 / 'di'ang lung zin dkon mchog mtshan can gyis thab shes mtshon pas skyes bcas nan tan chen po' bskul ngor/kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dag snang rin po' che' 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba dge cho de 'phel/sarba ma lam/ge pa dag snang lasaḥbla sgrub mi shig thig le bzhugs —10 namo gu ru yāḥzudza sgo rang bab so ma'i ngang bskyangs teḥ.uchos dbyings thig le nyag gcig klongs longs spyod rdzogs mdzad 'od lnga'i dkyilaḥsprul sku ye shes sgyu ma'i zhal snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal:cha ma hā gu ru bī ma mi tra sarba sidhi hūṃX ye yin de nyid don la blta rtogs dpyod spros pa 'i grwa zur bral rtsal sbyangs dgongs pa rgyas theb naḥgating gsal bla ma' rang zhal mthong sa ma yuḥsngag mchod phul rjes bstod pa niḥ( hrī zag med bde chen rdo rje'i skuḥbarjod bral na dā don gyis gsung skye 'gags spros bral ye shes thugs0 bla ma'i gsang ba gsum la bstodaḥdage ba bsngo zhang smon lam gdab khyer so bzhi dang ldan par bya dag mnyam bla ma' rnal 'byor bsgom

nugs yid gcig bsres nyams len brtsonaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham lha zhes pa'ang lung zan dkon mchog blo gros nas bskur ngor/ nus ldan pa sa so/ dge'o/——— snyan brgyud las sngags kyi bdag mo'i gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub bzhugs/ —134 :྅'u nanarna gtor skyems bshams 'phral sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal teng 'dzin brtan po yis spyo rang mdun dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas khrag mtsho lcags kyi drwa ba canaḥ thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klongaḥ dgra bgegs bskyil ba'i gdan steng nasaX 'bum phrag rgyud srung ral gcig ma: snying nas 'bod do da tshur byon sgrub pa po la 'bral med bzhugs ma bu'i dam tshig sgog gcig bsre brin las sgrub phyir lha phyag 'tshal dbu 'phangs mtho phyir mnga' gsol loḥ phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtshos bskang lta bsgom spyod pa nor 'khrul bshags che ba'i yon tan rjo gas la bstodaḥ lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogasaX ting 'dzin go don mdzub mos sprodaḥ sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed cingaX phyi nang gsang rkyen zhi ba dang rtogs pa'i na sbor nyams rtogs

dzeX spel sgyu lus bde stong me yis zhu dngas ma 'od kyi sku ru spyoraḥ 'gro ba'i rlung sems bdag dbang bsgyuraḥ dam pa chos kyi lam la sbyor bshad sgrub yar ngo ba zu ltar spelaḥ mdzad brin nam mkha'i pha mthar rgyasaḥ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sa la sbyor: don gnyis 'byung ba'i grogs po mdzod dam tshig ma g.yel sa ma yā: grangs bsogs snying nye phrin las myur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa 'a dkon blos bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel pa mang ga lam/ dge'o/

ro/ snyan brgyud las: bla sgrub skor gsum gyi dus su nye bar mkho ba'i bshags pa mun sel sgron me bzhugs soḥ——1 na mode sa yāḥ 216rgaspyod/ sas nyams rtog sgrib sbyangs ba'i phyir rig pa'i ngang bskyangs 'di skad do ma sgrib bral chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal loḥ gzod nas dag pa'i rig pa ye shes zhalaḥ bcing grol las 'das spang rtogs dmigs su medaḥ sangs rgyas nyag gcig sems su ma 'khrul ba'iḥ thog ma'i mgon po yab yum brtse bas dgongasaḥ bdag med bdag tu 'khrul ba'i ma rig pas ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ris su bcad ngang mdangs sku dang ye shes nang dbyings bor phyi gdangs 'od lngar bdag bzung spros pa bshags kha dog 'byung ba phung khams tshogs yul bltasaḥ phung lnga rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldogaḥ srid pa tha snyad tsam du gol ba'i nongs: rang bzhin dag pa'i stong nyid chen por bshagasaḥ ming tshig rtog btags thams cad rang bzhin med ngo bo zang thal bar med nyag gcig klong don la lhun 'byams phyal ba ka dag kyangaḥ

rten 'byung bkod pa lhun grub chen por bshagasaḥ lta ba dman pas yang dag don ma rtog0 sgom pa 'jugs blos rang rig rtsal ma rdzogs spyod pa 'du 'dzis nyams rtogs bog ma thon 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur sgrib tshogs mtha' dag bshagasaḥ mnyam 'grogs bdud bzhis sa lam 'bras bu bcomaḥ grogs ngan rkyen gyis bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin g.yelaḥdzig la 'char bas 'khrul snang g.yengs dbang shoraḥ ma rig rmongs sgrib bar chad rkyen rnams bshagasaḥ skyabs kun spyi gzigs bla ma mi ru bzungaX gdams ngag bdud rtsi ma btung zags su shor: dam tshig ngo lkog gyur te thugs khrel nongasaḥ mkha' mnyam chos sku'i dgongs par bshags bgyi'oḥ sangs rgyas rang la rdzogs pa'i zhal ma 'tshos bams gsum rten 'brel tsam la mngon zhen chagasaX mi rted 'phags pa'i nor bdun rdul dang brjes gol sgrib mtha' dag chos kyi dbyings su bshagasaḥ skyen bral tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub rtenal ༷ a āḥ de ltar bshags pas sgrib tshogs dag dro med ye shes rtogs pa 'charaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang las ldan rat+na sa ra'i mos blos bskul ngor kho bo

shā1) nus ldan pas rma mdun nas spel ba'i yi ge'i ras byed me tra'i bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma lam/༷༷ gnam phud bskang ba bsdus pa ni tshogs phud skyems mchod 'di skad doḥ.o āX sa stong pa dbyings la dbang bsgyur ba'iḥ 'bum phrag rgyud srung e ka dzaḥ ma lnga dmag zor rgyal mo dang legs ldan ma hā ka la ni lcam dral sprul 'khor bsam mtha' yas snang srid yul gzhi'i zor dor bcasaḥ ma lus 'du ba tshogs la byon sha chang dga' ston dgyes par rolaḥ nyams chags rtog sgrib ma lus bshagasaX bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i grogs sa lam mthar phyin phrin las sgrub: bshad sgrub yar ngos zla ltar spel gdul zhing rig 'dzin sa la skyol don gnyis lhun grub grogs mdzod cigaX dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ tsan ma hā ga ṇa tsakra byu dza khā hiḥ de ltar phul ba'i dregasatshog bskang phrin lasarab 'byams gegs med 'grub sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang nus ldan pa so/

tre snyan brgyud las rdzas bskang bsod nams sprin 'khrigs bzhugs soḥdapa na mo gu ru yāḥ ma hūṃ hrīḥdabyings rig dbyer med gnyug ma'i byed d+ma mchog dgong brgyud bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bulaḥdangos kun dngas ma ye shes lnga ru 'khrulaX brda brgyud bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la 'bul rten 'brel gnas stong bde ba chen po'i khrag ༷snyan brgyud bla ma sprul pa'i sku la 'bulaX 'khor 'das brtan g.yo gtor ma'i phung por sharaḥbargyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma'i dal du 'bulaḥm rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba ka dag steḥnang dbyings gdod ma'i sku gsum mngon gyur shogaḥde ltar bskang bas tshogs rdzogs shingaḥsgrab dag nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyasaḥs ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang rat+na sa ra' mos blos bskul ro ra/nus lan dpal gyi rdo rjes rma rgyal chen po' gnas mdun nas spel ba'i ye ge pa na snyang nor me shis bgyes pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masko lam/—— snyan brgyud las chogasabasdugaye shesasnyang po bzhugasaḥ——3 thas ba bza' bayo dga' ston tshogs su spel rgyal ba' thugs dam bska ba na ram̐ ye khaṃḥsnyed

phahūḥ gzhi grol dwangs ma chos sku'i klong yangs nas rtsa gsum mnyam rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ ye shes rtsal mdangs 'khor tshogs sprul bar bcasaḥ 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol chos nyid mnyam pa'i dga' ston 'bul lo bzhesaḥ sor byang sngags sdom 'gal 'das nor 'khrul bshagasaḥ rlung sems gnyis rtog ma rig rū tra bsgral bde chen klong yang dbu ma'i dgongs klong bstabs tshim pa drug ldan sngags kyi zlos gar rolaX rjes thob spyod pa dam tshig lhag ma'i skyong: bka' sdod dregs pas gnyer bcol las rnams sgrubasaX ma yam bstan ma'i phyi nang nyer 'tshe bzlog ༷ srid pa'i snang shes chos nyid lta dgongs brubaḥ gdod nas 'khrul bral gnyug ma'i dngos grub stsolaḥ 'khrul ba rang zhig 'khor gsum yongs dag teX gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen por sangs rgyas shog de ltar grangs bsogs phrin las sgrubs tshe dpa 'a nyams rtogs 'phe la zhang rgyas dngos grub 'bad med thob par 'gyur the tshom mi dgos sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thamaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin dkon mchog blo gros nas bskul ro ra nus ldan pas spel ba mang ga lam/ dge'oḥ

shā bskang rdzas byan brlabs na ཿo āhūṃ hrīḥmanyam nyid dgongs pa'i rol mtsho rtsating 'dzin gzugs brnyan ci shar yang ye shes rig pas dang blang nas gzhir /rterdor+sha bla ma'i gsang gsum bskang:'khrul snang nyams chags rang grol teḥbasdus ma'i rtogs pa rgyas gyur cig badz+ra spa ra ṇa saXsngags da phyag rgyas spel loḥs ma māḥzhes nus ldan pas smras te yi ge'i ris byed me cas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga lam/dge'o/da bskang dzos byin rlabs niḥzhe rab yang stong gsum rgyar mnyam ka pā lar:bza' ba tshogs shing rnam rtog gcod pa'i rjes sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi che ba 'dzomasaḥrgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir:ting 'dzin rol ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas sproXdakyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i sprin du gyur:nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum dang badz+ras ra ṇa dzaḥzhes brjod la spel khyabs su bya'o 'di yang dkon mchog blo gros ngor/nu ldan dpa 'a bos spel ba dge/sarba maṅga lam/

sgo snyan brgyud las bskang ba rin chen phreng mdzes bzhugasaḥ——1 na mo gu ru yāḥ 'asgomag cazas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo' dpal yon bcas bla ma'i gsang shes bskang phyir 'bul / hrīḥ ma skye bsdod med de bzhin nyidaX kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskangs lhun rdzogs ye shes lnga yi gsang bde gshegs rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskangasaX srid pa'i drwa ba gcod pa poḥ lag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangasaX gcig shes kun grol sangs rgyas stonaḥ dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangasaX ma rig rgong nga'i sbub 'byed paX 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs dam bskangasaḥ mkha' ltar mnyam nyid don ston pa'iḥ shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskang snying thig dgongs pa'i 'ja' skur sbyor dz+nyā na su tra'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ ka dag kun bzang dgongs don ster bi ma mi tra'i thugs dam bskangs: rdzogs pa chen po'i nyi ma cheḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangasaḥbade chen rgyal ba mnyes mdzad pa'i ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskangasaḥ gangs ljongs bstan pa'i gzhi ma cheX khri srong lde'u btsan thugs dam bskangs rgya bod chos kyi zam

pa 'dzug0 be ro tsa na'i thugs dam bskangs smon lam skye dgu'i dpal du sminaX gter ston rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangasaX 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sa la skyolaḥ bdud 'joms gling ba'i thugs dam bskangs zang thal dri med dgongs mdzod rtedaḥ gter bzhed snying po'i thugs dam bskangasaX gzhan phan thugs rje phrin las phyugs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ hū hrīX ma bzung yul snang dag pas bskangasaḥ ma spangs nyon mongs grol bas bskangasaḥ dug gsum ka nas dag pas bskangs: bdud bzhi zil gnon bro yis bskangasaḥ zang thal rig pa'i gar gyis bskangasaḥ brjod med nā da glu yis bskangasaX 'khor gsum yongs dag dgongs pas bskangs chags nyams sgrib tshogs ka dag teḥganas sdo/gas mnyam brdal lhug par āX de ltar bskang bas tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib dag don gnyas the ma tshomaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang las ldan grogs gis bskul ngor rma rgyal chen po'i gnas mdun nas spel ba'i yi ge pa snying nor me tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ dge'o/

53 swāhāḥ brgya rtsa 'bul 'dod gsol niḥ ho rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la drok+tar+sha nas: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon 'jigs brgyad dgra jag chom rkun dkor sgrib las nyon bag chags thams cad zhi ba'i brin las rgya chen po yongs su grub par mdzod cigaḥ rgyas pa la mar khu phul te hūṃ trīḥ tsho dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byoraX snyan dang grags pa nyams rtog kunaḥ yar ngos zla ltar 'phel rgyas phyiraḥ ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ rtsa sngags gi mtharaḥ a dṛ ta khā hiḥ tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hāḥ brgya rtsa 'bul 'dod gsol niḥhoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du bdud rtsi sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cigaḥ dbang rdzas me tog 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ chags bral mardzas pa'i ka

tshaX 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can mngon spyod drag pos las kyi tshar gcod par mdzod cig bstod pa na ཿ(nyisgom med yishasda thugs rje cheḥ ma 'dres gsal ba'i sku mnga' baḥ gang 'dul chos kyi char ba 'bebaḥ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod zag med tshe yi rig 'dzin grubaḥ 'pho med dwangs ma'i sku mngon gyuraX snying tig dgongs pa'i mdzod 'dzin paḥ bi ma mi trar phyag 'tshal bstodaX dpa' bo'i don dam bden pa brjod dpa' mo'i bde stong nyams glu len rig 'dzin paṇa grub bsgo gling 'uraḥ gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la bstodaḥ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i phrin las mdzadaḥ king dang ling ga'i bka' nyan 'khrigasaḥ ma sring dbang phyug drod tshad nyulaḥ pho nya rnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ spro na bskang tshogs bya gar+ṣa rag gi mchod pa niḥshā nyi dngos 'gror yod las skyes pa yiX ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrulaX phyi nang gsang mchod mtha' yas paḥ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskangasaḥtsan ma hā pu dza sa ma ya hoX gshegs skyems ni hūṃgi 'byu bcud snyeng po mar khu 'di bka'

zhes dbab de nyid brtan bzhugs me tog 'thor bum dab niḥ e skye med dbyengs kye bum pa dzatsho bla ma'i sku gsung thugs bcud 'khyelaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ bskyed rem rnal 'byer mnga' brtes re ga ma hā gu ru kā ya a bhi ྅sgo maḥ gsang dbang ni yis bde skyong ka pā la yi nang bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i rgyunaḥ skal ldan lce la bzhag pa yis rdzogs rim sgom la mnga' brnyes shog: ma ma hā gu ru wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca aḥ sher dab ni nyaḥ bcu drug gzhon nu yid 'ong ma'i bha ga nye lam sangs rgyas byed thabs 'di ma smrangs dngas du longasaḥ chags bral bde stong mnga' brtes shogaX o ma hā gu ru mu tra a bhi ṣiñca (ཿ tshag dbang naḥ hrīḥ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long mchog: khyod kyi snying la gang gnas pa'i ye shes nyid la mnyam par zhogaḥ khreg chod rtogs pa mngon gsum 'charaḥ ma ma hā gu ru tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ rtsal dab ni zhe cit+ta rin chen gzhal yas naX ches phra'i ye shes thig ler bzhugasaḥ sgo yul rlung rig thabs mkhas naḥ thod rgal lam 'bras tshe 'dir thobaḥ 'o ma ha gu ru rat+na a bhi ṣiñca treḥ dbang thob dam tshig spya dang ni rtsa ba' bla ma'
