'o/ rgyas 'ja' lus che 'bring chung: nam mkha' nam mkhar thim dang 'ja' dang mkha'aḥ 'od dang zer la bsdu ba'ang phun tshogs so yang tha'i gdos po me yis (pe tsa naḥ g.yo ba 'ja' 'od sgra dang gdung reng bsrel mi shig rten bcas sangs rgyas rtag mtshan 'char chos skur byang chub gzugs sku'i 'gro phan sgrub 'khor ba dong sprugs brgyud gsum rgyal dgongs bcudaḥ sngags bdag ral gcig bstan srung tshogs la gnyeraḥ bka' rgya sdom la dam ldan tshogs zhing spelaḥ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du smin 11la regagaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dkon mchog blo gros nas bkra shis lha reg ran chen gdu bu sgrub pa 'a rgyal mtshan gyi skyes bcas yang yang bskul ngor 7 kho bo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nus ldan rdo rjes shar mar du spel ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba masgo lam/

tshang dag snang las mdo chings pad ma'i ga'u bzhugs so: dpa dpal ldan bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal loḥ gzung 'dzin dben pa'i rnal 'byor ngo kha /ri 'khor 'das med la yod par snang tsam 'diX snang stong zung 'jug dgags sgrub med par bzlo: rang sems dwangs gsal kha gting yangs pa dza khams gsum tshogs yul brtan g.yo rlung gi bskyedaḥ dbang yul shes ngor thugs 'phrad 'gags med 'di: gsal stong ma 'dres zung 'jug chen por bzlo chos dbyings nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa ru kun tu bzang po ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: stong gsal mdangs lnga ma 'dres 'od gsal baḥ gzhir bzhugs rig stong zung 'jug chen por bzlo stong gsal rig pa nyid du 'gags bsdam pa rtsol sgrub dgags sgrub spang blang ma byas nas: nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rang yan chen po laḥ rang thog btsan sa bzung ba'i mdo chings steX phyog las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan brtan: sa ma yāḥ e ma hoḥ theg pa'i yang rtse rim dgu 'dus pa'i lung: blo yi grub mtha'i 'di don rtogs pa med kun gyi yang zhun man ngag 'di

yis byed so so ma yen tha me dad pa'i gsang: 'og ma'i lam la ma reg reg pa'i gnadaḥ de ye rang bzhen sgreb g.yog mi mnga' bas yang dog med pa khyab brdal nam mkha'i klongaḥ gsal 'grib med pa nyi zla 'bar ba'i mthongaḥ kha gting med pa rgya mtsho dwangs gsang ngang sgrib gol bral ba 'od gsal klong yangs mthilaḥ mkhyen cha ma 'dres ji lta ji rnyed gsangaḥ ye sangs rgyas phyir ye grol mkha' ltar dgaḥ rang byung ye shes yid las shes pa minaX ma brtsal 'gags med rang snang rang shar grol shes rab srog shar rig pa ngar dwangs gsal:shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin dengs ltaraḥ gnas dang rten med 'dzin rtsol blo las 'das thim la ma rmug nang gsal gnyug ma'i zhal yang dag med pa'i mkha' mnyam rtogs pa'i gdungaḥ sangs rgyas nyag gcig sgrub pa kun gyi phulaḥ bde stong zung 'jug zhu bde kun gyi mchog: ma bcos cog bzhag bzhag thab yongs kyi rtse cer grol zang thal lhag mthong kun gyi phul ngo bo lam byed nyid du thag gcod paḥ rig pa gcig pur rang sa bzung ba yi: mdo chings yid dpyod blo bral pad+ma'i sgromaḥ ri rgyal

te/ lta bur g.yo mgul 'pho 'gyur med rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gting gsal rnyed pa lagasaḥs ma yāX e ma hoXchos dbyings nam mkhar rig pa'i 'od gsal rgyadrordozung 'jug dgongs pas 'khor 'das yongs la brdalaḥyul med zang thal snang ba'i gdos mtshan grol:gzhi med rtsa bral 'dzin pa'i rgong rgya khrol:bar med 'od gsal gnyis snang mdud rgya zhig mnyam nyid klong yangs rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas:kun btag bya 'phur rjes med stong par sangasaX bag chags las nyon zun pa rang sar dengasaḥgayo ba'i rlung nyams shes rab nyid du 'dresaḥthob pa'i yid nyams chags thogs dben par grol:goms pa'i shes nyams ye shes rjen par sonaX brtan pa'i rig nyams thugs gsang 'khor lo brdalaḥmathar byin rtogs nyams chos zad chen por 'khyolaḥshis sgrib phra ba yul med la sangs teḥrang snang 'gags med lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang shes thams cad nang dbyings la bsdus teḥdu ma rang grol gdod ma'i btsan sa rnyed:chos sku mkha' khyab 'khor lor 'ub chub teXyang dag sangs rgyas mngon rdzogs byang

nub teḥ gzugs sku'i mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gyur: gdeng tshad mthar phyen grol sar pheb pa ste sangs rgyas rang chas rted pa'e mdo chengs ste: sgreb bral kun bzang mi g.yo rgyal po'oḥ sa ma yāḥ ye ma hoḥ 'khor 'dasa.a phyi gsang sngags gnyer 'dzin masaḥ dgongs pa zang thal chos dbyings rig pa'i gteraḥ bsam gyi mi khyab sgro btag bral ba'i klong: rdzogs pa chen po ye shes gsang ba'i mdzod: mkha' dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i sgrom rgyar chug bde stong zung 'jug nyi zla'i ga'ur chug: shes rab blo ldan dad dam zhing bzang poraḥ rtog pa'i lo 'dab smin pa'i 'bras bu thob sa lam mthar phyin goms 'dres rtsal rdzogs nas: 'brel tshad chos dbyings nam mkha'i mdzad spyod rnams zos nyid bden pa'i chos skur byang chub te: 'khor ba dong sprugs srid zhi'i mgon gyur 31ga: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa' mkhas btsun dkon mchog blo gros nas bskul ngor rdzong shod mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling nas nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba thog mtha' kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cigaḥ

73 dag snang lasaX 'od gsal gnad yig nyi zla'i sgron me bzhugasaḥ yong mtshanyildamiltos yem nyo chos nyid bzhugs pas chos can mthil la rgerder+shaX seng ha'i 'brug rngams 'od gsal dbyings thig 'phelaḥ rtsal chen 'byang bor nyams snang gyur du 'char ro stod gsung bor rlung sems ar la gtad kun khyab gzigs pas chos dbyings mthong sgo 'byedaḥ dbyings la dbyings 'dre gdangs thig lhun gyis grubaX khyab brdal ye shes spros dang bral bar bzhagaḥ ye nas sgrib med bcing grol las 'das pas: chos sku'i dgongs pa sgrib med sa ler gsal 'chi ba ka dag rgyal ba'i rgyal sar snyogasaḥ sa ma yāḥ agam ho 'i ngas skulibazhugs pas ma dag 'khrul snang gnonaX gnyis 'thung nyal thabs bde stong khod snyoms brdalaḥ rkang mthil phyir phud rdog pa g.yo med lhodaḥ sugs brang sbyar pas 'byung ba cha snyoms ngang lag mthil 'gram btags gsal stong zung du 'jug ༷ kun gzigs chags thogs bral ba'i mthong sgo 'byedaḥ 'od la zer 'khrigs thig gdangs kha sbyor mchedaḥ mkhyen pa'i ye shes

sgron me 'bar bar bzhag ye nas gsal la 'grob pa me da gas pas longs spyod dzogs sku'e dgongs pa wa ler sangasaḥ bar dor rang grol sangs rgyas gdan sar phyin sa ma yāḥ e ma ho sprul sku'i bzhugs pas dag pa'i snang ba 'drongs drang srong tsog pu'i lus sems mal ltod bdeḥ rkang mthil sar sbyar rnam rtog 'gyu ba mchilaḥ sol bsnol bde stong snyoms pa'i nyams snang 'charaḥ rgal rgyud bsrings bas rtsa rlung thig le bde rlung sems drangs bas rig pa rang gsal 'charaḥ kun snang ma 'dres sa ler bkra ba'i spyan byang chub sems dpa'i gzigs yul nyid la mchedaḥ dkar nag phyed mar shar gyi rgyu skar gsal: mkhyen gnyis ye shes bde ba khung nas 'baraḥ sprul sku'i dgongs pa ma 'dres sa ler bkraḥ skye ba'i gnas stong rgyal ba'i go sar phyinaḥ sa ma yāḥ.e ma nyo 'byung ba 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags dngas shing gsalaX a ti rang byung phyi yi dkyil 'khor cheX dbang po 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags 'od gsal baX nang gi dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po'i yulaḥ shes rab 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags sgrib bkol bral gsang bar rang byung don

ma gyi da la mchog dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i phyed las so dkar 'jams rtse mo dbu ma mtha' bral 1ngaX bya grub ye shes chos dbyings ka dag mthong:mje rtse sor rtog ye shes gsal dwangs 'byed me long nyid kyis mngon gsum 'phel rtsal rdzogs grags rtse chos dbyings ye shes lta bu'i lamaḥsrid gsum ka dag dgongs pa nang nas gsal mnyam nyid gnyug ma'i rig pa ther la 'bud:khams gsum yongs grol sgom pa mthar ru phyin rtse lngar gyis pa ye shes lnga yi gsang de las ma byung gang la brten nas 'charaḥrtsa ba o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling la brtenaX gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i zhing rnams rdzogasaḥbasam gyis mi khyab dga' bral ye shes 'char:chos dbyings thugs klong dung khang sku yi dal:rgyang zhags sprul sku rnam gsum zung 'jug 'brel dwangs ma lnga klong sku thugs mnyam nyid dalaḥshes rab rang byung nang gsal sgron ma bzhug:'od kyi lus la ye shes snying por bcasaXstong gsal mdangs lnga ldan pa'i sangs rgyas zhalaḥye nas rang byung chos sku'i dkyil 'khor de blo bral rjen pas de dag mngon sum

'char sa ma yāX e ma hoḥ skal bzang phun tshogs las ldan 'jug pa'i phyiraḥ las rlung rang sar bzhag pas rang gshis zhi ye rlung klong nas 'char zhing rig dngas gsal:sems rig shan 'byed rtog pa'i sgron ma 'baraḥ ka ti 'od gsal dwangs ba rtsa yi sbubasaḥ dbang po 'char sgo 'gags med chu yi sbubs sprin bral g.ya' dag nam mkha' stong chen sbubs zung 'jug nam mkha' sum sprugs ngang la bzhagaḥ sgron ma rnam gsum shes rab yul du mched: sur+ya tsarnya a lo ke la gsalaX tsakyu zlum bu'i bde ba khung nas 'bar ༷ pad+ma kha dbus dwangs snyigs legs par 'byedaX ye shes rtse mo'i chos rnams zag pa zadaḥ dbyings ni sems kyi yin rig pa'i yulaX thig le sgod bcud las 'das sdug po bkodaX rig gdangs ngar 'dzin las 'das shes rab skuX don dam 'bras bu'i klong mdzod gting nas 'byedaḥ sa ma yā e ma hoḥ sa thob yon tan rnam par smin pa'i skabasaḥ g.yo med lus ni rus sbal mkhar gzhung dpe brjod med ngag ni smra brjod shugs 'byung dalaḥ mkha' 'gro snyi la zin ltar rlung sems klodaḥ shes rab dri ma bral ba

ga 'di dus 'char tshe dbang rig 'dzin sbyangs dka'i mthar phyin dus skyes bu nad kyi gdung ba dang 'dra'i lus:spyon pa rang tshig rdol 'dra'i ngag byung rgyalaḥsedro ni dug gi myos 'dra rang grol te rig pa dri med 'od gsal mngon gsum 'charaX phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin bdun pa rang song saraḥlus ni glang po 'dam phyin zang thal bsgrodaḥngag la bden grub dam pa'i chos su sgrogasaḥsems ni dri med ye shes 'od phung 'baraX 'khor bar mi ldog 'od gsal 'ba' zhig 'gyur:ma dwags skal ba dbyings su zhig zhes grags chos kyi sprin mthar lhun grub rig 'dzin saraḥlus ni 'jig med ya nga bag tsha bralaḥngag ni brag cha ltar gyur gzhan rjes bzlo sems ni ka dag 'od gsal 'khor lor 'dres dkar cha'i khams dag gsal nyams zla 'od tsam dmar cha'i khams dag bde nyams nyi zhur 'dren mi rtogs khams dag stong gsal g.ya' dag chaX de yang dbyings nub ngo rang thug rje'i klong:mngon gyur dbyings zig rig pa'i 'bras dbang rdzogasaḥrig pa lnga ldan khung nas ka dag sbubasaḥchos sku khyab brdal gdod ma'i mgon

por drilaḥ sku thugs zung 'jug ye shes khyab brdal ba nang dbyengs gdod ma'i mgon por byang chub nasaX bsam yas sprul pas 'gro khams dong sprugs 'gyuraḥ bka' 'dis gnyer byang sngags kyi bdag mor gtadaḥ snod med gnas su zag par mi bya b.raḥ dam ldan thugs sras skal bzang tshogs la spelaX 'brel tshad 'ja' lus rig 'dzin gdung 'tshob cing0 bsam yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon 'gyuraḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi zhes pa'ang lung zan dkon mchog blo gros nas bkra shis lha regs rin chen gdug gu sgrub pa 'i rgyal mtshan kyi skyes bcas yang yang bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes spel ba dge zhing bkra shisaḥ sarba maṅga lam/

—— dag snang lasaḥ mtha' rten rjes kyi man ngag bzhugs soḥ ba rjo na mo gu ru bī ma mi tra yaX yotholam̐ om ho myur lam theg chen sbyangs pa mthar son tshe: rabs la nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'od gsal 'dresaḥ 'bring rnams sprul bsgyur 'byams rkyon sel ba dang tha mas dag pa 'ba' zhig rmi ba niḥ sku gsum zhing la spyod pa'i skye rtags soḥ lus ni rus sbal mkhar gzhung tshud pa ltaraḥ ngag ni pi waṃ rgyun thags chad pa ltaraḥ sems ni mkha' 'gro snyi ya zin pa bzhinaḥ thob pa nyer thob rab tu thob pa ste 'di ni chos nyid bden pa mazong ba'i rtagaX lus ni skyes bu nad kyi gdung ba bzhinaX spyon pa rang tshig rdol ba dang 'dra'i ngag skyes bu dug gi myos pa lta bu'i sems mthong ba nyer mthong rab tu mthong ba steḥ 'di ni nyams snang gong du 'phel ba'i rtags glang po 'dam bsgal ri brag zang thal lus grul bum glu ltar bden pa grub pa'i ngag skyes bu 'brum nad byang bzhin mi ltung sems smin po nyer smin rab tu smin pa ste: 'di ni rig pa tshad la pheb pa'i rtagasaḥ ri bo ltar du lus la g.yo mgul medaX brag cha ji

bzhen sgra la phan gnod bralaX g.ya' dag mkha' la gnyes 'ardzan sems rtog dben rtsal dzogs nyer rdzogs rab tu rdzogs pa steX 'de rna chos zad blo 'das chen po'i rtagasaḥ 'ja' dang 'od snang lag por bkram 'dra'i lus: grags stong brjod med nā da lta bu'i ngag stong gsal shes cha skar mda' rgyugs 'dra'i sems: rig grol mdangs grol ye grol dwangs ma che 'di ni sku gsum grol bar phyin pa'oX sa ma yāX ye ma hoḥ mkhyen gnyisape shes sgron ma 'bar ba'i stobasaX rnal 'byor lam snang rab tu smin pa na snang ba sdod pas rkyen snang grogs su 'charaX sgyu lus sdod pas bya spyod 'du 'dzi boraḥ rlung sems sdod pas gang snang rig pa shar snang bar dbang thob 'og min zhing bkod 'char sgyu lus dbang thob rdos med 'od du gsalaḥ rlung sems dbang thob dri med ye shes mthongaḥ gzhan yang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa ltaraḥ che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam mo sa ma yāḥ e ma hoḥ skad cig sems kyi drwa ba gcod pa'i phyiraX chos sku'i 'chi sbyangs nam mkha' mngon gyur ngang dbyings dang rig pa bsres nas mi 'gyur

'o/ b.raḥ gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin pas ting 'dzin skyongasaḥ longs sku'i 'chi sbyor 'od gsal mngon gyur ngang dbyings dang thig le rig pa'i rwa bar gcunaḥ rigabye khyongs dang thig le'i rwa bar btsudaḥ rgyan ldan sdug po'i zhing bkod sa ler gsal: 'gags med rang gsal phyogs ris bral bar bzhagaḥ sprul sku'i 'chi sbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byer bsgomaX thugs yid gcig bsres zangs mdog dpal rir gtadaḥ ston pa o rgyan 'khor ni lo paṇa tshogasaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging lang sun mar bcasaḥ tshom bu gciga'akhod 'pho ba'i thabs la brtsonaḥ thabs des rab ni tshe 'dir sku gsum 'grub 'bring tha bar do srid pa nyid la grolaḥ gong 'phel mthong bar lam gyi gdam ngag steḥ tshad pheb nas bzung 'di yi spros las 'dasaḥ sa ma yāX oṃm nya rnal 'byor dbang po yang rab rims pa la de ltar ma bcos spros med chen por grol gzhan yang rab 'bring tha ma'i sde rnams laḥ grol byed man ngag bar do'i gdam ngag gnadaḥ ngo bo nges tshig dbye bas sa mtshams dang lus drug rtag drug snang lug rnam pa drugaḥ mtshan nyid sbyongs byed rtogs dang

ma rtog khyad rtsa tshig la sogs bco brgyad rems pa bachenaḥ skye gnasabar dor thosabasam sgom gsum bya rmi lam sgyu lus sprul bsgyur 'od gsal sbyangs: bsam gtan bar do rig pa rang grol brtson 'chi kha'i bar dor 'pho ba rang grol gnad chos nyid bar dor mthong ba rang grol gzer srid pa bar dor 'byul snang rang grol gyisaḥ gdam ngag zabamosa'akhor ba dong sprugs nas mi ldog rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gdung 'tshob 'gyur gsang ba lasakyang rab tu gsang ba'i chosaX skal bzang bsgrod pa gcig pu'i las bzang poḥthugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du shogaḥ bka' gtsig phyag rgyas btab po e ka tsaḥ bsdam spel thabab la mkhas mdzod sa ma yaḥ 'brel tshad 'ja' lus rdo rje'i shul lam rted kun bzang thugs kyi gdul zhing yongs smin regag: sam pāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim thiḥ zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin dkon mchog blo grosan bkra shis lha reg sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gya skyesabacas yang yang bskul bdab nye gnasayi ge'i mthun skyen pa mkhar lonasabaskur ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang ba' 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shisapar gyur cig sarba ma lam/

༄༅/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ maswābha wa sogs kyi stong pa ra sbya sa te/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ trīḥ las dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas dbyug do dang g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros te dbyings nas ye shes pa sbyan drangs te bskyed pa'i lha la thim/ de'i sku yi cha thams cad nas dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa'i bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas la/ sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni/ hūṃ trīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi bdag gtum rngam bzod dka'i rnam 'gyur can/ ma chags thabs kyi rol rtsed bsgyur/ rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la bstod/ las bum gyi lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thim pas bag chags bkru zhing bgegs dpung gzhoms pa'i mthu ldan du gyur/ de nas bdag dbang len pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ hūṃ trīḥ rdor sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsol/ 'gags med gsung gi dngos grub stsol/ 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ yon tan re skong dngos grub

stsol/phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsol/mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsolaḥrtsa sngags mthar/kwa ya sernyi oḥwāk+ka ā tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ sarba sidhi trīḥ'adi'ang sgrub pa'i cha lag tu/pakho phyir pad+ma'i ming gis bris/'byug thar dgyes pa'i rgyur gyur cigasarba masgo lam/

badz+ra: nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos gter las: sgogegs bzlog pa 'bar ba'i 'khor lo bzhugs badz+ra na mo gu ru yaX marwa〉rnaro/ mkha' 'gro'i brda skad du ru 'u ci ya dza dhi raḥ 'jig rten gyi skad duḥ srid gegs bzlog pa'i gzungs rtsa gsum dam can srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥ me sa lcags chu shing gi yos bu la sri gegs bdud srin gyi za kha gshed mchu zug pa thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaX snyen dhu ru dhu ru tsakra ma sha dza ra bh+yo bh+yoḥ shing chu lcags sa me yi 'brug la pho sri mo sri chung sri ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ dza ya dza ya tsakraX bhu ru sha ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ chu lcags sa me shing gi sbrul la dar sri dur sri gegs sri g.yo ba thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaX ha na ha na tsakraḥ shidz+nya ku ru bh+yo bh+yoḥ lcags chu shing sa me yi rta la dgra bdud sri gegs phung 'dre g.yo ba thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ bhu ru bhu ru tsakra ya ma shu shu bh+yo bh+yoḥ me sa lcags shing chu yi lugs la pha gegs bu dang ma gegs bu mo la rtsub

shā kyi 'gags med tsamaḥ snang stong zung 'jug dgag sgrubs med par gzigs 'di don rtogs pas phyi skor lus dab 'draḥ gnas la ma zhen gsal ba mngon (rwa skyongs 'phro la rang yal 'gyu ba 'gags med tsamaḥ gsal stong zung 'jug spangs blangs med par gzigasaX 'di don rtogs pa'i nang skor mig dang 'draḥchos skur ma zhen longs sku mngon gyur skyongasaX sprul sku 'gags med shar grol zung 'jug ngangaḥ bying rgod bral bar thugs 'phrad rjes med grolaḥ 'di don rtogs pas gsang skor snying dang 'draḥ'od gsal ma zhen ye shes snying po skyongasaX stong gsal mdangs lnga ma 'dres ris med klong gnad gsum chings bzhis 'bras bu'i nyi ma 'charaḥ 'di don rtogs pasayang gsang bla na medaX gsal sgo ma 'gags phyi skor nam mkha' 'draḥ 'char cha ma 'dres nang skar nyi ma 'draX gnyis su byar med gsang skor zu 'jug 'dra srid zhi mnyamasangs yang gsang rgyal ba dngosaḥrgyu la 'bras bu kha sbyor bdun 'char baḥ rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i don dam gnadaḥ sa ma yaḥbaltar med lta ba ngos bzung med par grolaḥ nam

mkha' 'od gsal blo yid grub mtha' grolaḥ'adi don bsam brjod spros pa'i mtha' kun grolaX dmigs su med pa nam mkha' cog bzhag yinaḥbasgom med bsgom blo kun gzhi yid rlung grolaḥ'akhrul rtog nyam zhen shun pa tha dag grolaḥm rig gzhir sangs rten 'brel phung lnga grolaḥ zang thal phyal ba rgya mtsho cog bzhag yin spyod med spyod pas theng brgyad spros pa grolaḥ dpe cha'i zhen 'dzin grub mtha'i dpyad blo grolaḥkhams gsum zhi gnas srid gsum lhag mthong grol lhun 'grub rang zhal man ngag cog bzhag yin brtsal med 'bras bu thob bya'i chos rnams grol gang zhig ma thob pa yi yul las grolaḥgazhi lam 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen por grolaḥrig pa gcig pu dbyings ye cog bzhag klongaX rtsol sgrub las 'das ye shes bla ma'i zhalaX ji bzhin gzigs la shrī seng ha dngosaḥ sa ma yāX chos dbyings klong yangs chos can 'gags med rdzogs snang stong zung 'jug mnyam bzhag sgom pa'i 'phrang mnyam nyid sgrib bral rtogs pa spyod pa'i sgog chos nyid dbu ma chen po'i zab gnad yin stong gsal nam mkha' cha mnyam yangs pa'i

rdzo ༷ rdzongaX 'od lnga mnyam sangs 'od gsal sgom pa'i 'phrang dbyings ye zung 'jug rtogs pa spyod pa'i srog sems klong dbyer med dgongs pa'i zab gnad〉(1ka dag mkha' la lhun grub 'od lnga'i rdzongaX nang gsal rig pa byang rgod rang sangs 'phrangaXrig stong 'ub chub rdzogs pa chen po'i sgogaḥ.a ti yo ga 'bras bu'i nying khuyinaXsnang ba yul zug:de las rnam rgyal nas rig pa rang snang shā sang ha'i lugs sa ma yā 0gang tsheb deyod tsa na 'dzin pa yod yul dbang shes gsum gzhi rtsa rnam dag tshe chos nyid bden pa mngon sum mtho tsa na nyon mongs sgrib gol stug po bag la zha gang la yod yod pas na nyon yid yodaX yul shes thugs 'phrad bag chags gnas stong tshe shes nyams gong 'phel mnyam rjes dbyer med brdalaX bag la zha ba'i snang shes zil gnon grolaḥgang der rlung bde pas na rnam shes yod ༷shes pa thugs 'phrad rang zhig rangagrol sangasaḥlas rlung g.ya' dag nyin mtshan bar med 'dresaḥshes sgrib rag pa'i dpang gnon phra bar gnas dkar dmar nag gsum bde gsal mi rtog phra rlung shes go

'byed ring bar dbyings nub te snang ba skad rig rming med tshad pheb nas blo zad chos zad rlung zad sa gsum brgalaḥshes rabs dbang rta ye shes 'od kyi dbangaḥ sprul sku'i'od gsal bum pa gting gsal klong shes rab rang byung sgrol ma de ru 'khyil rdo rje lug brgyud thugs la skye 'gags med rig pa'i rta la 'od gsal kha sbyor dbangaḥ longasasku'i ye shes stong chen phyag rgya'i lhums stong pa thig le'i sgrol ma de ru sangs klong gsal 'od kyi sku la 'pho 'gyur medaḥye shes rta la ka dag klong sbyor dbangaX chos sku'i dgongs pa khyab brdal phyogs lhung bral nam mkha' rnam dag sgrol ma de klong 'dres zung 'jug chos sku'i klong chen bcing grol medaḥ'adas pa ming med du ma rang grol klong 'khor ba med med ka dag ye grol ngangaḥ bcu drug ye shes bla ma'i sa non pa 'bras bu'i yang rtse shrī seng ha yinaX sa ma lngaX skye 'gags dbyer med rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' ye shes gzigs pa phyogs ris bral ba'i 'gros med gcig phyal lhun dam tshig 'dzin skyongs maḥ sbas don gsang ba 'dzin pa'i sngags bsrung gsolaḥyang na rig dang rig

shāX pa brje la sprod lus srog 'dor kyang nyam nga med na rigaḥ yang na rig pa mi phang nor gyis bsluḥ stong gsum yon gyi gzhal byar ga la rung ya na rig pa ( byed sbyin par byaX gces rgu cog bzhag gcig shes kun grol loḥ de ni shrī sing ha'i gdul zhing ngoX khams gsum srid par bcal kyang rnyed par dka'aḥ sa ma yāḥ gter rgyaḥnam mkha'i rnal 'byor 'od gsal gling gtad rgyaḥshrī sing don dam gnad gcig 'diḥ sbas rgyaḥrdo rje lta bu'i klong nas btonaḥ zab rgyaX blo bral cog bzhag bsgo skal ste gsang rgyaḥsnang ba yul gyi blo la sdomaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya ༷ brda thimaḥsnyiḥ 'jig rten chos brgyad dkor dang 'di ma brje grogs sngags ban bon khrong du 'di ma gleng rtsol sgrub sgo gsum chos la 'di ma btsongs ji bzhin nyid de ma nor ma bcos lags lhun grub rdo rje dang mun sil dngaḥdakon mchog blo gros dngaḥgrogs rat+na sa ra rnamasal brtse ba chen pos nusaldan rdo rjes phul ba thogs mtha' bar gsum du dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cigaḥ

53 dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo: gzod nas ma skyes chos sku byang chub sems: kun la snyoms shing yongs su brnal ba'i gshes: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'ibye rdo pa bsam mtha' yas ma skyes mi 'gags mi gnas dbu ma che: e ma med byung ngo mtshar spros mtha' bral: dbyings kyi rang bzhin rgya chad phyogs lhung dben gang yang ma grub stong dbyings kun bzang mo: snang srid bde sdug 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur chos thams cad ma grub kun bzang klong du dag dag pa zhes su te yul logs na dben 'khrul ba dmigs med ming tsam gshis su grol ngo bo sangs ma rgyas pa skru tsam med: rang bzhin dag par ma gyur 'ga' tsam bral: thugs rje gshis su ma dag gang ma 'chis: dus gsum bya ba rtog pa'i spu ris can: sangs ma rgyas la sangs rgyas ming du btags: chos sku rgyab dor gzugs sku der 'dzin bltas cang ma shes pa'i rtse gnyis blo zung zad:dug lnga spang nas ye shes rtsol ba can: sa bon bral bas 'bras bus ya re nga: da lta'i so ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor dor: stong par btsal ba'i 'bras bu ma rted rmong: ku yang blo

hoX bde gcig shes kun grol la: 'jur bcing rmongs pa'i sgrog btsud mgo re rmongs: phyi rgya grol te klong chen nam mkha'i ngang: nang rgya grol te dbyings rig (1 3 'jug: gsang rgya grol te gnyis med kun bzang klong 'ub chub mnyam pa nyid kyi gsang lam te: shes par mdzod cig las ldan snying gi bu: sa ma yāḥ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du la bzla ba'o: gu rgya: dus gsum ma 'khrul mi 'khrul 'khrul bral gshis: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod dam pa ste: snang ba kun bzang bde chen yab kyi dal: stong pa kun bzang shes rab yum gyi ngang: gsal ba kun bzang nyon mongs rang grol gshis: stong pa kun bzang ye shes lnga ldan klong: bde ba kun bzang byang chub semasadapa'i dal: stong pa kun bzang rang grol sems ma'i ngang: dga' ba kun bzang he ru ka pa'i dbyings stong pa kun bzang gro ti chen mo'i klong rig pa kun bzang gsal 'gribadamigs su med: stong pa kun bzang rgya grol nam mkha' chen: ngo bo kun bzang chos sku de bzhin nyid rang bzhin kun bzang longs sku mtshan ma bral: thugs rje kun bzang

/ rang grol don:snang ba kun bzang sku yi dkyil 'khor la:grags pa kun bzang gsung gi rang bzhin can 'gyu 'phro kun bzang thugs kyi gshis su grol:kun bzang mi bzang chos 'ga' bral:dgongs pa zang thal rtogs mdzod sgal pa can:sa ma yu:snang srid kun tu bzang po'i rol par la bzla ba'o:gu h+ya:dgongs pa shar grol nyid bde ba'i klong gtad med byung rgyal lta ba rtogs 'dod rnams:nga bdag phung por 'dzin pa'i mdud dam phra:phyi nang 'dod yon kun btags zad med gter:ma bden gnas dpyad na rdzun ris can:sor rtog shes rab rdo rje rnon po yis:byung gnas 'gro ba'i yul rnams kun btsal te:rtog pa'i btags tsam bden par ma grub re dogs gnyis su 'ching ba'i rdzun phug rdib:med pa ne tso' gtam bzhin smra mkhas yang:don thog khel lam ma khel mtshang la rgol:snang ba mched 'gags rten 'brel byung chos:snang mched thob pa'i bskal pa dbyings su zhig:thams cad sems las byung ste sems su yal rten 'brel ma gtogs bden pa'i chos 'ga' med:snang

53 sems rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ste rten 'brel gang yin pa de stong par zad: stong zhes bya ba dmigs su med pa 'o:rdo rje'i rang bshin 'apo 'gyur(tā pas 'das: re yul sangs rgyas mnyam pa nyid las dben dogs yul 'khor ba dug gsum sems su rdzogs: bzang po lha dben rang rig byang chub sems: ngan pa 'drestong bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba'o: thams cad bar med phyal ba chen po ste: rig pa byang sems 'ub chub gcig tu grol:dbyengs ni sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan: lhun grub 'dus mabyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dod 'byung nor bu ji bzhin bsam mi khyab: dbyings ye zung 'jug stong gsal mnyam nyid don: gtad so bral ba'i lta ba nam mkha' che: dusagasum mnyam grol dgongs pa mngon gyur mdzod: sa ma yā:'khor 'das ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug tu la bzla ba'o: gu rgya:ye nas gnas kyang j-i bzhin ma rtogs 'khrul: dalta'i shes pa zang ma thal byung 'di: yin min bzang ngan bslad kyis ma zhugs par: rtse mo byung rgyal rig pa gcer bur byung: re dogs rtog dpyod rtsis gdab gang ma byas: ma

zhakhrul 'khrul ba'i sems rtogs kun dang bral:ma dmigs dmigs par bya ba'i 'dzin stang dben:ma rmongs rmongs pa'i 'thib cha kun gzhi grol:ma 'dzin 'dzin pa'i gsal cha myong zhen bral:ma zhen zhen pa'i bde nyams basmu brid dor ma 'thor 'thor bar bya ba rtog pa'i ngang ma byang byang bar gyur na kun rmongs gzeb:mkha' la nyi zla shar ba'i rang 'od bzhin:ched 'dzin med pa'i rang gsal rang grol ste 'dod 'byung nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser btags bzhin:sku gsum ye shes bsam yas 'dzin pa grol:phyi nang bar med gsal ba'i rig pa 'di:ma bcing ma bsdams ma lta ma gtad klod ma dmigs ma bsgoms ma 'dzin ma 'khrul ngang:mi spro mi sdud mi dpyod mi dmigs gal:mi gnas mi shig mi rtsol mi sgrib par:hang nge yang nge sang nge zang nger gnas:shigs se khrol le phyam me brnal le bzhag:kun shes kun rigs kun gsal kun tu bzang chags med chags bral chags yul rkyen dang bral:zang thal sgom pa blo 'das ye shes 'di:ma dor rtsol ba thang lhod bral bar skyongs:sa ma yā:gang shar ye shes sgom med blo 'das su

shā kyi la bzla ba'o gu h+ya: rang grol rol ba chen po'i rnal 'byor pas: lta ba nam mkha' ji bzhin dmigs su med: klong chen gza' gtad bral bar cog bzhag bye sgom pa rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba bzhin: kun rtog rlabs kyi ma bskyod dngas gsal bzhag: spyod pa snang sems gang shar gang 'gyu yang: de thog de gar mnyam brdal rang grol bzhag: 'bras bu sgrib bral nyi ma'i snying po bzhin gnyis rtog sprin gyis ma gos gsal bar bzhag: man ngag rang grol cog bzhag bzhi'i gnad skyongs ye nas grol ba g.ya' dag nam mkha' ltar: rang sar grol ba sbrul mdud mkha' bor bzhin: shar tsam grol ba chu yi rlab bzhin no: cer gyis grol ba rdo bsreg kha ba ltar: gcig tu grol ba kum zlum thig le che: gnyis med grol ba dbyings rig zung du 'jug mtha' kun grol ba zang thal nam mkha' che: rlabs kyis grol ba nyon mongs rang grol ngang shugs kyis grol ba sku gsum ye shes so: shes te grol ba sngar 'dres mi 'phrad bzhin: mthong nas grol ba rdzun pa'i gtam bzhin no: rtogs pas grol ba re dogs gza' gtad bral lta

ba klong grol 'di yin 'jog so bral sgom pa kun grol 'di min bsal bzhag dben: spyod pa mnyam grol yin min sgro 'dogs bral: byang chub sems grol dus gsum yul las dben: ma bcos rang grol 'dus ma byas pa'i don: rgyal kun dgongs pa zang thal 'ub chub mdzod: sa ma yā: cog bzhag bzhi dang grol lugs bcu drug gi gnad la brten nas dgongs pa zang thal du la bzla ba'o: gu h+ya phun tshogs skal ba bzang po'i skyes bu rnams: yang gsang rmad byung lam la spyod pa'i tshe: lta ba yas 'bebs snang srid chos skur blta: spyod pa mas 'jog dran shes bag yod brten stong par rtogs pas kha 'byams ga la 'tshal: bden med mthong tshe shes bzhin dug mi 'thung: dag mnyam rjen mjal log spyod lta ci 'tshal bar med mngon gyur gnyis rtog 'tshubs don dben: rang grol rtogs pas rang zhabrul rang mnar rmongs: kha skad mtho bas mthong ba ma yin te mi g.yo don rtogs 1nga mtho mtho ba'o: rjesa'ajug rnams kyis gzab par ma byas na: lta mtshang spyod pas ston tshe ya re nga de phyir nges pa don gyi rnal 'byor pas: rang rig bla

shā mar 'char bas mos gus rgyas: gang snang chos skur rtogs pas dag snang 'phel: gang shar ye shes mthong ba'i dug lnga grol:snang sred bden med rtogs〉〉 〉gas sdang zhi: stong chen lta ba rtogs pa'i der 'dzin grol zang thal sgom pa mthong ba'i 'khrul zhen bor: rnams rgyal spyod pa mjal ba'i 'chol rnyogs zhi: thams cad skugasum la mthong bsal bzhag bral: gser gling phyin pas sa rdo mi rted bzhin: 'khrul snang zhen 'dzin mi rnyed dus gcig 'byung: spyon pa 'ur gyis bslang ba sngi bzhin du: dusakun dga' spro 'phel te gsal 'dzum me: bde chen ye shes rjen pa'i gshis dang 'grogs gdong lnga gangs la 'gying bzhin lta gdings mtho khrim bdag mdun sar phebabazhin spyod pa zhib: ma bu zung du 'jug bzhin bsgom pa skyid: gnad gsum 'dun ma gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad 'byung: rgya grol rig pa rta bdun sngi bzhin gsal: rno rnams gsumaspyod cig skal ba can: sa ma yā:mirmong pa rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa chen por la bzla ba'o: gu rgya:rnal b.lidan spyod rig ldan snying gi bus: snang ba dngos por 'dzin pa'i

sems dang ni ye shes zang thal rig pa shan 'byed 'phyong: tshogs drug snang ba 'du byed rnam shes dang: bar med brdal ba ye shes shan 'byed 'phyong: dwangs gsal 'khrul ba'igazhi ma yid dang ni: rnam dpyod rtsal 'bar shes rab shan 'byed 'phyong: nor ba med pa'i go ba gsal po dang: nyams myong rjen par rtogs pa'i shan 'byed 'phyong: gdangs rtsal sgo 'gags kun gzhi 'thub po dang mnyam brdal gsal stong chos sku shan 'byed 'phyong ma nor rmongs pa'i blo gsal mngon du byung: ji bzhin theg mchog rgyal po'i lam la brten: rmad byung rang rig dgongs pa mngon gyur mdzod: sa ma yā:shan 'byed kyi 'phyong zab mo mi rmongs par la bzla ba'o: gu rgya: smon lam 'phro sad rnal 'byor pho mo yis nyin mtshan bar med 'od gsal bsgom pa'i mthus: snang ba'i yul zad 'dzin pa'i sems rtog grol: gnyis snang dag la 'od gsal chen por gnas: gdangs kyi grol ba'i sa la pheb pa'o: da dung shes sgrib phra ba'i rba rlabs kyis snang ba lag sor bkram ltar skad cig mngon: rdo rje'i rtse mo klong grol rig pa'i mthus: skad cig nyid la bcom ste

shā gdod ma'i gzhi: khyad chos drug ldan bum sku'i rgyal sa la: kun tu bzang po'i chos drug mngon gyur te chos kyi dbyings su rmad byung rdzogs sangs rgyas 111sa kyi 'khor ba dbyings su ma stong bar: dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa bsam yas 'byung: theg mchog 'khor lo'i sgra sgrogs don kun grub: 'ub chub rdzogs pa chen pora'abyams klas byed: sa ma yā: 'bras bu rnam par dag pa'i tshul bstan pa ste mngon gyur du bsgrub pa'i la bzla ba'o: gu khya: rang snang midzab dag pa dpal gyi zhing: rang rigaston pa pad+masam bha was rang rtsal 'khor gyi thog mnus ldan par rang gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos char phab: rang byung 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dus su'o: rang bab gnyugama'i klong rbas gtad rgya te rang grol dus su sad pabadud 'dul bas rang snang 'khor la phan bde spel ba'i phyir: rang rdol med byung brda ris gtams pa'o sa ma yā: rgya rgyargya: zang thal dgongs pa rang byung gcer grol ḍak+ki'i gsang lam zab mo rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya: o rgyan gyi slon dponapad+ma se bha
